## [Short Title]{.HTitleText1} {#h-583523 .Part}

**[[1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1 .sectionLabel}** These Regulations may be
cited as the [Income Tax Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._945).

## [Interpretation]{.HTitleText1} {#h-583525 .Part}

**[[2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-2 .sectionLabel}** In these Regulations,
[[Act]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the [Income Tax Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3).

## [PART I]{.HLabel1}[Tax Deductions]{.HTitleText1} {#h-583527 .Part}

### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-583528 .Subheading}

- **[[100]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-100 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  this Part and in Schedule I,

  [[employee]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[employee]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any person receiving
      remuneration; ([employé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[employer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[employer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any person paying
      remuneration; ([employeur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[estimated deductions]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[estimated deductions]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of
      a taxation year, the total of the amounts estimated to be
      deductible by an employee for the year under any of paragraphs
      8(1)(f), (h), (h.1), (i) and (j) of the Act and determined by the
      employee for the purpose of completing the form referred to in
      subsection 107(2); ([déductions estimatives]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[exemptions]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[exemptions]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/89-508, s.
      1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[pay period]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[pay period]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a day,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a week,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a two week period,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a semi-monthly period,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a month,

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a four week period,

      - [(g)]{.lawlabel} one tenth of a calendar year, or

      - [(h)]{.lawlabel} one twenty-second of a calendar year; ([période
        de paie]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[personal credits]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[personal credits]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a
      particular taxation year, the greater of

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount referred to in paragraph 118(1)(c)
        of the Act, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of the credits which the employee
        would be entitled to claim for the year under

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} subsections 118(1), (2) and (3) of the Act if
          the description of A in those subsections were read as "is
          equal to one",

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} subsections 118.3(1) and (2) of the Act if
          the description of A in subsection 118.3(1) of the Act were
          read as "is equal to one" and if subsection 118.3(1) of the
          Act were read without reference to paragraph (c) thereof,

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} subsections 118.5(1) and 118.6(2) of the
          Act if subsection 118.5(1) of the Act were read without
          reference to "the product obtained when the appropriate
          percentage for the year is multiplied by" and the description
          of A in subsection 118.6(2) of the Act were read as "is equal
          to one", and after deducting from the aggregate of the amounts
          determined under those subsections the excess over \$3,000 of
          the aggregate of amounts that the employee claims to expect to
          receive in the year on account of a scholarship, fellowship or
          bursary,

        - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} section 118.8 of the Act if the formula A +
          B - C in that section were read as

          > :::: ReadAsText
          > ::: {#583552 .ReadAsText}
          > (A + B) / C
          >
          > where
          >
          > [A]{.dfn}
          > :   is the value of A in that section,
          >
          > [B]{.dfn}
          > :   is the value of B in that section, and
          >
          > [C]{.dfn}
          > :   is the appropriate percentage for the year,
          > :::
          > ::::

        - [(v)]{.lawlabel} section 118.9 of the Act if the formula A - B
          in section 118.81 of the Act were read as

          > :::: ReadAsText
          > ::: {#583559 .ReadAsText}
          > A / B
          >
          > where
          >
          > [A]{.dfn}
          > :   is the value of A set out in that section, and
          >
          > [B]{.dfn}
          > :   is the appropriate percentage for the year. ([crédits
          >     d'impôts personnels]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})
          > :::
          > ::::

  [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes any payment that is

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} salary or wages, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} commissions or other similar amounts fixed
          by reference to the volume of the sales made or the contracts
          negotiated (referred to as [[commissions]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}
          in this Part)

      paid to an officer or employee or former officer or employee,

      - [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an employee's gratuities
        required under provincial legislation to be declared to the
        employee's employer,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a superannuation or pension benefit (including
        an annuity payment made pursuant to or under a superannuation or
        pension fund or plan) other than a distribution

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} that is made from a pooled registered pension
          plan and is not required to be included in computing a
          taxpayer's income under paragraph 56(1)(z.3) of the Act, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} that subsection 147.5(14) of the Act deems
          to have been made,

      - [(b.1)]{.lawlabel} an amount of a distribution out of or under a
        retirement compensation arrangement,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a retiring allowance,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a death benefit,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a benefit under a supplementary unemployment
        benefit plan,

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a payment under a deferred profit sharing plan
        or a plan referred to in section 147 of the Act as a [[revoked
        plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, reduced, if applicable, by amounts
        determined under subsections 147(10.1), (11) and (12) of the
        Act,

      - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a benefit under the [Employment Insurance
        Act](/eng/acts/E-5.6),

      - [(g.1)]{.lawlabel} an amount that is required by paragraph
        56(1)(a.3) of the Act to be included in computing a taxpayer's
        income,

      - [(h)]{.lawlabel} an amount that is required by paragraph
        56(1)(r) of the Act to be included in computing a taxpayer's
        income, except the portion of the amount that relates to child
        care expenses and tuition costs,

      - [(h.1)]{.lawlabel} an amount that is required by paragraph
        56(1)(z.2) of the Act to be included in computing a taxpayer's
        income,

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a payment made during the lifetime of an
        annuitant referred to in the definition
        [[annuitant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 146(1) of the
        Act out of or under a registered retirement savings plan of that
        annuitant, other than

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a periodic annuity payment, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a payment made by a person who has
          reasonable grounds to believe that the payment may be deducted
          under subsection 146(8.2) of the Act in computing the income
          of any taxpayer,

      - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a payment out of or under a plan referred to in
        subsection 146(12) of the Act as an [[amended
        plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} other than

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a periodic annuity payment, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} where paragraph 146(12)(a) of the Act
          applied to the plan after May 25, 1976, a payment made in a
          year subsequent to the year in which that paragraph applied to
          the plan,

      - [(j.1)]{.lawlabel} a payment made during the lifetime of an
        annuitant referred to in the definition
        [[annuitant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 146.3(1) of the
        Act under a registered retirement income fund of that annuitant,
        other than a particular payment to the extent that

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the particular payment is in respect of the
          minimum amount (in this paragraph having the meaning assigned
          by subsection 146.3(1) of the Act) under the fund for a year,
          or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} where the fund governs a trust, the
          particular payment would be in respect of the minimum amount
          under the fund for a year if each amount that, at the
          beginning of the year, is scheduled to be paid after the time
          of the particular payment and in the year to the trust under
          an annuity contract that is held by the trust both at the
          beginning of the year and at the time of the particular
          payment, is paid to the trust in the year,

      - [(k)]{.lawlabel} a benefit described in section 5502,

      - [(l)]{.lawlabel} an amount as, on account or in lieu of payment
        of, or in satisfaction of, proceeds of the surrender,
        cancellation or redemption of an income-averaging annuity
        contract,

      - [(m)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an amount that can reasonably be
        regarded as having been received, in whole or in part, as
        consideration or partial consideration for entering into a
        contract of service, where the service is to be performed in
        Canada, or for an undertaking not to enter into such a contract
        with another party,

      - [(n)]{.lawlabel} a payment out of a registered education savings
        plan other than

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a refund of payments,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an educational assistance payment, or

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} an amount, up to \$50,000, of an
          accumulated income payment that is made to a subscriber, as
          defined in subsection 204.94(1) of the Act, or if there is no
          subscriber at that time, that is made to a person that has
          been a spouse or common-law partner of an individual who was a
          subscriber, if

          - [(A)]{.lawlabel} that amount is transferred to an RRSP in
            which the annuitant is either the recipient of the payment
            or the recipient's spouse or common-law partner, and

          - [(B)]{.lawlabel} it is reasonable for the person making the
            payment to believe that that amount is deductible for the
            year by the recipient of the payment within the limits
            provided for in subsection 146(5) or (5.1) of the Act,

      - [(o)]{.lawlabel} an amount of a disability assistance payment
        made under a registered disability savings plan that is required
        by paragraph 56(1)(q.1) of the Act to be included in computing a
        taxpayer's income,

      - [(p)]{.lawlabel} an amount that is required by paragraph
        56(1)(z.5) of the Act to be included in computing a taxpayer's
        income,

      - [(q)]{.lawlabel} a payment described in paragraph 153(1)(v) of
        the Act, or

      - [(r)]{.lawlabel} an amount that is required by subparagraph
        56(1)(a)(viii) of the Act to be included in computing the
        taxpayer's income; ([rémunération]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[total remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[total remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a
      taxation year, the total of all amounts each of which is an amount
      referred to in paragraph (a) or (a.1) of the definition
      [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}. ([rémunération
      totale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the amount of any credit referred to in
  paragraph (a) or (b) of the definition [[personal
  credits]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection (1) is subject to an
  annual adjustment under section 117.1 of the Act, such amount shall,
  in a particular taxation year, be subject to that annual adjustment.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, where an employer
  deducts or withholds from a payment of remuneration to an employee one
  or more of the following amounts, the balance remaining after the
  deducting or withholding of the amount or amounts shall be deemed to
  be the amount of that payment of remuneration:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a contribution to or under a pooled registered
    pension plan, a registered pension plan or a specified pension plan,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} dues described in subparagraph 8(1)(i)(iv), (v)
    or (vi) of the Act paid on account of the employee,

  - [(b.1)]{.lawlabel} a contribution by the employee under subparagraph
    8(1)(m.2) of the Act,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a premium under a registered retirement savings
    plan, to the extent that the employer believes on reasonable grounds
    that the premium is deductible under paragraph 60(j.1) or subsection
    146(5) or (5.1) of the Act in computing the employee's income for
    the taxation year in which the payment of remuneration is made,

  - [(c.1)]{.lawlabel} a contribution to or under a FHSA, to the extent
    that the employer believes on reasonable grounds that the
    contribution is deductible under subsection 146.6(5) of the Act in
    computing the employee's income for the taxation year in which the
    payment of remuneration is made,

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an amount that is deductible under paragraph 60(b)
    of the Act,

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} an amount that is deductible under paragraph
    60(e.1) of the Act, or

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} an amount that is deductible under paragraph 60(l)
    of the Act.

- [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, where an employee
  has claimed a deduction for a taxation year under paragraph
  110.7(1)(b) of the Act as shown on the return most recently filed by
  the employee with the employee's employer pursuant to subsection
  227(2) of the Act, the amount of remuneration otherwise determined,
  including the amount deemed by subsection (3) to be the amount of that
  payment of remuneration, paid to the employee for a pay period shall
  be reduced by an amount equal to the amount of the deduction divided
  by the maximum number of pay periods in the year in respect of the
  appropriate pay period.

- [(3.2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2001-209, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, where an employee is
  not required to report for work at any establishment of the employer,
  he shall be deemed to report for work

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of remuneration that is salary, wages or
    commissions, at the establishment of the employer from which the
    remuneration is paid; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of remuneration other than salary, wages
    or commissions, at the establishment of the employer in the province
    where the employee resides at the time the remuneration is paid but,
    if the employer does not have an establishment in that province at
    that time, he shall, for the purposes of this paragraph, be deemed
    to have an establishment in that province.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, where an employer
  deducts or withholds from a payment of remuneration to an employee an
  amount in respect of the acquisition by the employee of an approved
  share, as defined in subsection 127.4(1) of the Act, there shall be
  deducted from the amount determined under paragraph 102(1)(e) or
  (2)(e), as the case may be, in respect of that payment the lesser of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} \$750, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 15% of the amount deducted or withheld in respect
    of the acquisition of an approved share.

### [Deductions and Remittances]{.HTitleText2} {#h-583618 .Subheading}

**[[101]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-101 .sectionLabel}** Every person who makes
a payment described in subsection 153(1) of the Act in a taxation year
shall deduct or withhold therefrom, and remit to the Receiver General,
such amount, if any, as is determined in accordance with rules
prescribed in this Part.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/81-471, s. 2
:::

### [Periodic Payments]{.HTitleText2} {#h-583622 .Subheading}

- **[[102]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-102
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Except as otherwise provided in this
  Part, the amount to be deducted or withheld by an employer

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} from any payment of remuneration (in this
    subsection referred to as the [[payment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}) made
    to an employee in his taxation year where he reports for work at an
    establishment of the employer in a province, in Canada beyond the
    limits of any province or outside Canada, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for any pay period in which the payment is made by
    the employer

  shall be determined for each payment in accordance with the following
  rules:

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an amount that is a notional remuneration for the
    year in respect of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a payment to the employee, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount, if any, of gratuities referred to in
      paragraph (a.1) of the definition
      [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 100(1)

    is deemed to be the amount determined by the formula

    ::: {#583632 .Paragraph}
    A × B

    where

    [A]{.dfn}
    :   is the amount that is deemed for the purpose of this paragraph
        to be the mid-point of the applicable range of remuneration for
        the pay period, as provided in Schedule I, in which falls the
        total of
        - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the payment referred to in subparagraph (i)
          made in the pay period, and

        - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the amount of gratuities referred to in
          subparagraph (ii) declared by the employee for the pay period,
          and

    [B]{.dfn}
    :   is the maximum number of such pay periods in that year;
    :::

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} if the employee is not resident in Canada at the
    time of the payment, no personal credits will be allowed for the
    purposes of this subsection and, if the employee is resident in
    Canada at the time of the payment, the employee's personal credits
    for the year are deemed to be the mid-point of the range of amounts
    of personal credits for a taxation year as provided for in section 2
    of Schedule I;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} an amount (in this subsection referred to as the
    [[notional tax for the year]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}) shall be computed
    in respect of that employee by

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} calculating the amount of tax payable for the
      year, as if that amount were calculated under subsection 117(2) of
      the Act and adjusted annually pursuant to section 117.1 of the
      Act, on the amount determined in accordance with paragraph (c) as
      if that amount represented the employee's amount taxable for that
      year,

    and deducting the aggregate of

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount determined in accordance with
      paragraph (d) multiplied by the appropriate percentage for the
      year,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} an amount equal to

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the amount determined in accordance with
        paragraph (c) multiplied by the employee's premium rate for the
        year under the [Employment Insurance Act](/eng/acts/E-5.6), not
        exceeding the maximum amount of the premiums payable by the
        employee for the year under that Act,

      multiplied by

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the appropriate percentage for the year, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} an amount equal to

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the product obtained when the difference
        between the amount determined in accordance with paragraph (c)
        and the amount determined under section 20 of the [Canada
        Pension Plan](/eng/acts/C-8) for the year is multiplied by the
        employee's contribution rate for the year under the [Canada
        Pension Plan](/eng/acts/C-8) or under a provincial pension plan
        as defined in subsection 3(1) of that Act, not exceeding the
        maximum amount of such contributions payable by the employee for
        the year under the plan,

      multiplied by

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the appropriate percentage for the year;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the amount determined in accordance with
    paragraph (e) shall be increased by, where applicable, the tax as
    determined under subsection 120(1) of the Act;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} where the amount of notional remuneration for the
    year is income earned in the Province of Quebec, the amount
    determined in accordance with paragraph (e) shall be reduced by an
    amount that is the aggregate of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amount that is deemed to be paid under
      subsection 120(2) of the Act as if there were no other source of
      income or loss for the year, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount by which the amount referred to in
      subparagraph (i) is increased by virtue of section 27 of the
      Federal-Provincial Fiscal Arrangements and Federal Post-Secondary
      Education and Health Contributions Act; and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} \[Repealed, SOR/92-667, s. 1\]

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amount to be deducted or withheld shall be
    computed by

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} dividing the amount of the notional tax for the
      year by the maximum number of pay periods for the year in respect
      of the appropriate pay period, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} rounding the amount determined under
      subparagraph (i) to the nearest multiple of five cents or, if such
      amount is equidistant from two such multiples, to the higher
      multiple.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where an employee has elected pursuant to subsection
  107(2) and has not revoked such election, the amount to be deducted or
  withheld by the employer from any payment of remuneration (in this
  subsection referred to as the [[payment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}) that is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a payment in respect of commissions or is a
    combined payment of commissions and salary or wages, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a payment in respect of salary or wages where that
    employee receives a combined payment of commissions and salary or
    wages,

  made to that employee in his taxation year where he reports for work
  at an establishment of the employer in a province, in Canada beyond
  the limits of any province or outside Canada, shall be determined for
  each payment in accordance with the following rules:

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an employee's [[estimated annual taxable
    income]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} shall be determined by using the
    formula

    ::: {#583664 .Paragraph}
    A - B

    where

    [A]{.dfn}
    :   is the amount of that employee's total remuneration in respect
        of the year as recorded by the employee on the form referred to
        in subsection 107(2), and

    [B]{.dfn}
    :   is the amount of that employee's expenses in respect of the year
        as recorded by that employee on that form;
    :::

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} if the employee is not resident in Canada at the
    time of the payment, no personal credits will be allowed for the
    purposes of this subsection and if the employee is resident in
    Canada at the time of the payment, the employee's personal credits
    for the year shall be the total claim amount as recorded by that
    employee on the return for the year referred to in subsection
    107(1);

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} an amount (in this subsection referred to as the
    [[notional tax for the year]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}) shall be
    calculated in respect of that employee by using the formula

    ::: {#583670 .Paragraph}
    C - \[(D + E + F) × G\] + H - I

    where

    [C]{.dfn}
    :   is the amount of tax payable for the year, calculated as if that
        amount of tax were computed under subsection 117(2) of the Act
        and adjusted annually pursuant to section 117.1 of the Act, on
        the amount determined under paragraph (c) as if that amount
        represented the employee's amount taxable for that year,

    [D]{.dfn}
    :   is the amount determined in accordance with paragraph (d),

    [E]{.dfn}
    :   is the amount determined in the description of A in
        paragraph (c) multiplied by the employee's premium rate for the
        year under the [Employment Insurance Act](/eng/acts/E-5.6), not
        exceeding the maximum amount of the premiums payable by the
        employee for the year under that Act,

    [F]{.dfn}
    :   is the amount determined in the description of A in
        paragraph (c) less the amount for the year determined under
        section 20 of the [Canada Pension Plan](/eng/acts/C-8)
        multiplied by the employee's contribution rate for the year
        under that Act or under a provincial pension plan as defined in
        section 3 of that Act, not exceeding the maximum amount of such
        contributions payable by the employee for the year under the
        plan,

    [G]{.dfn}
    :   is the appropriate percentage for the year,

    [H]{.dfn}
    :   is, where applicable, the tax as determined under subsection
        120(1) of the Act,

    [I]{.dfn}
    :   is, where the amount of total remuneration for the year is
        income earned in the Province of Quebec, an amount equal to the
        aggregate of
        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amount that would be deemed to have been
          paid under subsection 120(2) of the Act with respect to the
          employee if the notional tax for the year for the employee
          were determined without reference to the elements H, I and J
          in this formula and if that tax were that employee's tax
          payable under Part I of the Act for that year, as if there
          were no other source of income or loss for the year, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount by which the amount referred to
          in subparagraph (i) is increased by virtue of section 27 of
          the [Federal-Provincial Fiscal Arrangements
          Act](/eng/acts/F-7.8);
    :::

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the employee's notional rate of tax for a year is
    calculated by dividing the amount determined under paragraph (e) by
    the amount referred to in the description of A in paragraph (c) in
    respect of that employee and expressed as a decimal fraction rounded
    to the nearest hundredth, or where the third digit is equidistant
    from two consecutive one-thousandths, to the higher thereof;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the amount to be deducted or withheld in respect of
    any payment made to that employee shall be determined by multiplying
    the payment by the appropriate decimal fraction determined pursuant
    to paragraph (f).

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2001-221, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/89-508, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/81-471, s. 3\]]{.Repealed}

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsections (1) and (2), no amount
  shall be deducted or withheld in the year by an employer from a
  payment of remuneration to an employee in respect of commissions
  earned by the employee in the immediately preceding year where those
  commissions were previously reported by the employer as remuneration
  of the employee in respect of that year on an information return.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), no amount shall be deducted
  or withheld in the year by an employer from an amount determined in
  accordance with subparagraph 110(1)(f)(iii), (iv) or (v) of the Act.

### [Non-Periodic Payments]{.HTitleText2} {#h-583690 .Subheading}

- **[[103]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-103
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where a payment in respect of a
  bonus or retroactive increase in remuneration is made by an employer
  to an employee whose total remuneration from the employer (including
  the bonus or retroactive increase) may reasonably be expected not to
  exceed \$5,000 in the taxation year of the employee in which the
  payment is made, the employer shall deduct or withhold, in the case of
  an employee who reports for work at an establishment of the employer

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in any province, 10 per cent, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in Canada beyond the limits of any province or
    outside Canada, 15 per cent,

  - [(c) to (n)]{.lawlabel} \[Repealed, SOR/2001-221, s. 3\]

  of such payment in lieu of the amount determined under section 102.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where a payment in respect of a bonus is made by an
  employer to an employee whose total remuneration from the employer
  (including the bonus) may reasonably be expected to exceed \$5,000 in
  the taxation year of the employee in which the payment is made, the
  amount to be deducted or withheld therefrom by the employer is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount determined under section 102 in respect
    of an assumed remuneration equal to the aggregate of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amount of regular remuneration paid by the
      employer to the employee in the pay period in which the
      remuneration is paid, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an amount equal to the bonus payment divided by
      the number of pay periods in the taxation year of the employee in
      which the payment is made

  minus

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount determined under section 102 in respect
    of the amount of regular remuneration paid by the employer to the
    employee in the pay period

  multiplied by

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the number of pay periods in the taxation year of
    the employee in which the payment is made.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where a payment in respect of a retroactive increase
  in remuneration is made by an employer to an employee whose total
  remuneration from the employer (including the retroactive increase)
  may reasonably be expected to exceed \$5,000 in the taxation year of
  the employee in which the payment is made, the amount to be deducted
  or withheld therefrom by the employer is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount determined under section 102 in respect
    of the new rate of remuneration

  minus

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount determined under section 102 in respect
    of the previous rate of remuneration

  multiplied by

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the number of pay periods in respect of which the
    increase in remuneration is retroactive.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (4.1) and (5), where a lump
  sum payment is made by an employer to an employee who is a resident of
  Canada,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the payment does not exceed \$5,000, the
    employer shall deduct or withhold therefrom, in the case of an
    employee who reports for work at an establishment of the employer

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in Quebec, 5 per cent,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other province, 7 per cent, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} in Canada beyond the limits of any province or
      outside Canada, 10 per cent,

    - [(iv) to (xiv)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2001-221, s.
      3\]]{.Repealed}

    of such payment in lieu of the amount determined under section 102;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the payment exceeds \$5,000 but does not exceed
    \$15,000, the employer shall deduct or withhold therefrom, in the
    case of an employee who reports for work at an establishment of the
    employer

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in Quebec, 10 per cent,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other province, 13 per cent, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} in Canada beyond the limits of any province or
      outside Canada, 20 per cent,

    - [(iv) to (xiv)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2001-221, s.
      3\]]{.Repealed}

    of such payment in lieu of the amount determined under section 102;
    and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the payment exceeds \$15,000, the employer shall
    deduct or withhold therefrom, in the case of an employee who reports
    for work at an establishment of the employer

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in Quebec, 15 per cent,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other province, 20 per cent, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} in Canada beyond the limits of any province or
      outside Canada, 30 per cent,

    - [(iv) to (xiv)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2001-221, s.
      3\]]{.Repealed}

    of such payment in lieu of the amount determined under section 102.

- [(4.1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of a lump sum payment described in
  paragraph (6)(h), subsection (4) is to be read without reference to
  its paragraphs (b) and (c) and the portion of subsection (4) before
  subparagraph (a)(i) is to be read as follows:

  > ::: ReadAsText
  > - [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where a lump sum payment is made by an employer
  >   to an employee,
  >
  >   - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the employer shall deduct or withhold
  >     therefrom, in the case of an employee who reports for work at an
  >     establishment of the employer
  > :::

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Where the payment referred to in subsection (4) would
  be pension income or qualified pension income of the employee in
  respect of which subsection 118(3) of the Act would apply if the
  definition [[pension income]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 118(7)
  of the Act were read without reference to subparagraphs (a)(ii)
  and (iii) thereof, the payment shall be deemed to be the amount of the
  payment minus

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where the payment does not exceed the amount
    taxable referred to in paragraph 117(2)(a) of the Act, as adjusted
    annually pursuant to section 117.1 of the Act, the lesser of \$1,000
    and the amount of the payment;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the payment exceeds the amount referred to in
    paragraph (a) but does not exceed \$61,509, \$727;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} where the payment exceeds \$61,509 but does not
    exceed \$100,000, \$615; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} where the payment exceeds \$100,000, \$552.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (4), a [[lump sum
  payment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a payment that is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a payment described in subparagraph 40(1)(a)(i)
    or (iii) or paragraph 40(1)(c) of the [Income Tax Application
    Rules](/eng/acts/I-3.31),

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a payment under a deferred profit sharing plan or a
    plan referred to in section 147 of the Act as a [[revoked
    plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, except a payment referred to in
    subparagraph 147(2)(k)(v) of the Act,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a payment made during the lifetime of an annuitant
    referred to in the definition [[annuitant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in
    subsection 146(1) of the Act out of or under a registered retirement
    savings plan of that annuitant, other than

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a periodic annuity payment, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a payment made by a person who has reasonable
      grounds to believe that the payment may be deducted under
      subsection 146(8.2) of the Act in computing the income of any
      taxpayer,

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a payment out of or under a plan referred to in
    subsection 146(12) of the Act as an [[amended
    plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} other than

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a periodic annuity payment, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} where paragraph 146(12)(a) of the Act applied to
      the plan after May 25, 1976, a payment made in a year subsequent
      to the year in which that paragraph applied to the plan,

  - [(d.1)]{.lawlabel} a payment made during the lifetime of an
    annuitant referred to in the definition
    [[annuitant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 146.3(1) of the Act
    under a registered retirement income fund of that annuitant, other
    than a payment to the extent that it is in respect of the minimum
    amount (within the meaning assigned by subsection 146.3(1) of the
    Act) under the fund for a year,

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a retiring allowance,

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a payment of an amount as, on account or in lieu of
    payment of, or in satisfaction of, proceeds of the surrender,
    cancellation or redemption of an income-averaging annuity contract,

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a payment described in paragraph (n) of the
    definition [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection
    100(1),

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a payment made under the

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} [Canada Recovery Benefits
      Act](/eng/acts/C-10.10), or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} [Canada Worker Lockdown Benefit
      Act](/eng/acts/C-11.01), or

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a payment described in paragraph 153(1)(v) of the
    Act.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection 153(1) of the Act, the
  amount to be deducted or withheld by a person shall be 50 per cent

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} of the contribution made by the person under a
    retirement compensation arrangement, other than

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a contribution made by the person as an employee,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a contribution made to a plan or arrangement
      that is a prescribed plan or arrangement for the purposes of
      subsection 207.6(6) of the Act,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a contribution made by way of a transfer from
      another retirement compensation arrangement under circumstances in
      which subsection 207.6(7) of the Act applies, or

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a contribution that is an [[excluded
      contribution]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} (as defined in subsection
      207.5(1) of the Act); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} of the payment by the person to a resident of
    Canada of an amount on account of the purchase price of an interest
    in a retirement compensation arrangement.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} Every employer making a payment described in
  paragraph (n) of the definition [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}
  in subsection 100(1) shall withhold --- in addition to any other
  amount required to be withheld under Part I of these Regulations ---
  on account of the tax payable under Part X.5 of the Act, an amount
  equal to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where the amount is paid in the province of Quebec,
    12 per cent of the payment, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, 20 per cent of the payment.

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} The amount to be deducted or withheld by a person
  from any payment of an amount described in paragraph 56(1)(z.4) of the
  Act is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a payment to a resident of Quebec,
    30% of the payment; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a payment to a resident of Canada
    who is not a resident of Quebec, 50% of the payment.

- **[[103.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-103.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of the description
  of C in subsection (2), [[plan payment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a disability assistance payment that
    is a lifetime disability assistance payment, the total amount of all
    the lifetime disability assistance payments that have been made or
    that may reasonably be expected to be made to the employee under the
    plan in their taxation year and that the employer has reasonable
    grounds to believe are described in paragraph (o) of the definition
    [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 100(1); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a disability assistance payment that
    is other than a lifetime disability assistance payment, the amount
    of the payment that is made to the employee under the plan and that
    is described in paragraph (o) of the definition
    [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 100(1).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If an employer makes a disability assistance payment
  under a registered disability savings plan to an employee who is a
  resident of Canada, the employer shall, in lieu of the amount
  determined under section 102, deduct or withhold from the payment an
  amount determined by the formula

  ::: {#583767 .Subsection}
  (A -- B) × C

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the amount of the disability assistance payment that is made to
      the employee and that is described in paragraph (o) of the
      definition [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
      100(1);

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is
      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the beneficiary of the plan is deceased,
        nil, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount by which the total of the following
        amounts exceeds the total amount of all the disability
        assistance payments previously made to the employee in their
        taxation year and that are described in paragraph (o) of the
        definition [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
        100(1):

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amount determined for F in subsection
          118(1.1) of the Act for the taxation year, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount used under the description of B
          in subsection 118.3(1) of the Act for the taxation year; and

  [C]{.dfn}
  :   is
      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the plan payment does not exceed \$5,000 and
        the amount is paid

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in Quebec, 5 per cent,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other province, 7 per cent, or

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} in Canada beyond the limits of any province
          or outside Canada, 10 per cent,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the plan payment exceeds \$5,000 but does
        not exceed \$15,000 and the amount is paid

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in Quebec, 10 per cent,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other province, 13 per cent, or

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} in Canada beyond the limits of any province
          or outside Canada, 20 per cent, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the plan payment exceeds \$15,000 and the
        amount is paid

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in Quebec, 15 per cent,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other province, 20 per cent, or

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} in Canada beyond the limits of any province
          or outside Canada, 30 per cent.
  :::

### [Deductions not Required]{.HTitleText2} {#h-583790 .Subheading}

- **[[104]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-104
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2001-221, s.
  4\]]{.Repealed}

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No amount shall be deducted or withheld from a
  payment in accordance with any of sections 102 to 103.1 in respect of
  an employee who was neither employed nor resident in Canada at the
  time of payment except in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} remuneration described in subparagraph 115(2)(e)(i)
    of the Act that is paid to a non-resident person who has in the
    year, or had in any previous year, ceased to be resident in Canada;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} remuneration reasonably attributable to the duties
    of any office or employment performed or to be performed in Canada
    by the non-resident person.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} No amount shall be deducted or withheld from a
  payment made by a person during the lifetime of an annuitant referred
  to in paragraph (a) of the definition
  [[annuitant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 146(1) of the Act out
  of or under a registered retirement savings plan of the annuitant
  where, at the time of the payment, the annuitant has certified in
  prescribed form to the person that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a written agreement has been entered into to
    acquire a home by either

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the annuitant, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a disabled person who is related to the
      annuitant and who is entitled to the credit for mental or physical
      impairment under subsection 118.3(1) of the Act;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the annuitant intends that the home be used as a
    principal place of residence in Canada for the annuitant or the
    disabled person, as the case may be, within one year after its
    acquisition;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the home has not been previously owned by the
    annuitant, the annuitant's spouse or common-law partner, the
    disabled person or the spouse or common-law partner of that person;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the annuitant was resident in Canada;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the total amount of the payment and all other such
    payments received by the annuitant in respect of the home at or
    before the time of the payment does not exceed the dollar amount
    specified in paragraph (h) of the definition [[regular eligible
    amount]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 146.01(1) of the Act;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} except where the annuitant certifies that he or she
    is a disabled person entitled to the credit for mental or physical
    impairment under subsection 118.3(1) of the Act or certifies that
    the payment is being withdrawn for the benefit of such a disabled
    person, the annuitant is a qualifying homebuyer at the time of the
    certification; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} where the annuitant has withdrawn an eligible
    amount, within the meaning assigned by subsection 146.01(1) of the
    Act, before the calendar year of the certification, the total of all
    eligible amounts received by the annuitant before that calendar year
    does not exceed the total of all amounts previously designated under
    subsection 146.01(3) of the Act or included in computing the
    annuitant's income under subsection 146.01(4) or (5) of the Act.

- [(3.01)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (3), the annuitant
  is a qualifying homebuyer at a particular time unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the annuitant had an owner-occupied home in the
    period beginning on January 1 of the fourth calendar year preceding
    the particular time, and ending on the thirty-first day before the
    particular time; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the annuitant's spouse or common-law partner, in
    the period referred to in paragraph (a), had an owner-occupied home
    that was inhabited by the annuitant at any time during the
    annuitant's marriage to the spouse or the annuitant's common-law
    partnership with the common-law partner.

- [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (3.01), an individual
  shall be considered to have had an owner-occupied home at any time
  where the home was owned, whether jointly with another person or
  otherwise, by the individual at that time and inhabited by the
  individual as the individual's principal place of residence at that
  time.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsections (3), (3.01) and
  (3.1), [[home]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a housing unit;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a share of the capital stock of a cooperative
    housing corporation, where the holder of the share is entitled to
    possession of a housing unit; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} where the context so requires, the housing unit to
    which a share described in paragraph (b) relates.

### [Lifelong Learning Plan]{.HTitleText2} {#h-583816 .Subheading}

- **[[104.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-104.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No amount shall be deducted or
  withheld from a payment made by a person during the lifetime of an
  annuitant referred to in paragraph (a) of the definition
  [[annuitant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 146(1) of the Act out
  of or under a registered retirement savings plan of the annuitant
  where, at the time of the payment, the annuitant has certified in
  prescribed form to the person that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} at the time of certification, the annuitant or the
    annuitant's spouse or common-law partner

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is a full-time student in a qualifying
      educational program,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} is a part-time student in a qualifying
      educational program and is entitled to the credit for mental or
      physical impairment under subsection 118.3(1) of the Act, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} has received notification in writing of his or
      her entitlement, either absolutely or conditionally, to enrol
      before March of the year that follows the year of certification as

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} a full-time student in a qualifying educational
        program, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} a part-time student in a qualifying educational
        program where the annuitant or the annuitant's spouse or
        common-law partner is entitled to the credit for mental or
        physical impairment under subsection 118.3(1) of the Act;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the annuitant is resident in Canada;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the total amount of the payment and all other such
    payments received by the annuitant for a year at or before that time
    does not exceed \$10,000; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the total payments received by the annuitant do not
    exceed \$20,000 throughout the period in which the annuitant
    participates in the Lifelong Learning Plan.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (1), a [[qualifying
  educational program]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a qualifying
  educational program at a designated educational institution (as those
  expressions are defined in subsection 118.6(1) of the Act), except
  that a reference to a [[qualifying educational
  program]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} shall be read

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} without reference to paragraphs (a) and (b) of that
    definition; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} as if the reference to "3 consecutive weeks" in
    that definition were a reference to "3 consecutive months".

### [Non-Residents]{.HTitleText2} {#h-583833 .Subheading}

- **[[105]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-105
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every person paying to a
  non-resident person a fee, commission or other amount in respect of
  services rendered in Canada, of any nature whatever, shall deduct or
  withhold 15 per cent of such payment.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a payment

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} described in the definition
    [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 100(1);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} made to a registered non-resident insurer (within
    the meaning assigned by section 804); or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} made to an authorized foreign bank in respect of
    its Canadian banking business.

  text

### [Fishermen's Election]{.HTitleText2} {#h-583842 .Subheading}

- **[[105.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-105.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding section 100, in this
  section,

  [[amount of remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[amount of remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} paid to a fisherman
      means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where a boat crewed by one or more fishermen
        engaged in making a catch is owned, together with the gear, by a
        person, other than a member of the crew, to whom the catch is to
        be delivered for subsequent sale or other disposition, such
        portion of the proceeds from the disposition of the catch that
        is payable to the fisherman in accordance with an arrangement
        under which the proceeds of disposition of the catch are to be
        distributed (in this section referred to as a "share
        arrangement"),

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the boat or gear used in making a catch
        is owned or leased by a fisherman who alone or with another
        individual engaged under a contract of service makes the catch,
        such portion of the proceeds from the disposition of the catch
        that remains after deducting therefrom

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amount in respect of any portion of the
          catch not caught by the fisherman or the other individual,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount payable to the other individual
          under the contract of service, and

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the amount of such proportionate share of
          the catch as is attributable to the expenses of the operation
          of the boat or its gear pursuant to their share arrangement,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} where a crew includes the owner of the boat or
        gear (in this paragraph referred to as the
        [[owner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}) and any other fisherman engaged
        in making a catch, such portion of the proceeds from the
        disposition of the catch that remains after deducting therefrom

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an owner,

          - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the amount in respect of that portion of
            the catch not caught by the crew or an owner,

          - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of all amounts each of which
            is an amount payable to a crew member (other than the owner)
            pursuant to their share arrangement or to an individual
            engaged under a contract of service, and

          - [(C)]{.lawlabel} the amount of such proportionate share of
            the catch as is attributable to the expenses of the owner's
            operation of the boat or its gear pursuant to their share
            arrangement, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of any other crew member, such
          proceeds from the disposition of the catch as is payable to
          him in accordance with their share arrangement, or

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, the proceeds of disposition
        of the catch payable to the fisherman; ([montant de
        rémunération]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[catch]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[catch]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a catch of shell fish,
      crustaceans, aquatic animals or marine plants caught or taken from
      any body of water; ([pêche]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[crew]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[crew]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means one or more fishermen engaged
      in making a catch; ([équipe]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[fisherman]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fisherman]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an individual engaged in
      making a catch other than under a contract of
      service. ([pêcheur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every person paying at any time in a taxation year an
  amount of remuneration to a fisherman who, pursuant to paragraph
  153(1)(n) of the Act, has elected for the year in prescribed form in
  respect of all such amounts shall deduct or withhold 20% of each such
  amount paid to the fisherman while the election is in force.

### [Variations in Deductions]{.HTitleText2} {#h-583864 .Subheading}

- **[[106]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-106
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where an employer makes a payment of
  remuneration to an employee in his taxation year

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for a period for which no provision is made in
    Schedule I, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for a pay period referred to in Schedule I in an
    amount that is greater than any amount provided for therein,

  - [(c) and (d)]{.lawlabel} \[Repealed, SOR/2001-221, s. 5\]

  the amount to be deducted or withheld by the employer from any such
  payment is that proportion of the payment that the tax that may
  reasonably be expected to be payable under the Act by the employee
  with respect to the aggregate of all remuneration that may reasonably
  be expected to be paid by the employer to the employee in respect of
  that taxation year is of such aggregate.

- [(2) and (3)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/84-913, s. 3\]]{.Repealed}

### [Employee's Returns]{.HTitleText2} {#h-583874 .Subheading}

- **[[107]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-107 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  return required to be filed by an employee under subsection 227(2) of
  the Act shall be filed by the employee with the employer when the
  employee commences employment with that employer and a new return
  shall be filed thereunder within 7 days after the date on which a
  change occurs that may reasonably be expected to result in a change in
  the employee's personal credits for the year.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (1), where, in a year, an
  employee receives payments in respect of commissions or in respect of
  commissions and salary or wages, and the employee elects to file a
  prescribed form for the year in addition to the return referred to in
  that subsection, that form shall be filed with the employee's
  continuing employer on or before January 31 of that year and, where
  applicable, within one month after the employee commences employment
  with a new employer or within one month after the date on which a
  change occurs that may reasonably be expected to result in a
  substantial change in the employee's estimated total remuneration for
  the year or estimated deductions for the year.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where, in a taxation year, an employee has elected to
  file the prescribed form referred to in subsection (2) and has filed
  such form with his employer, the employee may at any time thereafter
  in the year revoke that election and such revocation is effective from
  the date that he notifies his employer in writing of his intention.

### [Remittances to Receiver General]{.HTitleText2} {#h-583881 .Subheading}

- **[[108]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-108
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (1.1) to
  (1.13), amounts deducted or withheld in a month under subsection
  153(1) of the Act shall be remitted to the Receiver General on or
  before the 15th day of the following month.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (1.11), where the average
  monthly withholding amount of an employer for the second calendar year
  preceding a particular calendar year is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} equal to or greater than \$25,000 and less than
    \$100,000, all amounts deducted or withheld from payments described
    in the definition [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
    100(1) that are made in a month in the particular calendar year by
    the employer shall be remitted to the Receiver General

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in respect of payments made before the 16th day
      of the month, on or before the 25th day of the month, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in respect of payments made after the 15th day
      of the month, on or before the 10th day of the following month; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} equal to or greater than \$100,000, all amounts
    deducted or withheld from payments described in the definition
    [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 100(1) that are
    made in a month in the particular calendar year by the employer
    shall be remitted to the Receiver General on or before the third
    day, not including a Saturday or holiday, after the end of the
    following periods in which the payments were made,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the period beginning on the first day and ending
      on the 7th day of the month,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the period beginning on the 8th day and ending
      on the 14th day of the month,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the period beginning on the 15th day and ending
      on the 21st day of the month, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the period beginning on the 22nd day and ending
      on the last day of the month.

- [(1.11)]{.lawlabel} Where an employer referred to in paragraph
  (1.1)(a) or (b) would otherwise be required to remit in accordance
  with that paragraph the amounts withheld or deducted under subsection
  153(1) of the Act in respect of a particular calendar year, the
  employer may elect to remit those amounts

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in accordance with subsection (1), if the average
    monthly withholding amount of the employer for the calendar year
    preceding the particular calendar year is less than \$25,000 and the
    employer has advised the Minister that the employer has so elected;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the average monthly withholding amount of the
    employer for the calendar year preceding the particular calendar
    year is equal to or greater than \$25,000 and less than \$100,000
    and the employer has advised the Minister that the employer has so
    elected,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in respect of payments made before the 16th day
      of a month in the particular calendar year, on or before the 25th
      day of the month, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in respect of payments made after the 15th day
      of a month in particular calendar year, on or before the 10th day
      of the following month.

- [(1.12)]{.lawlabel} If at any time

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the average monthly withholding amount in respect
    of an employer for either the first or the second calendar year
    before the particular calendar year that includes that time is less
    than \$3,000,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} throughout the 12-month period before that time,
    the employer has remitted, on or before the day on or before which
    the amounts were required to be remitted, all amounts each of which
    was required to be remitted under subsection 153(1) of the Act,
    under subsection 21(1) of the [Canada Pension Plan](/eng/acts/C-8),
    under subsection 82(1) of the [Employment Insurance
    Act](/eng/acts/E-5.6) or under Part IX of the [Excise Tax
    Act](/eng/acts/E-15), and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} throughout the 12-month period before that time,
    the employer has filed all returns each of which was required to be
    filed under this Act or Part IX of the [Excise Tax
    Act](/eng/acts/E-15) on or before the day on or before which those
    returns were required to be filed under those Acts,

  all amounts deducted or withheld from payments described in the
  definition [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 100(1)
  that are made by the employer in a month that ends after that time and
  that is in the particular calendar year may be remitted to the
  Receiver General

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in respect of such payments made in January,
    February and March of the particular calendar year, on or before the
    15th day of April of the particular year,

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} in respect of such payments made in April, May and
    June of the particular calendar year, on or before the 15th day of
    July of the particular year,

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} in respect of such payments made in July, August
    and September of the particular calendar year, on or before the 15th
    day of October of the particular year, and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} in respect of such payments made in October,
    November and December of the particular calendar year, on or before
    the 15th day of January of the year following the particular year.

- [(1.13)]{.lawlabel} If an employer is a new employer throughout a
  particular month in a particular calendar year, all amounts deducted
  or withheld from payments described in the definition
  [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 100(1) that are
  made by the employer in the month may be remitted to the Receiver
  General

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of such payments made in January,
    February and March of the particular calendar year, on or before the
    15th day of April of the particular calendar year;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of such payments made in April, May and
    June of the particular calendar year, on or before the 15th day of
    July of the particular calendar year;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in respect of such payments made in July, August
    and September of the particular calendar year, on or before the 15th
    day of October of the particular calendar year; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in respect of such payments made in October,
    November and December of the particular calendar year, on or before
    the 15th day of January of the year following the particular
    calendar year.

- [(1.2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, average monthly
  withholding amount, in respect of an employer for a particular
  calendar year, is the quotient obtained when

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of all amounts each of which is an
    amount required to be remitted with respect to the particular year
    under

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} subsection 153(1) of the Act and a similar
      provision of a law of a province which imposes a tax upon the
      income of individuals, where the province has entered into an
      agreement with the Minister of Finance for the collection of taxes
      payable to the province, in respect of payments described in the
      definition [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
      100(1),

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} subsection 21(1) of the [Canada Pension
      Plan](/eng/acts/C-8), or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} subsection 82(1) of the [Employment Insurance
      Act](/eng/acts/E-5.6),

    by the employer or, where the employer is a corporation, by each
    corporation associated with the corporation in a taxation year of
    the employer ending in the second calendar year following the
    particular year

  is divided by

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the number of months in the particular year, not
    exceeding twelve, for which such amounts were required to be
    remitted by the employer and, where the employer is a corporation,
    by each corporation associated with it in a taxation year of the
    employer ending in the second calendar year following the particular
    year.

- [(1.21)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1.4), the monthly
  withholding amount, in respect of an employer for a month, is the
  total of all amounts each of which is an amount required to be
  remitted with respect to the month by the employer or, if the employer
  is a corporation, by each corporation associated with the corporation,
  under

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} subsection 153(1) of the Act and a similar
    provision of a law of a province which imposes a tax upon the income
    of individuals, if the province has entered into an agreement with
    the Minister of Finance for the collection of taxes payable to the
    province, in respect of payments described in the definition
    [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 100(1);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subsection 21(1) of the [Canada Pension
    Plan](/eng/acts/C-8); or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} subsection 82(1) of the [Employment Insurance
    Act](/eng/acts/E-5.6).

- [(1.3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1.2), where a
  particular employer that is a corporation has acquired in a taxation
  year of the corporation ending in a particular calendar year all or
  substantially all of the property of another employer used by the
  other employer in a business

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in a transaction in respect of which an election
    was made under subsection 85(1) or (2) of the Act,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} by virtue of an amalgamation within the meaning
    assigned to that term by section 87 of the Act, or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} as the result of a winding-up in respect of which
    subsection 88(1) of the Act is applicable,

  the other employer shall be deemed to be a corporation associated with
  the particular employer in the taxation year and each taxation year
  ending at any time in the next two following calendar years.

- [(1.4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1.13) an employer

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} becomes a new employer at the beginning of any
    month after 2015 in which the employer first becomes an employer;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} ceases to be a new employer at a specified time in
    a particular year, if in a particular month the employer does not
    meet any of the following conditions:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the monthly withholding amount in respect of the
      employer for the particular month is less than \$1,000,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} throughout the 12-month period before that time,
      the employer has remitted, on or before the day on or before which
      the amounts were required to be remitted, all amounts each of
      which was required to be remitted under subsection 153(1) of the
      Act, subsection 21(1) of the [Canada Pension Plan](/eng/acts/C-8),
      subsection 82(1) of the [Employment Insurance
      Act](/eng/acts/E-5.6) or Part IX of the [Excise Tax
      Act](/eng/acts/E-15), and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} throughout the 12-month period before that
      time, the employer has filed all returns each of which was
      required to be filed under the Act or Part IX of the [Excise Tax
      Act](/eng/acts/E-15) on or before the day on or before which those
      returns were required to be filed under those Acts.

- [(1.41)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1.4), the
  specified time is the end of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} March of the particular year, if the particular
    month is January, February or March of that year;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} June of the particular year, if the particular
    month is April, May or June of that year;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} September of the particular year, if the particular
    month is July, August or September of that year; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} December of the particular year, if the particular
    month is October, November or December of that year.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where an employer has ceased to carry on business,
  any amount deducted or withheld under subsection 153(1) of the Act
  that has not been remitted to the Receiver General shall be paid
  within 7 days of the day when the employer ceased to carry on
  business.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Remittances made to the Receiver General under
  subsection 153(1) of the Act shall be accompanied by a return in
  prescribed form.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Amounts deducted or withheld under subsection 153(4)
  of the Act shall be remitted to the Receiver General within 60 days
  after the end of the taxation year subsequent to the 12-month period
  referred to in that subsection.

### [Elections To Increase Deductions]{.HTitleText2} {#h-583945 .Subheading}

- **[[109]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-109 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Any
  election under subsection 153(1.2) of the Act shall be made by filing
  with the person making the payment or class of payments referred to
  therein (in this section referred to as the
  [[payer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}) the form prescribed by the Minister for
  that purpose.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A taxpayer who has made an election in the manner
  prescribed by subsection (1) may require that the amount deducted or
  withheld pursuant to that election be varied by filing with the payer
  the form prescribed by the Minister for that purpose.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} An election made in the manner prescribed by
  subsection (1) or a variation made pursuant to subsection (2) need not
  be taken into account by the payer in respect of the first payment to
  be made to the taxpayer after the election or variation, as the case
  may be, unless the election or variation, as the case may be, is made
  within such time, in advance of the payment, as may reasonably be
  required by the payer.

### [Prescribed Persons]{.HTitleText2} {#h-583950 .Subheading}

- **[[110]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-110 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  following are prescribed persons for the purposes of subsection 153(1)
  of the Act:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an employer who is required, under subsection
    153(1) of the Act and in accordance with paragraph 108(1.1)(b), to
    remit amounts deducted or withheld; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a person or partnership who, acting on behalf of
    one or more employers, remits the following amounts in a particular
    calendar year and whose average monthly remittance, in respect of
    those amounts, for the second calendar year preceding the particular
    calendar year, is equal to or greater than \$50,000,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} amounts required to be remitted under subsection
      153(1) of the Act and a similar provision of a law of a province
      that imposes a tax on the income of individuals, where the
      province has entered into an agreement with the Minister of
      Finance for the collection of taxes payable to the province, in
      respect of payments described in the definition
      [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 100(1),

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} amounts required to be remitted under subsection
      21(1) of the [Canada Pension Plan](/eng/acts/C-8), and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} amounts required to be remitted under
      subsection 82(1) of the [Employment Insurance
      Act](/eng/acts/E-5.6) or subsection 53(1) of the Unemployment
      Insurance Act.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraph (1)(b), the average
  monthly remittance made by a person or partnership on behalf of all
  the employers for whom that person or partnership is acting, for the
  second calendar year preceding the particular calendar year, is the
  quotient obtained when the aggregate, for that preceding year, of all
  amounts referred to in subparagraphs (1)(b)(i) to (iii) remitted by
  the person or partnership on behalf of those employers is divided by
  the number of months, in that preceding year, for which the person or
  partnership remitted those amounts.

- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]

:::

### [Deemed Remittance]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1247438 .Subheading}

**[[111]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-111 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 153(1.02) of the Act

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} \$25,000 is the amount prescribed for the purpose of
  the description of A in paragraph 153(1.02)(a) of the Act;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} 10%, or a lower percentage elected by the [[eligible
  employer]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined in subsection 153(1.03),
  is the percentage prescribed for the purpose of the description of C
  in paragraph 153(1.02)(b) of the Act; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} \$1,375 is the amount prescribed for the purpose of
  the description of E in paragraph 153(1.02)(c) of the Act.

## [PART II]{.HLabel1}[Information Returns]{.HTitleText1} {#h-583961 .Part}

### [Remuneration and Benefits]{.HTitleText2} {#h-583962 .Subheading}

- **[[200]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-200
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (1.1), every
  person who makes a payment described in subsection 153(1) of the Act
  (including an amount paid that is described in subparagraph
  153(1)(a)(ii) of the Act) shall make an information return in
  prescribed form in respect of the payment unless an information return
  in respect of the payment has been made under sections 202, 214, 237
  or 238.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an annuity payment in respect of an interest in an
    annuity contract to which subsection 201(5) applies; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an amount paid by a qualifying non-resident
    employer to a qualifying non-resident employee that is exempted
    under subparagraph 153(1)(a)(ii) of the Act if the employer, after
    reasonable inquiry, has no reason to believe that the employee's
    total amount of taxable income earned in Canada under Part I of the
    Act during the calendar year that includes the time of this payment
    (including an amount described in paragraph 110(1)(f) of the Act) is
    more than \$10,000.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every person who makes a payment as or on account of,
  or who confers a benefit or allocates an amount that is,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a scholarship, fellowship or bursary, or a prize
    for achievement in a field of endeavour ordinarily carried on by the
    recipient thereof (other than a prize prescribed by section 7700),

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a grant to enable the recipient thereof to carry on
    research or any similar work,

  - [(b.1)]{.lawlabel} an amount that is required by paragraph
    56(1)(n.1) of the Act to be included in computing a taxpayer's
    income,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an amount that is required by paragraph 56(1)(r) of
    the Act to be included in computing a taxpayer's income,

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a benefit under regulations made under an
    appropriation Act providing for a scheme of transitional assistance
    benefits to persons employed in the production of products to which
    the Canada-United States Agreement on Automotive Products, signed on
    January 16, 1965, applies,

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a benefit described in section 5502,

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} an amount payable to a taxpayer on a periodic basis
    in respect of the loss of all or any part of his income from an
    office or employment, pursuant to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a sickness or accident insurance plan,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a disability insurance plan, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} an income maintenance insurance plan,

    to or under which his employer has made a contribution,

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} an amount or benefit the value of which is required
    by paragraph 6(1)(a), (e) or (h) or subsection 6(9) of the Act to be
    included in computing a taxpayer's income from an office or
    employment, other than a payment referred to in subsection (1),

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a benefit the amount of which is required by virtue
    of subsection 15(5) of the Act to be included in computing a
    shareholder's income,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a benefit deemed by subsection 15(9) of the Act to
    be a benefit conferred on a shareholder by a corporation, or

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a payment out of a registered education savings
    plan, other than a refund of payments,

  shall make an information return in prescribed form in respect of such
  payment or benefit except where subsection (3) or (4) applies with
  respect to the payment or benefit.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where a benefit is included in computing a taxpayer's
  income from an office or employment pursuant to paragraph 6(1)(a)
  or (e) of the Act in respect of an automobile made available to the
  taxpayer or to a person related to the taxpayer by a person related to
  the taxpayer's employer, the employer shall make an information return
  in prescribed form in respect of the benefit.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where a benefit is included in computing the income
  of a shareholder of a corporation by virtue of subsection 15(5) of the
  Act in respect of an automobile made available to the shareholder or
  to a person related to the shareholder by a person related to the
  corporation, the corporation shall make an information return in
  prescribed form in respect of the benefit.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Where a particular qualifying person (within the
  meaning assigned by subsection 7(7) of the Act) has agreed to sell or
  issue a security (within the meaning assigned by that subsection) of
  the particular qualifying person (or of a qualifying person with which
  it does not deal at arm's length) to a taxpayer who is an employee of
  the particular qualifying person (or of a qualifying person with which
  it does not deal at arm's length) and the taxpayer has acquired the
  security under the agreement in circumstances to which subsection 7(8)
  of the Act applied, each of the particular qualifying person, the
  qualifying person of which the security is acquired and the qualifying
  person which is the taxpayer's employer shall, for the particular
  taxation year in which the security is acquired, make an information
  return in the prescribed form in respect of the benefit from
  employment that the taxpayer would be deemed to have received in the
  particular taxation year in respect of the acquisition of the security
  if the Act were read without reference to subsection 7(8) and, for
  this purpose, an information return made by one of the qualifying
  persons in respect of the taxpayer's acquisition of the security is
  deemed to have been made by each of the qualifying persons.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Every person who makes a payment as or on account of
  an amount that is required by subsection 56(6) of the Act to be
  included in computing a taxpayer's income shall make an information
  return in prescribed form in respect of that payment.
