          and picture editing (other than remuneration paid or payable
          to or in respect of persons referred to in subparagraphs
          (i), (ii) and (iii)), was incurred in respect of services
          rendered in Canada, and

        - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the copyright protecting its use in Canada is
          beneficially owned

          - [(A)]{.lawlabel} by a person who is either a Canadian or a
            corporation incorporated under the laws of Canada or a
            province, or

          - [(B)]{.lawlabel} jointly or otherwise by two or more persons
            described in clause (A),

      other than a film

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} acquired after the day that is the earlier of

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the day of its first commercial use, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} 12 months after the day the principal
          photography thereof is completed, or

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in respect of which certification under this
        definition has been revoked by the Minister of Communications as
        provided in paragraph (10)(b); ([long métrage portant
        visa]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[certified production]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[certified production]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a
      particular taxation year, means a motion picture film or video
      tape certified by the Minister of Communications to be a film or
      tape in respect of which all photography, taping or art work
      required specifically for the production thereof and all film or
      tape editing therefor were commenced after May 25, 1976, certified
      by him to be a film or tape in respect of which the principal
      photography or taping thereof was commenced before the end of the
      particular taxation year or was completed no later than 60 days
      after the end of that year and certified by him to be

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a film or tape the production of which is
        contemplated in a coproduction agreement entered into between
        Canada and another country, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a film or tape in respect of which

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the individual who performed the duties of
          producer was a Canadian,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the Minister of Communications has allotted
          not less than an aggregate of six units of production, not
          less than two of which were allotted by virtue of clause (A)
          or (B) and not less than one of which was allotted by virtue
          of clause (C) or (D), for individuals who provided services in
          respect of the film or tape, in the following manner:

          - [(A)]{.lawlabel} for the director, two units of production,

          - [(B)]{.lawlabel} for the screenwriter, two units of
            production,

          - [(C)]{.lawlabel} for the actor or actress in respect of
            whose services for the film or tape the highest remuneration
            was paid or payable (unless in the opinion of the Minister
            of Communications the individual did not perform a major
            role in the film or tape), one unit of production,

          - [(D)]{.lawlabel} for the actor or actress in respect of
            whose services for the film or tape the second highest
            remuneration was paid or payable (unless in the opinion of
            the Minister of Communications the individual did not
            perform a major role in the film or tape), one unit of
            production,

          - [(E)]{.lawlabel} for the art director, one unit of
            production,

          - [(F)]{.lawlabel} for the director of photography, one unit
            of production,

          - [(G)]{.lawlabel} for the music composer, one unit of
            production, and

          - [(H)]{.lawlabel} for the picture editor, one unit of
            production,

          shall be allotted, provided the individual in respect of such
          allotment was a Canadian,

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} not less than 75 per cent of the aggregate
          of all costs (other than costs determined by reference to the
          amount of income from the film or tape) paid or payable to
          persons for services provided in respect of producing the film
          or tape (other than remuneration paid or payable to, or in
          respect of, individuals referred to in subparagraph (i) or
          (ii), costs referred to in subparagraph (iv) incurred for
          processing and final preparation of the film or tape, and
          amounts paid or payable in respect of insurance, financing,
          brokerage, legal and accounting fees and similar amounts) was
          paid or payable to, or in respect of services provided by,
          Canadians, and

        - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} not less than 75 per cent of the aggregate
          of all costs (other than costs determined by reference to the
          amount of income from the film or tape) incurred for
          processing and final preparation of the film or tape,
          including laboratory work, sound re-recording, sound editing
          and picture editing (other than remuneration paid or payable
          to, or in respect of, individuals referred to in
          subparagraph (i) or (ii)) was incurred in respect of services
          provided in Canada,

      other than a film or tape

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} acquired after the day that is the earlier of

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the day of its first commercial use, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} 12 months after the day the principal
          photography or taping thereof is completed,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} acquired by a taxpayer who has not paid in
        cash, as of the end of the particular taxation year, to the
        person from whom he acquired the film or tape, at least 5 per
        cent of the capital cost to the taxpayer of the film or tape as
        of the end of the year,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} acquired by a taxpayer who has issued in
        payment or part payment thereof, a bond, debenture, bill, note,
        mortgage or similar obligation in respect of which an amount is
        not due until a time that is more than four years after the end
        of the taxation year in which the taxpayer acquired the film or
        tape,

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} acquired from a non-resident, or

      - [(g)]{.lawlabel} in respect of which certification under this
        definition has been revoked by the Minister of Communications as
        provided in paragraph (10)(b),

      and, for the purposes of the application of this definition,

      - [(h)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a film or tape acquired in 1987,
        other than a film or tape in respect of which paragraph (i)
        applies, the reference in this definition to "commenced before
        the end of the particular taxation year or was completed no
        later than 60 days after the end of that year" shall be read as
        a reference to "commenced before the end of 1987 or was
        completed before July, 1988"; and

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a film or tape acquired in 1987
        or 1988 that is included in paragraph (n) of Class 12 in
        Schedule II and that is part of a series of films or tapes that
        includes another property included in that paragraph, the
        reference in this definition to "commenced before the end of the
        particular taxation year or was completed no later than 60 days
        after the end of that year" shall be read as a reference to
        "completed before 1989"; ([production portant
        visa]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[certified short production]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[certified short production]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/86-254, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

  [[completion]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[completion]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a specified development
      phase of a taxpayer's oil sands project means the first attainment
      of a level of average output, attributable to the specified
      development phase and measured over a sixty day period, equal to
      at least 60% of the planned level of average daily output (as
      determined in paragraph (b) of the definition [[specified
      development phase]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}) in respect of that
      phase; ([achèvement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[computer software]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[computer software]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes systems
      software and a right or licence to use computer
      software; ([logiciel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[data network infrastructure equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[data network infrastructure
      equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means network infrastructure
      equipment that controls, transfers, modulates or directs data, and
      that operates in support of telecommunications applications such
      as e-mail, instant messaging, audio- and video-over-Internet
      Protocol or Web browsing, Web searching and Web hosting, including
      data switches, multiplexers, routers, remote access servers, hubs,
      domain name servers, and modems, but does not include

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} network equipment (other than radio network
        equipment) that operates in support of telecommunications
        applications, if the bandwidth made available by that equipment
        to a single end-user of the network is 64 kilobits per second or
        less in either direction,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} radio network equipment that operates in
        support of wireless telecommunications applications unless the
        equipment supports digital transmission on a radio channel,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} network equipment that operates in support of
        broadcast telecommunications applications and that is
        unidirectional,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} network equipment that is end-user equipment,
        including telephone sets, personal digital assistants and
        facsimile transmission devices,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} equipment that is described in paragraph (f.2)
        or (v) of Class 10, or in any of Classes 45, 50 and 52, in
        Schedule II,

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} wires or cables, or similar property, and

      - [(g)]{.lawlabel} structures; ([matériel d'infrastructure pour
        réseaux de données]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[designated asset]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[designated asset]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in respect of a
      development phase of a taxpayer's oil sands project, means a
      property that is a building, a structure, machinery or equipment
      and is, or is an integral and substantial part of,

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a bitumen development phase,

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a crusher,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a froth treatment plant,

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a primary separation unit,

        - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a steam generation plant,

        - [(v)]{.lawlabel} a cogeneration plant, or

        - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} a water treatment plant, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an upgrading development phase,

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a gasifier unit,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a vacuum distillation unit,

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a hydrocracker unit,

        - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a hydrotreater unit,

        - [(v)]{.lawlabel} a hydroprocessor unit, or

        - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} a coker; ([bien désigné]{.DefinedTermLink
          lang="fr"})

  [[designated overburden removal cost]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[designated overburden removal cost]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a
      taxpayer means any cost incurred by him in respect of clearing or
      removing overburden from a mine in Canada owned or operated by him
      where the cost

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} was incurred after November 16, 1978 and before
        1988,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} was incurred after the mine came into
        production in reasonable commercial quantities,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} as of the end of the taxation year in which the
        cost was incurred, has not been deducted by the taxpayer in
        computing his income, and

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} is not deductible, in whole or in part, by the
        taxpayer in computing his income for a taxation year subsequent
        to the taxation year in which the cost was incurred, other than
        by virtue of paragraph 20(1)(a) of the Act; ([coût désigné
        d'enlèvement des terrains de couverture]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[designated underground storage cost]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[designated underground storage cost]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a
      taxpayer means any cost incurred by him after December 11, 1979 in
      respect of developing a well, mine or other similar underground
      property for the storage in Canada of petroleum, natural gas or
      other related hydrocarbons; ([coût désigné de stockage
      souterrain]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[development phase]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[development phase]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a taxpayer's oil
      sands project means the acquisition, construction, fabrication or
      installation of a group of assets, by or on behalf of the
      taxpayer, that may reasonably be considered to constitute a
      discrete expansion in the capacity of the oil sands project when
      complete (including, for greater certainty, the initiation of a
      new oil sands project); ([phase de mise en
      valeur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[eligible liquefaction building]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[eligible liquefaction building]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a
      taxpayer, in respect of an eligible liquefaction facility of the
      taxpayer, means property (other than property that has been used
      or acquired for use for any purpose before it was acquired by the
      taxpayer or a residential building ) acquired by the taxpayer
      after February 19, 2015 and before 2025 that is included in Class
      1 in Schedule II because of paragraph (q) of that Class and that
      is used as part of the eligible liquefaction facility; ([bâtiment
      de liquéfaction admissible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[eligible liquefaction equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[eligible liquefaction equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in respect
      of an eligible liquefaction facility of a taxpayer, means property
      of the taxpayer that is used in connection with the liquefaction
      of natural gas and that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is acquired by the taxpayer after February 19,
        2015 and before 2025,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is included in Class 47 in Schedule II because
        of paragraph (b) of that Class,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} has not been used or acquired for use for any
        purpose before it was acquired by the taxpayer,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} is not excluded equipment, and

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} is used as part of the eligible liquefaction
        facility; ([matériel de liquéfaction
        admissible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[eligible liquefaction facility]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[eligible liquefaction facility]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a
      taxpayer means a self-contained system located in Canada ---
      including buildings, structures and equipment --- that is used or
      intended to be used by the taxpayer for the purpose of liquefying
      natural gas; ([installation de liquéfaction
      admissible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[eligible mine development property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[eligible mine development property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      property acquired by a taxpayer after March 20, 2013 and before
      2018 for the purpose of gaining or producing income

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} from a new mine or an expansion of a mine, if
        the property was acquired under a written agreement entered into
        by the taxpayer before March 21, 2013,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} from a new mine, if

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the construction of the new mine was started
          by, or on behalf of, the taxpayer before March 21, 2013 (and
          for this purpose construction does not include obtaining
          permits or regulatory approvals, conducting environmental
          assessments, community consultations or impact benefit
          studies, and similar activities), or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the engineering and design work for the
          construction of the new mine, as evidenced in writing, was
          started by, or on behalf of, the taxpayer before March 21,
          2013 (and for this purpose engineering and design work does
          not include obtaining permits or regulatory approvals,
          conducting environmental assessments, community consultations
          or impact benefit studies, and similar activities), or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} from an expansion of a mine, if

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the construction for the expansion of the
          mine was started by, or on behalf of, the taxpayer before
          March 21, 2013 (and for this purpose construction does not
          include obtaining permits or regulatory approvals, conducting
          environmental assessments, community consultations or impact
          benefit studies, and similar activities), or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the engineering and design work for the
          construction of the expansion of the mine, as evidenced in
          writing, was started by, or on behalf of, the taxpayer before
          March 21, 2013 (and for this purpose engineering and design
          work does not include obtaining permits or regulatory
          approvals, conducting environmental assessments, community
          consultations or impact benefit studies, and similar
          activities); ([bien admissible à l'aménagement d'une
          mine]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[eligible non-residential building]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[eligible non-residential building]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      taxpayer's building (other than a building that was used, or
      acquired for use, by any person or partnership before March
      19, 2007) that is located in Canada, that is included in Class 1
      in Schedule II and that is acquired by the taxpayer on or after
      March 19, 2007 to be used by the taxpayer, or a lessee of the
      taxpayer, for a non-residential use; ([bâtiment non résidentiel
      admissible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[excluded equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[excluded equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} pipelines (other than pipelines used to move
        natural gas, or its components that are extracted, within an
        eligible liquefaction facility during the liquefaction process
        or used to move liquefied natural gas),

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} equipment used exclusively to regasify
        liquefied natural gas, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} electrical generation equipment; ([matériel non
        admissible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[gas or oil well equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[gas or oil well equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} equipment, structures and pipelines, other than
        a well casing, acquired to be used in a gas or oil field in the
        production therefrom of natural gas or crude oil, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a pipeline acquired to be used solely for
        transmitting gas to a natural gas processing plant,

      but does not include

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} equipment or structures acquired for the
        refining of oil or the processing of natural gas including the
        separation therefrom of liquid hydrocarbons, sulphur or other
        joint products or by-products, or

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a pipeline for removal or for collection for
        immediate removal of natural gas or crude oil from a gas or oil
        field except a pipeline referred to in paragraph (b); ([matériel
        de puits de gaz ou de pétrole]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[general-purpose electronic data processing equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[general-purpose electronic data processing
      equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means electronic equipment that,
      in its operation, requires an internally stored computer program
      that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is executed by the equipment,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} can be altered by the user of the equipment,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} instructs the equipment to read and select,
        alter or store data from an external medium such as a card, disk
        or tape, and

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} depends upon the characteristics of the data
        being processed to determine the sequence of its
        execution; ([matériel électronique universel de traitement de
        l'information]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[oil sands project]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[oil sands project]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a taxpayer means an
      undertaking by the taxpayer for the extraction of tar sands from a
      mineral resource owned by the taxpayer, which undertaking may
      include the processing of the tar sands to a stage that is not
      beyond the crude oil stage or its equivalent; ([projet de sables
      bitumineux]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[oil sands property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[oil sands property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a taxpayer means
      property acquired by the taxpayer for the purpose of earning
      income from an oil sands project of the taxpayer; ([bien de sables
      bitumineux]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[ore]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ore]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes ore from a mineral resource
      that has been processed to any stage that is prior to the prime
      metal stage or its equivalent; ([minerai]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[preliminary work activity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[preliminary work activity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means activity
      that is preliminary to the acquisition, construction, fabrication
      or installation by or on behalf of a taxpayer of designated assets
      in respect of the taxpayer's oil sands project including, without
      limiting the generality of the foregoing, the following
      activities:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} obtaining permits or regulatory approvals,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} performing design or engineering work,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} conducting feasibility studies,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} conducting environmental assessments,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} clearing or excavating land,

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} building roads, and

      - [(g)]{.lawlabel} entering into contracts; ([travaux
        préliminaires]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[railway system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[railway system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes a railway owned or
      operated by a common carrier, together with all buildings, rolling
      stock, equipment and other properties pertaining thereto, but does
      not include a tramway; ([réseau de chemin de fer]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[specified development phase]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specified development phase]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a
      taxpayer's oil sands project means a bitumen development phase or
      an upgrading development phase of the oil sands project which can
      reasonably be expected to result in a planned level of average
      daily output (where that output is bitumen or a similar product in
      the case of a bitumen development phase, or synthetic crude oil or
      a similar product in the case of an upgrading development phase),
      and in respect of which phase,

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} not including any preliminary work activity,
        one or more designated assets was, before March 19, 2007,

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} acquired by the taxpayer, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the process of being constructed,
          fabricated or installed, by or on behalf of the taxpayer, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the planned level of average daily output is
        the lesser of,

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the level that was the demonstrated intention
          of the taxpayer as of March 19, 2007 to produce from the
          specified development phase, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the maximum level of output associated with
          the design capacity, as of March 19, 2007, of the designated
          asset referred to in paragraph (a); ([phase de mise en valeur
          déterminée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[specified oil sands property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specified oil sands property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a taxpayer
      means oil sands property, acquired by the taxpayer before 2012,
      the taxpayer's use of which is reasonably required

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for a specified development phase of an oil
        sands project of the taxpayer to reach completion; or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} as part of a bitumen development phase of an
        oil sands project of the taxpayer,

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} to the extent that the output from the
          bitumen development phase is required for an upgrading
          development phase that is a specified development phase of the
          oil sands project to reach completion, and it is reasonable to
          conclude that all or substantially all of the output from the
          bitumen development phase will be so used; and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} where it was the demonstrated intention of
          the taxpayer as of March 19, 2007 to produce, from a mineral
          resource owned by the taxpayer, the bitumen feedstock required
          for the upgrading development phase to reach
          completion; ([bien de sables bitumineux
          déterminé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[specified temporary access road]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specified temporary access road]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a temporary access road to an oil or gas well
        in Canada, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a temporary access road the cost of which
        would, if the definition [[Canadian exploration
        expense]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection 66.1(6) of the Act
        were read without reference to paragraphs (k.1) and (l) of that
        definition, be a Canadian exploration expense because of
        paragraph (f) or (g) of that definition; ([route d'accès
        temporaire déterminée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[systems software]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[systems software]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a combination of
      computer programs and associated procedures, related technical
      documentation and data that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} performs compilation, assembly, mapping,
        management or processing of other programs,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} facilitates the functioning of a computer
        system by other programs,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} provides service or utility functions such as
        media conversion, sorting, merging, system accounting,
        performance measurement, system diagnostics or programming aids,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} provides general support functions such as data
        management, report generation or security control, or

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} provides general capability to meet widespread
        categories of problem solving or processing requirements where
        the specific attributes of the work to be performed are
        introduced mainly in the form of parameters, constants or
        descriptors rather than in program logic,

      and includes a right or licence to use such a combination of
      computer programs and associated procedures, related technical
      documentation and data; ([logiciel
      d'exploitation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[tar sands ore]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[tar sands ore]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means ore extracted from a
      deposit of bituminous sands or oil shales; ([minerai de sables
      asphaltiques]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[telegraph system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[telegraph system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes the buildings,
      structures, general plant and communication and other equipment
      pertaining thereto; ([réseau de télégraphe]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[telephone system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[telephone system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes the buildings,
      structures, general plant and communication and other equipment
      pertaining thereto; ([réseau de téléphone]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[television commercial message]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[television commercial message]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      commercial message as defined in the [Television Broadcasting
      Regulations, 1987](/eng/regulations/SOR-87-49) made under the
      [Broadcasting Act](/eng/acts/B-9.01); ([message publicitaire pour
      la télévision]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[tramway or trolley bus system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[tramway or trolley bus system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes the
      buildings, structures, rolling stock, general plant and equipment
      pertaining thereto and where buses other than trolley buses are
      operated in connection therewith includes the properties
      pertaining to those bus operations; ([réseau de tramway ou
      d'autobus à trolley]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[upgrading development phase]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[upgrading development phase]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a
      taxpayer's oil sands project means a development phase that
      expands the oil sands project's capacity to process bitumen or a
      similar feedstock (all or substantially all of which is from a
      mineral resource owned by the taxpayer) to the crude oil stage or
      its equivalent. ([phase de valorisation]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Except as otherwise provided in subsection (6), in
  this Part and in Schedules II and V,

  [[industrial mineral mine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[industrial mineral mine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes a peat
      bog or deposit of peat but does not include a mineral
      resource; ([mine de minéral industriel]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[mineral]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mineral]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes
      peat; ([minéral]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[mining]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mining]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes the harvesting of
      peat. ([exploitation minière]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

  [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in this Part and
  Schedules II to VI.

  [[designated immediate expensing property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[designated immediate expensing
      property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} for a taxation year, means property
      of an eligible person or partnership that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is immediate expensing property of the eligible
        person or partnership;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} became available for use by the eligible person
        or partnership in the taxation year; and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is designated as designated immediate expensing
        property in prescribed form filed by the eligible person or
        partnership with the Minister for the taxation year

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if the eligible person or partnership is a
          partnership, on or before the day that is 12 months after the
          day on which any member of the partnership is required to file
          an information return under section 229 for the fiscal period
          to which the designation relates, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, on or before the day that
          is 12 months after the eligible person or partnership's
          filing-due date for the taxation year to which the designation
          relates. ([bien relatif à la passation en charges immédiate
          désigné]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[eligible person or partnership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[eligible person or partnership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} for a
      taxation year, means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a corporation that was a Canadian-controlled
        private corporation throughout the year;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an individual (other than a trust) who was
        resident in Canada throughout the year; or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian partnership all of the members of
        which were, throughout the period, persons described in
        paragraph (a) or (b). ([personne ou société de personnes
        admissible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[immediate expensing property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[immediate expensing property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} for a
      taxation year, means property of a prescribed class (other than
      property included in any of Classes 1 to 6, 14.1, 17, 47, 49 and
      51 in Schedule II) of an eligible person or partnership that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is acquired by the eligible person or
        partnership

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if the eligible person or partnership is a
          Canadian-controlled private corporation, after April 18, 2021,
          or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if the eligible person or partnership is an
          individual or a Canadian partnership, after December 31, 2021;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} becomes available for use

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if the eligible person or partnership is an
          individual or a Canadian partnership all the members of which
          are individuals throughout the taxation year, before 2025, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, before 2024; and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} meets either of the following conditions:

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the property

          - [(A)]{.lawlabel} has not been used for any purpose before it
            was acquired by the eligible person or partnership, and

          - [(B)]{.lawlabel} is not a property in respect of which an
            amount has been deducted under paragraph 20(1)(a) or
            subsection 20(16) of the Act by any person or partnership
            for a taxation year ending before the time the property was
            acquired by the eligible person or partnership, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the property was not

          - [(A)]{.lawlabel} acquired in circumstances where

            - [(I)]{.lawlabel} the eligible person or partnership was
              deemed to have been allowed or deducted an amount under
              paragraph 20(1)(a) of the Act in respect of the property
              in computing income for previous taxation years, or

            - [(II)]{.lawlabel} the undepreciated capital cost of
              depreciable property of a prescribed class of the eligible
              person or partnership was reduced by an amount determined
              by reference to the amount by which the capital cost of
              the property to the eligible person or partnership exceeds
              its cost amount, or

          - [(B)]{.lawlabel} previously owned or acquired by the
            eligible person or partnership or by a person or partnership
            with which the eligible person or partnership did not deal
            at arm's length at any time when the property was owned or
            acquired by the person or partnership. ([bien relatif à la
            passation en charges immédiate]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[taxpayer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[taxpayer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} unless the context otherwise
      requires, includes an eligible person or
      partnership. ([contribuable]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Immediate expensing limit

  [(3.2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part and Schedules II to
  VI, an eligible person or partnership's immediate expensing limit for
  a taxation year is \$1,500,000 unless the eligible person or
  partnership is associated (within the meaning of section 256 of the
  Act, as modified by subsection (3.6)) in the taxation year with one or
  more other eligible persons or partnerships, in which case, except as
  otherwise provided in this section, its immediate expensing limit is
  nil.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Associated eligible persons or
  partnerships

  [(3.3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (3.2), if all the eligible
  persons or partnerships that are associated with each other (within
  the meaning of section 256 of the Act, as modified by subsection
  (3.6)) in a taxation year file with the Minister in prescribed form an
  agreement that assigns for the purpose of this Part and Schedules II
  to VI a percentage to one or more of them for the year, the immediate
  expensing limit for the year of each of the eligible persons or
  partnerships is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the total of the percentages assigned in the
    agreement does not exceed 100%, \$1,500,000 multiplied by the
    percentage assigned to that eligible person or partnership in the
    agreement; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, nil.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Failure to file agreement

  [(3.4)]{.lawlabel} If any of the eligible persons or partnerships that
  are associated with each other (within the meaning of section 256 of
  the Act, as modified by subsection (3.6)) in a taxation year has
  failed to file with the Minister an agreement described in subsection
  (3.3) within 30 days after notice in writing by the Minister has been
  forwarded to any of them that such an agreement is required for the
  purpose of any assessment of tax under Part I of the Act, the Minister
  shall, for the purpose of this Part and Schedules II to VI, allocate
  an amount to one or more of them for the taxation year.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Special rules for immediate expensing
  limit

  [(3.5)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (3.2) to (3.4),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where an eligible person or partnership (in this
    paragraph referred to as the "first person") has more than one
    taxation year ending in the same calendar year and it is associated
    (within the meaning of section 256 of the Act, as modified by
    subsection (3.6)) in two or more of those taxation years with
    another eligible person or partnership (in this paragraph referred
    to as the "other person") that has a taxation year ending in that
    calendar year, the immediate expensing limit of the first person for
    each taxation year ending in the calendar year in which it is
    associated (within the meaning of section 256 of the Act, as
    modified by subsection (3.6)) with the other person that ends after
    the first such taxation year ending in that calendar year is,
    subject to the application of paragraph (b), an amount equal to the
    lesser of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its immediate expensing limit determined under
      subsection (3.3) or (3.4) for the first such taxation year ending
      in the calendar year, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} its immediate expensing limit determined under
      subsection (3.3) or (3.4) for the particular taxation year ending
      in the calendar year; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where an eligible person or partnership has a
    taxation year that is less than 51 weeks, its immediate expensing
    limit for the year is that proportion of its immediate expensing
    limit for the year determined without reference to this paragraph
    that the number of days in the year is of 365.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Associated - interpretation

  [(3.6)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part and Schedules II to
  VI, in determining whether an eligible person or partnership is
  associated (within the meaning of section 256 of the Act, as modified
  by this subsection) with another eligible person or partnership in a
  taxation year

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the eligible person or partnership is a
    partnership,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the partnership is deemed to be a corporation (in
      this subsection referred to as a "deemed corporation") for the
      year,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the deemed corporation is deemed to have a
      capital stock of a single class of shares, with a total of 100
      issued and outstanding shares,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} each member (in this subsection referred to as
      a "deemed shareholder") of the deemed corporation is deemed to be
      a shareholder of the deemed corporation,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} each deemed shareholder of the deemed
      corporation is deemed to hold a number of shares in the capital
      stock of the deemed corporation determined by the formula

      ::: {#1368074 .Subparagraph}
      A × 100

      where

      [A]{.dfn}
      :   is equal to
          - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the deemed shareholder's specified
            proportion for the last fiscal period of the deemed
            corporation, or

          - [(B)]{.lawlabel} if the deemed shareholder does not have a
            specified proportion described in clause (A), the proportion
            that the fair market value of the deemed shareholder's
            interest in the deemed corporation at that time is of the
            fair market value of all interests in the deemed corporation
            at that time, and
      :::

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the deemed corporation's fiscal period is deemed
      to be its taxation year; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the eligible person or partnership is an
    individual (other than a trust) who carries on a business or has
    acquired immediate expensing property

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the individual, in respect of that business or
      property, is deemed to be a corporation that is controlled by the
      individual, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the corporation's taxation year is deemed to be
      the same as the individual's taxation year.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part and Schedules II to VI,
  [[accelerated investment incentive property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}
  means property of a taxpayer (other than property included in any of
  Classes 54 to 56) that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is acquired by the taxpayer after November 20, 2018
    and becomes available for use before 2028; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} meets either of the following conditions:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the property is not a property in respect of
      which an amount has been deducted under paragraph 20(1)(a) or
      subsection 20(16) of the Act by any person or partnership for a
      taxation year ending before the time the property was acquired by
      the taxpayer, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the property was not

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} acquired in circumstances where

        - [(I)]{.lawlabel} the taxpayer was deemed to have been allowed
          or deducted an amount under paragraph 20(1)(a) of the Act in
          respect of the property in computing income for previous
          taxation years, or

        - [(II)]{.lawlabel} the undepreciated capital cost of
          depreciable property of a prescribed class of the taxpayer was
          reduced by an amount determined by reference to the amount by
          which the capital cost of the property to the taxpayer exceeds
          its cost amount, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} previously owned or acquired by the taxpayer or
        by a person or partnership with which the taxpayer did not deal
        at arm's length at any time when the property was owned or
        acquired by the person or partnership.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed separate properties

  [(4.1)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subparagraph (4)(b)(i), if the
  capital cost to a taxpayer of a depreciable property (referred to in
  this subsection as the "single property") includes amounts incurred at
  different times, then amounts deducted under paragraph 20(1)(a) or
  subsection 20(16) of the Act in respect of the single property are
  deemed to have been deducted in respect of a separate property that is
  not part of the single property to the extent the deducted amounts can
  reasonably be considered to be in respect of amounts

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} incurred before November 21, 2018; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} incurred after November 20, 2018, if any portion of
    the single property is considered to have become available for use
    before the time the single property is first used for the purpose of
    earning income.

##### [Mining]{.HTitleText3} {#mining .SchedHeadL3}

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraphs 1100(1)(w) to (ya.2),
  subsections 1101(4a) to (4h) and Classes 10, 28 and 41 to 41.2 of
  Schedule II, a taxpayer's [[income from a mine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm},
  or any expression referring to a taxpayer's income from a mine,
  includes income reasonably attributable to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the processing by the taxpayer of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} ore (other than iron ore or tar sands ore) all or
      substantially all of which is from a mineral resource owned by the
      taxpayer to any stage that is not beyond the prime metal stage or
      its equivalent,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} iron ore all or substantially all of which is
      from a mineral resource owned by the taxpayer to any stage that is
      not beyond the pellet stage or its equivalent,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} tar sands ore all or substantially all of which
      is from a mineral resource owned by the taxpayer to any stage that
      is not beyond the crude oil stage or its equivalent, or

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} material extracted by a well, all or
      substantially all of which is from a deposit of bituminous sands
      or oil shales owned by the taxpayer, to any stage that is not
      beyond the crude oil stage or its equivalent;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the production by the taxpayer of material from a
    deposit of bituminous sands or oil shales; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the transportation by the taxpayer of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} output, other than iron ore or tar sands ore,
      from a mineral resource owned by the taxpayer that has been
      processed by him to any stage that is not beyond the prime metal
      stage or its equivalent,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} iron ore from a mineral resource owned by the
      taxpayer that has been processed by him to any stage that is not
      beyond the pellet stage or its equivalent, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} tar sands ore from a mineral resource owned by
      the taxpayer that has been processed by him to any stage that is
      not beyond the crude oil stage or its equivalent,

    to the extent that such transportation is effected through the use
    of property of the taxpayer that is included in Class 10 in Schedule
    II because of paragraph (m) thereof or that would be so included if
    that paragraph were read without reference to subparagraph (v)
    thereof and if Class 41 in Schedule II were read without the
    reference therein to that paragraph.

- [(5.1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of Classes 41 to 41.2 of Schedule
  II, a taxpayer's [[gross revenue from a mine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}
  includes

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} revenue reasonably attributable to the processing
    by the taxpayer of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} ore (other than iron ore or tar sands ore) from a
      mineral resource owned by the taxpayer to any stage that is not
      beyond the prime metal stage or its equivalent,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} iron ore from a mineral resource owned by the
      taxpayer to any stage that is not beyond the pellet stage or its
      equivalent,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} tar sands ore from a mineral resource owned by
      the taxpayer to any stage that is not beyond the crude oil stage
      or its equivalent, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} material extracted by a well from a mineral
      resource owned by the taxpayer that is a deposit of bituminous
      sands or oil shales to any stage that is not beyond the crude oil
      stage or its equivalent;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount, if any, by which any revenue reasonably
    attributable to the processing by the taxpayer of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} ore (other than iron ore or tar sands ore) from a
      mineral resource not owned by the taxpayer, to any stage that is
      not beyond the prime metal stage or its equivalent,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} iron ore from a mineral resource not owned by
      the taxpayer to any stage that is not beyond the pellet stage or
      its equivalent,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} tar sands ore from a mineral resource not owned
      by the taxpayer to any stage that is not beyond the crude oil
      stage or its equivalent, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} material extracted by a well from a mineral
      resource not owned by the taxpayer that is a deposit of bituminous
      sands or oil shales to any stage that is not beyond the crude oil
      stage or its equivalent

    exceeds the cost to the taxpayer of the ore or material processed;
    and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} revenue reasonably attributable to the production
    by the taxpayer of material from a deposit of bituminous sands or
    oil shales.

- [(5.2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (5.1), [[gross
  revenue from a mine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} does not include revenue
  reasonably attributable to the addition of diluent, for the purpose of
  transportation, to material extracted from a deposit of bituminous
  sands or oil shales.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of Class 10 in Schedule II,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} [[income from a mine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes
    income reasonably attributable to the processing of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} ore, other than iron ore or tar sands ore, from a
      mineral resource not owned by the taxpayer to any stage that is
      not beyond the prime metal stage or its equivalent,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} iron ore from a mineral resource not owned by
      the taxpayer to any stage that is not beyond the pellet stage or
      its equivalent,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} tar sands ore from a mineral resource not owned
      by the taxpayer to any stage that is not beyond the crude oil
      stage or its equivalent, or

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} material extracted by a well from a mineral
      resource not owned by the taxpayer that is a deposit of bituminous
      sands or oil shales to any stage that is not beyond the crude oil
      stage or its equivalent; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} [[mine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes a well for
    the extraction of material from a deposit of bituminous sands or oil
    shales or from a deposit of calcium chloride, halite or sylvite.

- [(6.1)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/99-179, s. 3\]]{.Repealed}

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraphs 1100(1)(w) to (ya.2),
  subsections 1101(4a) to (4h) and 1102(8) and (9), section 1107 and
  Classes 12, 28 and 41 to 41.2 of Schedule II,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} [[mine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a well for the extraction of material from a
      deposit of bituminous sands or oil shales or from a deposit of
      calcium chloride, halite or sylvite, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a pit for the extraction of kaolin or tar sands
      ore,

    but does not include

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} an oil or gas well, or

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a sand pit, gravel pit, clay pit, shale pit,
      peat bog, deposit of peat or a stone quarry (other than a kaolin
      pit or a deposit of bituminous sands or oil shales);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} all wells of a taxpayer for the extraction of
    material from one or more deposits of calcium chloride, halite or
    sylvite, the material produced from which is sent to the same plant
    for processing, are deemed to be one mine of the taxpayer; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} all wells of a taxpayer for the extraction of
    material from a deposit of bituminous sands or oil shales that the
    Minister, in consultation with the Minister of Natural Resources,
    determines constitute one project, are deemed to be one mine of the
    taxpayer.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (7), [[stone
  quarry]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes a mine producing dimension stone
  or crushed rock for use as aggregates or for other construction
  purposes.

- [(8.1)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, for the purposes of
  paragraphs (c) and (e) of Class 28 and paragraph (a) of Classes 41 to
  41.2 in Schedule II, [[production]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
  production in reasonable commercial quantities.

##### [Manufacturing or Processing]{.HTitleText3} {#manufacturing-or-processing .SchedHeadL3}

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraph 1100(1)(a.1),
  subsection 1100(26) and Class 29 in Schedule II, [[manufacturing or
  processing]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} does not include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} farming or fishing;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} logging;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} construction;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} operating an oil or gas well or extracting
    petroleum or natural gas from a natural accumulation thereof;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} extracting minerals from a mineral resource;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} processing of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} ore, other than iron ore or tar sands ore, from a
      mineral resource to any stage that is not beyond the prime metal
      stage or its equivalent,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} iron ore from a mineral resource to any stage
      that is not beyond the pellet stage or its equivalent, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} tar sands ore from a mineral resource to any
      stage that is not beyond the crude oil stage or its equivalent;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} producing industrial minerals;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} producing or processing electrical energy or steam,
    for sale;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} processing natural gas as part of the business of
    selling or distributing gas in the course of operating a public
    utility;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} processing heavy crude oil recovered from a natural
    reservoir in Canada to a stage that is not beyond the crude oil
    stage or its equivalent; or

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} Canadian field processing.

##### [Certified Films and Video Tapes]{.HTitleText3} {#certified-films-and-video-tapes-1 .SchedHeadL3}

- [(10)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection 1100(21) and the
  definitions [[certified feature film]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} and
  [[certified production]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} and in subsection (2),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} [[Canadian]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
    individual who was, at all relevant times,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian citizen as defined in the [Citizenship
      Act](/eng/acts/C-29), or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a permanent resident within the meaning of the
      Immigration Act, 1976;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a motion picture film or video tape that has been
    certified by

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the Secretary of State, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the Minister of Communications

    as a certified feature film or certified production, as the case may
    be, may have its certification revoked by the Minister of
    Communications where an incorrect statement was made in the
    furnishing of information for the purpose of obtaining that
    certification and a certification that has been so revoked is void
    from the time of its issue;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} [[remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} does not
    include an amount determined by reference to the amount of income
    from a motion picture film or video tape;

  - [(c.1)]{.lawlabel} [[revenue guarantee]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    contract or other arrangement under the terms of which a taxpayer
    has a right to receive a minimum rental revenue or other fixed
    revenue in respect of a right to the use, in any manner whatever, of
    a certified feature film or certified production;

  - [(c.2)]{.lawlabel} a screenwriter shall be deemed to be an
    individual who is a Canadian where

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} each individual involved in the preparation of
      the screenplay is a Canadian, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the principal screenwriter is an individual who
      is a Canadian and

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the screenplay for the motion picture film or
        video tape is based upon a work authored by a Canadian,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} copyright in the work subsists in Canada, and

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} the work is published in Canada;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} [[unit of production]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    measure used by the Minister of Communications in determining the
    weight to be given for each individual Canadian referred to in
    subparagraph (b)(ii) of the definition [[certified
    production]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection (2) who provides
    services in respect of a motion picture film or video tape; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} where each individual who performed a service in
    respect of a motion picture film or video tape as the

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} director,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} screenwriter,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} actor or actress in respect of whose services
      for the film or tape the highest remuneration was paid or payable,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} actor or actress in respect of whose services
      for the film or tape the second highest remuneration was paid or
      payable,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} art director,

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} director of photoghraphy,

    - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} music composer, or

    - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} picture editor

    was a Canadian, the Minister of Communications shall be deemed to
    have allotted six units of production in respect of the film or tape
    for the purposes of the definition [[certified
    production]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection (2).

##### [Certified Class 34 Properties]{.HTitleText3} {#certified-class-34-properties .SchedHeadL3}

- [(11)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraph (h) of Class 34 in
  Schedule II, a certificate issued under

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} subparagraph (d)(i) of that class may be revoked by
    the Minister of Industry, Trade and Commerce, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subparagraph (d)(ii) or paragraph (g) of that
    class, as the case may be, may be revoked by the Minister of Energy,
    Mines and Resources

  where

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an incorrect statement was made in the furnishing
    of information for the purpose of obtaining the certificate, or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the taxpayer does not conform to the plan described
    in subparagraph (d)(i) or (d)(ii) of that class, as the case may be,

  and a certificate that has been so revoked shall be void from the time
  of its issue.

##### [Amusement Parks]{.HTitleText3} {#amusement-parks .SchedHeadL3}

- [(12)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of Class 37 in Schedule II,
  [[amusement park]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a park open to the public
  where amusements, rides and audio-visual attractions are permanently
  situated.

##### [Classes 43.1 and 43.2 --- Energy Conservation Property]{.HTitleText3} {#classes-43.1-and-43.2-energy-conservation-property .SchedHeadL3}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/2006-117, s. 4

\]
:::

- [(13)]{.lawlabel} The definitions in this subsection apply for the
  purposes of this subsection, subsections (14) to (17) and Classes 43.1
  and 43.2 in Schedule II.

  [[basic oxygen furnace gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[basic oxygen furnace gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the gas
      that is produced intermittently in a basic oxygen furnace of a
      steel mill by the chemical reaction of carbon in molten steel and
      pure oxygen. ([gaz de convertisseur basique à
      oxygène]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[biogas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[biogas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the gas produced by the
      anaerobic digestion of specified waste
      material. ([biogaz]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[bio-oil]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[bio-oil]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means liquid fuel that is created
      from wood waste or plant residues using a thermo-chemical
      conversion process that takes place in the absence of
      oxygen. ([bio-huile]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[blast furnace gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[blast furnace gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the gas produced
      in a blast furnace of a steel mill, by the chemical reaction of
      carbon (in the form of coke, coal or natural gas), the oxygen in
      air and iron ore. ([gaz de haut fourneau]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[digester gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[digester gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a mixture of gases that
      are produced from the decomposition of organic waste in a digester
      and that are extracted from an eligible sewage treatment facility
      for that organic waste. ([gaz de digesteur]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[distribution equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[distribution equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means equipment
      (other than transmission equipment) used to distribute electrical
      energy generated by electrical generating equipment. ([matériel de
      distribution]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[district energy equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[district energy equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means property
      that is part of a district energy system and that consists of
      pipes or pumps used to collect and distribute an energy transfer
      medium, meters, control equipment, chillers and heat exchangers
      that are attached to the main distribution line of a district
      energy system, but does not include

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} property used to distribute water that is for
        consumption, disposal or treatment; or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} property that is part of the internal heating
        or cooling system of a building. ([équipement de réseau
        énergétique de quartier]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[district energy system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[district energy system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a system that
      is used primarily to provide heating or cooling by continuously
      circulating, from a central generation unit to one or more
      buildings through a system of interconnected pipes, an energy
      transfer medium that is heated or cooled using thermal
      energy. ([réseau énergétique de quartier]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[eligible landfill site]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[eligible landfill site]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a landfill
      site that is situated in Canada, or a former landfill site that is
      situated in Canada, and, if a permit or licence in respect of the
      site is or was required under any law of Canada or of a province,
      for which the permit or licence has been issued. ([site
      d'enfouissement admissible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[eligible sewage treatment facility]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[eligible sewage treatment facility]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      sewage treatment facility that is situated in Canada and for which
      a permit or licence is issued under any law of Canada or of a
      province. ([installation admissible de traitement des eaux
      usées]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[eligible waste fuel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[eligible waste fuel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means biogas, bio-oil,
      digester gas, landfill gas, municipal waste, plant residue, pulp
      and paper waste and wood waste. ([combustible résiduaire
      admissible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[eligible waste management facility]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[eligible waste management facility]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      waste management facility that is situated in Canada and for which
      a permit or licence is issued under any law of Canada or of a
      province. ([installation admissible de gestion des
      déchets]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[enhanced combined cycle system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[enhanced combined cycle system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      electrical generating system in which thermal waste from one or
      more natural gas compressor systems is recovered and used to
      contribute at least 20 per cent of the energy input of a combined
      cycle process in order to enhance the generation of electricity,
      but does not include the natural gas compressor systems. ([système
      à cycles combinés amélioré]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[food and animal waste]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[food and animal waste]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means organic waste
      that is disposed of in accordance with the laws of Canada or a
      province and that is

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} generated during the preparation or processing
        of food or beverage for human or animal consumption;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} food or beverage that is no longer fit for
        human or animal consumption; or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} animal remains. ([déchets alimentaires et
        animaux]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[food waste]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[food waste]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2010, c. 25, s.
      76\]]{.Repealed}

  [[fossil fuel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fossil fuel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a fuel that is
      petroleum, natural gas or related hydrocarbons, basic oxygen
      furnace gas, blast furnace gas, coal, coal gas, coke, coke oven
      gas, lignite or peat. ([combustible fossile]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[gaseous biofuel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[gaseous biofuel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a fuel produced all
      or substantially all from specified waste material that is a gas
      at a temperature of 15.6°C (60°F) and a pressure of 101 kPa (14.7
      psia). ([biocarburants gazeux]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[landfill gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[landfill gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a mixture of gases that
      are produced from the decomposition of organic waste and that are
      extracted from an eligible landfill site. ([gaz
      d'enfouissement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[liquid biofuel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[liquid biofuel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a fuel produced all
      or substantially all from specified waste material or carbon
      dioxide that is a liquid at a temperature of 15.6°C (60°F) and a
      pressure of 101 kPa (14.7 psia). ([biocarburants
      liquides]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[municipal waste]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[municipal waste]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the combustible
      portion of waste material (other than waste material that is
      considered to be toxic or hazardous waste pursuant to any law of
      Canada or of a province) that is generated in Canada and that is
      accepted at an eligible landfill site or an eligible waste
      management facility and that, when burned to generate energy,
      emits only those fluids or other emissions that are in compliance
      with the law of Canada or of a province. ([déchets
      municipaux]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[plant residue]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[plant residue]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means residue of plants (not
      including wood waste and waste that no longer has the chemical
      properties of the plants of which it is a residue) that would
      otherwise be waste material. ([résidus végétaux]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[producer gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[producer gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a property of a taxpayer that
        becomes available for use by the taxpayer before 2025, fuel the
        composition of which, excluding its water content, is all or
        substantially all non-condensable gases that is generated
        primarily from eligible waste fuel or specified waste material
        using a thermo-chemical conversion process and that is not
        generated from any feedstock other than eligible waste fuel,
        specified waste material or fossil fuel; and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a property of a taxpayer that
        becomes available for use by the taxpayer after 2024, fuel

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the composition of which, excluding its water
          content, is all or substantially all non-condensable gases,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} that is generated using a thermo-chemical
          conversion process,

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} that is generated from feedstock of which
          no more than 25% is fossil fuel when measured in terms of
          energy content (expressed as a higher heating value of the
          feedstock), and

        - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} that is not generated from any feedstock
          other than eligible waste fuel, specified waste material or
          fossil fuel. ([gaz de gazéification]{.DefinedTermLink
          lang="fr"})

  [[pulp and paper by-product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[pulp and paper by-product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means tall oil
      soaps and crude tall oil that are produced as by-products of the
      processing of wood into pulp or paper and the by-product of a pulp
      or paper plant's effluent treatment or its de-inking
      processes. ([sous-produit d'usine de pâtes ou
      papiers]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[pulp and paper waste]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[pulp and paper waste]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} tall oil soaps, crude tall oil and turpentine
        that are produced as by-products of the processing of wood into
        pulp or paper; and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the by-product of a pulp or paper plant's
        effluent treatment, or its de-inking processes, if that
        by-product has a solid content of at least 40 per cent before
        combustion. ([déchets d'usines de pâtes ou
        papiers]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[separated organics]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[separated organics]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means organic waste
      (other than waste that is considered to be toxic or hazardous
      waste under any law of Canada or a province) that could be
      disposed of in an eligible waste management facility or eligible
      landfill site. ([matières organiques séparées]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[solid biofuel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[solid biofuel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a fuel produced all or
      substantially all from specified waste material that is a solid at
      a temperature of 15.6°C (60°F) and a pressure of 101 kPa (14.7
      psia) (other than charcoal that is used for cooking or fuels with
      fossil fuel-derived ignition accelerants) and that has undergone

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a thermo-chemical conversion process to
        increase its carbon fraction and densification; or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} densification into pellets or
        briquettes. ([biocarburants solides]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[solution gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[solution gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a fossil fuel that is
      gas that would otherwise be flared and has been extracted from a
      solution of gas and produced oil. ([gaz dissous]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[specified waste material]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specified waste material]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means wood waste,
      plant residue, municipal waste, sludge from an eligible sewage
      treatment facility, spent pulping liquor, food and animal waste,
      manure, pulp and paper by-product and separated
      organics. ([déchets déterminés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[spent pulping liquor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[spent pulping liquor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the by-product
      of a chemical process of transforming wood into pulp, consisting
      of wood residue and pulping agents. ([liqueur
      résiduaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[thermal waste]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[thermal waste]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means waste heat energy
      extracted from a distinct point of rejection in an industrial
      process that would otherwise

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be vented to the atmosphere or transferred to a
        liquid; and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} not be used for a useful purpose. ([déchets
        thermiques]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[transmission equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[transmission equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means equipment
      used to transmit more than 75 per cent of the annual electrical
      energy generated by electrical generating equipment, but does not
      include a building. ([matériel de transmission]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[wood waste]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[wood waste]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes scrap wood, sawdust,
      wood chips, bark, limbs, saw-ends and hog fuel, but does not
      include spent pulping liquor and any waste that no longer has the
      physical or chemical properties of wood. ([déchets de
      bois]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(14)]{.lawlabel} Where property of a taxpayer is not operating in the
  manner required by paragraph (c) of Class 43.1, or paragraph (a) of
  Class 43.2, in Schedule II solely because of a deficiency, failing or
  shutdown that is beyond the control of the taxpayer of the system of
  which it is a part and that previously operated in the manner required
  by that paragraph, as the case may be, that property is deemed, for
  the purpose of that paragraph, to be operating in the manner required
  under that paragraph during the period of the deficiency, failing or
  shutdown, if the taxpayer makes all reasonable efforts to rectify the
  circumstances within a reasonable time.

- [(15)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (14), a taxpayer's
  system referred to in that subsection that has at any particular time
  operated in the manner required by paragraph (c) of Class 43.1, or
  paragraph (a) of Class 43.2, in Schedule II includes at any time after
  the particular time a property of another person or partnership if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the property would reasonably be considered to be
    part of the taxpayer's system were the property owned by the
    taxpayer;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the property utilizes steam obtained from the
    taxpayer's system primarily in an industrial process (other than the
    generation of electrical energy);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the operation of the property is necessary for the
    taxpayer's system to operate in the manner required by paragraph (c)
    of Class 43.1, or paragraph (a) of Class 43.2, in Schedule II, as
    the case may be; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} at the time that the taxpayer's system first became
    operational, the deficiency, failing or shutdown in the operation of
    the property could not reasonably have been anticipated by the
    taxpayer to occur within five years after that time.

- [(16)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (14), a district
  energy system is deemed to satisfy the requirements of paragraph (c)
  of Class 43.1, or paragraph (a) of Class 43.2, in Schedule II, as the
  case may be, if the electrical cogeneration equipment that produces
  the thermal energy used by the system is deemed by subsection (14) to
  meet the requirements of paragraph (c) of Class 43.1, or paragraph (a)
  of Class 43.2, in Schedule II, as the case may be.

- [(17)]{.lawlabel} A property that would otherwise be eligible for
  inclusion in Class 43.1 or Class 43.2 in Schedule II by a taxpayer is
  deemed not to be eligible for inclusion in either of those classes if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the property is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} included in Class 43.1 because of its
      subparagraph (c)(i), or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} described in

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} any of subparagraphs (d)(vii) to (ix), (xi),
        (xiii), (xiv), (xvi), (xvii) and (xix) to (xxii) of Class 43.1,
        or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} paragraph (a) of Class 43.2; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} at the time the property becomes available for use
    by the taxpayer, the taxpayer has not satisfied the requirements of
    all environmental laws, by-laws and regulations

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} of Canada, a province or a municipality in
      Canada, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} of a municipal or public body performing a
      function of government in Canada

    applicable in respect of the property.

##### [Classes 1 and 47 --- Liquefaction Property]{.HTitleText3} {#classes-1-and-47-liquefaction-property .SchedHeadL3}

- [(18)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraphs 1100(1)(a.3) and
  (yb), a taxpayer's income for a taxation year from eligible
  liquefaction activities in respect of an eligible liquefaction
  facility of the taxpayer is determined as if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the taxpayer carried on a separate business

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the only income of which is any combination of:

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} in the case of natural gas that is owned by the
        taxpayer at the time it enters the taxpayer's eligible
        liquefaction facility, income from the sale by the taxpayer of
        the natural gas that has been liquefied, whether sold as
        liquefied natural gas or regasified natural gas, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, income reasonably
        attributable to the liquefaction of natural gas at the
        taxpayer's eligible liquefaction facility, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in respect of which the only permitted
      deductions in computing the separate business' income are those
      deductions that are attributable to income described in
      subparagraph (i) and, in the case of income described in clause
      (i)(A), that are reasonably attributable to income derived after
      the natural gas enters the eligible liquefaction facility; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of income described in clause
    (a)(i)(A), the taxpayer acquired the natural gas that has been
    liquefied at a cost equal to the fair market value of the natural
    gas at the time it entered the eligible liquefaction facility.
