### [DIVISION 5]{.HLabel2}[Interpretation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-588202 .Subheading}

#### [Insurance Businesses]{.HTitleText3} {#h-588203 .Subheading}

- **[[1408]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1408
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The definitions in this subsection
  apply in this Part.

  [[accident and sickness insurance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[accident and sickness insurance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the
      same meaning as in the schedule to the [Insurance Companies
      Act](/eng/acts/I-11.8). ([assurance accidents et
      maladie]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[acquisition costs]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[acquisition costs]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2002-123, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

  [[amount payable]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[amount payable]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a policy
      loan at a particular time, means the amount of the policy loan and
      the interest that is outstanding on the policy loan at that
      time. ([montant payable]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[benefit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[benefit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a policy, includes

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a policy dividend (other than a policy dividend
        in respect of a policy described in paragraph 1403(1)(c)) in
        respect of the policy to the extent that the dividend was
        specifically treated as a benefit by the insurer in determining
        a premium for the policy, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an expense of maintaining the policy after all
        premiums in respect of the policy have been paid to the extent
        that the expense was specifically provided for by the insurer in
        determining a premium for the policy,

      but does not include

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a policy loan,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} interest on funds left on deposit with the
        insurer under the terms of the policy, and

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any other amount under the policy that was not
        specifically provided for by the insurer in determining a
        premium for the policy. ([bénéfice]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[capital tax]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[capital tax]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a tax imposed under Part
      I.3 or VI of the Act or a similar tax imposed under an Act of the
      legislature of a province. ([impôt sur le
      capital]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[cash surrender value]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[cash surrender value]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning
      assigned by subsection 148(9) of the Act. ([valeur de
      rachat]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[claim liability]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[claim liability]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2022, c.
      19, s. 84\]]{.Repealed}

  [[contractual service margin]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[contractual service margin]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} for a group of
      insurance contracts of an insurer, or a group of reinsurance
      contracts held by the insurer, at the end of a taxation year, has
      the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the Act. ([marge sur
      services contractuels]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[deposit accounting insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[deposit accounting insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has
      the meaning assigned by subsection 138(12) of the Act. ([police
      d'assurance à comptabilité de dépôt]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[extended motor vehicle warranty]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[extended motor vehicle
      warranty]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2022, c. 19, s.
      84\]]{.Repealed}

  [[general amending provision]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[general amending provision]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      2022, c. 19, s. 84\]]{.Repealed}

  [[group of insurance contracts]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[group of insurance contracts]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an insurer
      has the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the Act. ([groupe
      de contrats d'assurance]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[group of life insurance contracts]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[group of life insurance contracts]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an
      insurer has the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the
      Act. ([groupe de contrats d'assurance-vie]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[group of life insurance contracts in Canada]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[group of life insurance contracts in
      Canada]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an insurer has the same meaning as
      in subsection 138(12) of the Act. ([groupe de contrats
      d'assurance-vie au Canada]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[group of reinsurance contracts]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[group of reinsurance contracts]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} held by an
      insurer has the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the
      Act. ([groupe de contrats de réassurance]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[group of segregated fund policies]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[group of segregated fund policies]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an
      insurer has the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the
      Act. ([groupe de polices à fonds réservé]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a policy loan,
      has the meaning assigned by subsection 138(12) of the
      Act. ([intérêt]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[lapse-supported policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[lapse-supported policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a life
      insurance policy that would require materially higher premiums if
      premiums were determined using policy lapse rates that are zero
      after the fifth policy year. ([police fondée sur les
      déchéances]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[liability for incurred claims]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[liability for incurred claims]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} for a group
      of insurance contracts of an insurer at the end of a taxation year
      has the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the Act. ([passif
      au titre des sinistres survenus]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[liability for remaining coverage]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[liability for remaining coverage]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} for a
      group of insurance contracts of an insurer at the end of a
      taxation year has the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the
      Act. ([passif au titre de la couverture restante]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning
      as defined in subsection 138(12) of the Act. ([police
      d'assurance-vie]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[life insurance policy in Canada]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[life insurance policy in Canada]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the
      same meaning as defined in subsection 138(12) of the Act. ([police
      d'assurance-vie au Canada]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[modified net premium]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[modified net premium]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a
      premium under a policy (other than a prepaid premium under a
      policy that cannot be refunded except on termination of the
      policy), means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where all benefits (other than policy
        dividends) and premiums (other than the frequency of payment of
        premiums) in respect of the policy are determined at the date of
        issue of the policy, the amount determined by the formula

        ::: {#588239 .Paragraph}
        A × \[(B + C) / (D + E)\]

        where

        [A]{.dfn}
        :   is the amount of the premium,

        [B]{.dfn}
        :   is the present value, at the date of the issue of the
            policy, of the benefits to be provided under the terms of
            the policy after the day that is one year after the date of
            the issue of the policy,

        [C]{.dfn}
        :   is the present value, at the date of the issue of the
            policy, of the benefits to be provided under the terms of
            the policy after the day that is two years after the date of
            the issue of the policy,

        [D]{.dfn}
        :   is the present value, at the date of the issue of the
            policy, of the premiums payable under the terms of the
            policy on or after the day that is one year after the date
            of the issue of the policy, and

        [E]{.dfn}
        :   is the present value, at the date of the issue of the
            policy, of the premiums payable under the terms of the
            policy on or after the day that is two years after the date
            of the issue of the policy,
        :::

        except that the amount determined by the formula in respect of
        the premium for the second year of a policy is deemed to be the
        amount that is 50% of the total of

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amount that would otherwise be determined
          under the formula, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount of a one-year term insurance
          premium (determined without regard to the frequency of payment
          of the premium) that would be payable under the policy; and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, the amount that would be
        determined under paragraph (a) if that paragraph applied and the
        amount were adjusted in a manner that is reasonable in the
        circumstances. ([prime nette modifiée]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[mortgage insurance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mortgage insurance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as
      in the schedule to the [Insurance Companies
      Act](/eng/acts/I-11.8). ([assurance hypothécaire]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[net premium for the policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[net premium for the policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2002-123, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

  [[non-cancellable or guaranteed renewable accident and sickness policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[non-cancellable or guaranteed renewable accident and sickness
      policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, includes a non-cancellable or
      guaranteed renewable accident and sickness benefit under a group
      policy. ([police d'assurance contre les accidents et la maladie
      non résiliable ou à renouvellement garanti]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[participating life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[participating life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has
      the meaning assigned by subsection 138(12) of the Act. ([police
      d'assurance-vie avec participation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[policy liability]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[policy liability]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2022, c.
      19, s. 84\]]{.Repealed}

  [[policy loan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[policy loan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning assigned by
      subsection 138(12) of the Act. ([avance sur
      police]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[post-1995 life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[post-1995 life insurance
      policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2022, c. 19, s.
      84\]]{.Repealed}

  [[post-1995 non-cancellable or guaranteed renewable accident and sickness policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[post-1995 non-cancellable or guaranteed renewable accident and
      sickness policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2022, c. 19, s.
      84\]]{.Repealed}

  [[pre-1996 life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[pre-1996 life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      2022, c. 19, s. 84\]]{.Repealed}

  [[pre-1996 non-cancellable or guaranteed renewable accident and sickness policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[pre-1996 non-cancellable or guaranteed renewable accident and
      sickness policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2022, c. 19, s.
      84\]]{.Repealed}

  [[qualified annuity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[qualified annuity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an annuity
      contract issued before 1982, other than a deposit administration
      fund policy or a policy referred to in paragraph 1403(7)(c),

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of which regular periodic annuity
        payments have commenced;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of which a contract or certificate
        has been issued that provides for regular periodic annuity
        payments to commence within one year after the date of issue of
        the contract or certificate;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} that is not issued as or under a registered
        retirement savings plan, registered pension plan or deferred
        profit sharing plan and that

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} does not provide for a guaranteed cash
          surrender value at any time, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} provides for regular periodic annuity
          payments to commence not later than the attainment of age 71
          by the annuitant; or

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} that is issued as or under a registered
        retirement savings plan, registered pension plan or deferred
        profit sharing plan, if the interest rate is guaranteed for at
        least 10 years and the plan does not provide for any
        participation in profits, directly or indirectly. ([rente
        admissible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[reinsurance commission]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[reinsurance commission]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      2022, c. 19, s. 84\]]{.Repealed}

  [[reinsurance contract held amount]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[reinsurance contract held amount]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} for a
      group of reinsurance contracts held by an insurer at the end of a
      taxation year has the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the
      Act. ([montant au titre des contrats de réassurance
      détenus]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[reinsurance recoverable amount]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[reinsurance recoverable amount]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an
      insurer means an amount reported as a reinsurance asset of the
      insurer as at the end of a taxation year in respect of an amount
      recoverable from a reinsurer. ([somme à recouvrer au titre de la
      réassurance]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[relevant authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[relevant authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an insurer has the
      same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the Act. ([autorité
      compétente]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[reported reserve]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[reported reserve]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an insurer at the end
      of a taxation year in respect of a policy that insures an
      earthquake risk in Canada, or a fidelity risk, a nuclear risk or a
      risk related to a financial loss of a lender on a loan made on the
      security of real property, means the amount equal to the positive
      or negative amount of the reserve reported as at the end of the
      year. ([provision déclarée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[segregated fund]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[segregated fund]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning assigned
      by subsection 138.1(1) of the Act. ([fonds
      réservé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[segregated fund policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[segregated fund policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning
      assigned by subsection 138.1(1) of the Act. ([police à fonds
      réservé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[title insurance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[title insurance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in
      the schedule to the [Insurance Companies
      Act](/eng/acts/I-11.8). ([assurance de titres]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2022, c. 19, s. 84\]]{.Repealed}

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of the formula referred to in the
  definition [[modified net premium]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
  (1), it may be assumed that premiums are payable annually in advance.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2022, c. 19, s. 84\]]{.Repealed}

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, any rider that is
  attached to a life insurance policy and that provides for additional
  life insurance or for an annuity is a separate life insurance policy.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, any rider that is
  attached to a policy and that provides for additional non-cancellable
  or guaranteed renewable accident and sickness insurance, as the case
  may be, is a separate non-cancellable or guaranteed renewable accident
  and sickness policy.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2022, c. 19, s. 84\]]{.Repealed}

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2022, c. 19, s. 84\]]{.Repealed}

## [PART XV]{.HLabel1}[Profit Sharing Plans]{.HTitleText1} {#h-588324 .Part}

### [DIVISION I]{.HLabel2}[Employees Profit Sharing Plans]{.HTitleText2} {#h-588325 .Subheading}

- **[[1500]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1500 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  election under subsection 144(4.1) of the Act by the trustee of a
  trust governed by an employees profit sharing plan shall be made by
  filing with the Minister the prescribed form in duplicate.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} An election under subsection 144(4.2) of the Act by
  the trustee of a trust governed by an employees profit sharing plan
  shall be made by filing with the Minister the prescribed form in
  duplicate on or before the last day of a taxation year of the trust in
  respect of any capital property deemed to have been disposed of in
  that taxation year by virtue of the election.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} An election under subsection 144(10) of the Act shall
  be made by sending the following documents by registered mail to the
  Commissioner of Revenue at Ottawa:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a letter from the employer stating that he elects
    to have the arrangement qualify as an employees profit sharing plan;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the employer is a corporation,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} where the directors of the corporation are
      legally entitled to administer the affairs of the corporation, a
      certified copy of their resolution authorizing the election to be
      made, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} where the directors of the corporation are not
      legally entitled to administer the affairs of the corporation, a
      certified copy of the authorization of the making of the election
      by the person or persons legally entitled to administer the
      affairs of the corporation; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a copy of the agreement and any supplementary
    agreement setting out the plan.

- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/94-686, ss. 69(F), 79(F)
- SOR/2007-116, s. 4

### [DIVISION II]{.HLabel2}[Deferred Profit Sharing Plans]{.HTitleText2} {#h-588337 .Subheading}

#### [Registration of Plans]{.HTitleText3} {#h-588338 .Subheading}

**[[1501]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1501 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
the definition [[deferred profit sharing plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in
subsection 147(1) of the Act, an application for registration of a plan
shall be made by sending the following documents by registered mail to
the Commissioner of Revenue at Ottawa:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a letter from the trustee and the employer whereby
  the trustee and the employer apply for the registration of the plan as
  a deferred profit sharing plan;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the employer is a corporation, a certified copy of
  a resolution of the directors authorizing the application to be made;
  and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a copy of the agreement and any supplementary
  agreement setting out the plan.

### [DIVISION III]{.HLabel2}[Elections in Respect of Certain Single Payments]{.HTitleText2} {#h-588348 .Subheading}

**[[1503]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1503 .sectionLabel}** Any election by a
beneficiary under subsection 147(10.1) of the Act shall be made by
filing the prescribed form in duplicate as follows:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} one form shall be filed by the beneficiary with the
  trustee of the deferred profit sharing plan not later than 60 days
  after the end of the taxation year in which the beneficiary received
  the payment referred to in subsection 147(10.1) of the Act; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the other form shall be filed by the beneficiary with
  the Minister on or before the day on which the beneficiary is required
  to file a return of income pursuant to section 150 of the Act for the
  taxation year in which the beneficiary received the payment referred
  to in subsection 147(10.1) of the Act.

## [PART XVII]{.HLabel1}[Capital Cost Allowances, Farming and Fishing]{.HTitleText1} {#h-588372 .Part}

::: HistoricalNote

### [DIVISION I]{.HLabel2}[Deductions Allowed]{.HTitleText2} {#h-588375 .Subheading}

#### [Rates]{.HTitleText3} {#h-588376 .Subheading}

- **[[1700]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1700
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraph
  20(1)(a) of the Act, there is hereby allowed to a taxpayer, in
  computing his income from farming or fishing, as the case may be, a
  deduction for each taxation year in respect of each property that was
  used for the purpose of gaining or producing income from farming or
  fishing equal to such amount as he may claim, not exceeding in the
  case of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a building or other structure, not described
    elsewhere in this subsection, including component parts such as
    electric wiring, plumbing, sprinkler systems, air-conditioning
    equipment, heating equipment, lighting fixtures, elevators and
    escalators, 2 1/2 per cent,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a building or other structure of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} frame,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} log,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} stucco on frame,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} galvanized iron, or

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} corrugated iron,

    construction including component parts such as electric wiring,
    plumbing, sprinkler systems, air-conditioning equipment, heating
    equipment, lighting fixtures, elevators and escalators, 5 per cent,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a fence, 5 per cent,

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a scow or a vessel, including furniture, fittings
    or equipment attached thereto, but not including radiocommunication
    equipment, 7 1/2 per cent,

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} nonautomotive equipment and machinery, 10 per cent,

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} automotive equipment, a sleigh or a wagon, 15 per
    cent,

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} radiocommunication equipment, 15 per cent,

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} tile drainage acquired before the 1965 taxation
    year, 10 per cent,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a water storage tank, 5 per cent,

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a gas well that is part of the equipment of a farm
    and from which the gas produced is not sold, 10 per cent, and

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} a tool costing less than \$100, 100 per cent,

  of the depreciable cost to the taxpayer of the property.

##### [Taxation Years Less Than 12 Months]{.HTitleText3} {#taxation-years-less-than-12-months-1 .SchedHeadL3}

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where a taxation year is less than 12 months, the
  amount allowed as a deduction under subsection (1) shall not exceed
  that proportion of the maximum amount otherwise allowable that the
  number of days in the taxation year is of 365.

##### [Property Disposed of During Year]{.HTitleText3} {#property-disposed-of-during-year .SchedHeadL3}

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where a taxpayer has disposed of a property before
  the end of a taxation year, the amount allowed as a deduction under
  subsection (1) in respect of that property for the year shall not
  exceed that proportion of the maximum amount otherwise allowable that
  the number of months in the taxation year during which the property
  was owned by the taxpayer is of 12.

##### [Leasehold Interest]{.HTitleText3} {#leasehold-interest .SchedHeadL3}

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where a taxpayer has property that was used for the
  purpose of gaining or producing income from farming or fishing and
  that would be included in Class 13 in Schedule II if he had claimed an
  allowance under Part XI, he may deduct, in computing his income from
  farming or fishing for a taxation year, an amount not exceeding the
  amount he could have deducted in respect of that property for the year
  under paragraph 1100(1)(b).

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/78-377, s. 10
:::

### [DIVISION II]{.HLabel2}[Maximum Deductions]{.HTitleText2} {#h-588405 .Subheading}

- **[[1701]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1701
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The amount allowed as a deduction
  under section 1700 in respect of a property shall not exceed the
  amount by which the capital cost of the property to the taxpayer
  exceeds the aggregate of the deductions from income allowed under this
  Part in respect of the property for previous taxation years.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} In respect of the 1972 and subsequent taxation years,
  where subsection 20(5) of the [Income Tax Application
  Rules](/eng/acts/I-3.31), applies to a particular property,
  notwithstanding subsection (1), the amount allowed as a deduction
  under section 1700 in respect of the property shall not exceed the
  amount by which

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount determined to be the undepreciated
    capital cost of the property, under paragraph 20(5)(b) of the
    [Income Tax Application Rules](/eng/acts/I-3.31),

  exceeds

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of the deductions from income allowed
    under this Part in respect of the property for previous taxation
    years ending after 1971.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/94-686, s. 48
:::

### [DIVISION III]{.HLabel2}[Property not Included]{.HTitleText2} {#h-588414 .Subheading}

- **[[1702]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1702
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Nothing in this Part shall be
  construed as allowing a deduction in respect of a property

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the cost of which is deductible in computing the
    taxpayer's income;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is described in the taxpayer's inventory;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} that was acquired by an expenditure in respect of
    which the taxpayer is allowed a deduction from income under section
    37 of the Act;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} that has been constituted a prescribed class by
    subsection 24(2) of chapter 91, S.C. 1966-67;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} that is included in a separate prescribed class
    established under subsection 13(14) of the Act;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} that was not used in the business during the year;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} that is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an animal, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a tree, shrub, herb or similar growing thing;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} that was not acquired by the taxpayer for the
    purpose of gaining or producing income from farming or fishing;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} that has been included at any time by the taxpayer
    in a class prescribed under Part XI;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} that is a passenger automobile acquired after June
    13, 1963, and before January 1, 1966, the cost to the taxpayer of
    which, minus the initial transportation charges and retail sales tax
    in respect thereof, exceeded \$5,000, unless the automobile was
    acquired by a person before June 14, 1963 and has, by one or more
    transactions between persons not dealing at arm's length, become
    vested in the taxpayer; or

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} that was acquired by the taxpayer after 1971.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where a taxpayer is a member of a partnership, the
  properties referred to in this Part shall be deemed not to include any
  property that is an interest of the taxpayer in depreciable property
  that is partnership property of the partnership.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The properties referred to in section 1700 shall be
  deemed not to include the land upon which a property described therein
  was constructed or is situated.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where the taxpayer is a non-resident person, the
  properties referred to in section 1700 shall be deemed not to include
  property that is situated outside Canada.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The provisions of subsections 1102(11), (12) and (13)
  are applicable [mutatis mutandis]{.otherLang lang="la"} to paragraph
  (1)(j).

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/94-686, ss. 15(F), 50(F), 58(F), 70(F), 78(F)
- SOR/2010-93, s. 15(F)
:::

[Previous

:::

### [DIVISION IV]{.HLabel2}[Interpretation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-588436 .Subheading}

#### [Taxation Years for Individuals in Business]{.HTitleText3} {#h-588437 .Subheading}

- **[[1703]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1703
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where a taxpayer is an individual
  and his income for the taxation year includes income from a business
  the fiscal period of which does not coincide with the calendar year,
  in respect of depreciable properties acquired for the purpose of
  gaining or producing income from the business, a reference in this
  Part to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} "the taxation year" shall be deemed to be a
    reference to the fiscal period of the business; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} "the end of the taxation year" shall be deemed to
    be a reference to the end of the fiscal period of the business.

##### [Depreciable Cost]{.HTitleText3} {#depreciable-cost .SchedHeadL3}

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} In this Part, [[depreciable
  cost]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} to a taxpayer of property means, except as
  otherwise provided, the actual cost of the property to the taxpayer or
  the amount at which he is deemed under subsection 13(7) of the Act to
  have acquired the property, as the case may be.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding the other provisions of this section,
  in the case of property the cost of which to a partnership has been
  determined under paragraph 20(5)(a) of the [Income Tax Application
  Rules](/eng/acts/I-3.31), the depreciable cost to the taxpayer of the
  property for the purposes of this Part shall be deemed to be an amount
  equal to the cost to the partnership of the particular property as
  determined under that paragraph.

##### [Personal Use of Property]{.HTitleText3} {#personal-use-of-property .SchedHeadL3}

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where a taxpayer has, in a taxation year, regularly
  used a property in part for the purpose of gaining or producing income
  from farming or fishing and in part for a purpose other than gaining
  or producing income, the depreciable cost to the taxpayer of the
  property for the purposes of this Part is the proportion of the amount
  that would otherwise be the depreciable cost that the use regularly
  made of the property for the purpose of gaining or producing income
  from farming or fishing is of the whole use regularly made of the
  property.

##### [Grants, Subsidies or Other Government Assistance]{.HTitleText3} {#grants-subsidies-or-other-government-assistance .SchedHeadL3}

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Where a taxpayer has received or is entitled to
  receive a grant, subsidy or other assistance from a government,
  municipality or other public authority in respect of or for the
  acquisition of property, the depreciable cost to the taxpayer of the
  property for the purposes of this Part is the amount that would
  otherwise be the depreciable cost minus the amount of the grant,
  subsidy or other assistance.

##### [Transactions Not at Arm's Length]{.HTitleText3} {#transactions-not-at-arms-length .SchedHeadL3}

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Where property did belong to a person (in this
  subsection referred to as the "original owner") and has, by one or
  more transactions between persons not dealing at arm's length, become
  vested in a taxpayer, the depreciable cost to the taxpayer of the
  property for the purposes of this part is the lesser of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the actual capital cost of the property to the
    taxpayer; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount by which the actual capital cost of the
    property to the original owner exceeds the aggregate of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the total amount of depreciation for the property
      that, since the commencement of 1917, has been or should have been
      taken into account in accordance with the practice of the
      Department of National Revenue in ascertaining the income of the
      original owner and all intervening owners for the purposes of the
      Income War Tax Act or in ascertaining a loss for a year when there
      was no income under that Act,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any accumulated depreciation reserves that the
      original owner or an intervening owner had for the property at the
      commencement of 1917 and that were recognized by the Minister for
      the purposes of the Income War Tax Act, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of the deductions, if any,
      allowed under this Part in respect of the property to the original
      owner and all intervening owners.

##### [Property Acquired From a Parent]{.HTitleText3} {#property-acquired-from-a-parent .SchedHeadL3}

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (6), where depreciable
  property has been acquired by a taxpayer under such circumstances that
  the provisions of section 85H of the Act as it read in its application
  to the 1971 and prior taxation years are applicable for the
  determination of the capital cost of the property, the depreciable
  cost to the taxpayer of the property for the purposes of this Part is
  the capital cost as determined under that section.

##### [Property Acquired by Gift]{.HTitleText3} {#property-acquired-by-gift .SchedHeadL3}

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (6) does not apply in respect of property
  which a taxpayer has acquired by gift.

  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]

- SOR/2010-93, s. 16(F)
:::

### [DIVISION V]{.HLabel2}[Application of this Part]{.HTitleText2} {#h-588462 .Subheading}

**[[1704]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1704 .sectionLabel}** This Part shall apply
only to a taxpayer who, in computing his income, has never claimed an
allowance under Part XI in respect of a property at a time when an
allowance could have been claimed under this Part in respect of that
property, other than an allowance claimed by the taxpayer under Part XI
that may be claimed in respect of a property described in

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} paragraph 1100(1)(r) as enacted by Order in Council
  P.C. 1965-1118 of June 18, 1965 and as amended by Order in Council
  P.C. 1965-2320 of December 29, 1965;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} paragraph 1100(1)(sa) as enacted by Order in Council
  P.C. 1968-2261 of December 10, 1968;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} paragraph 1100(1)(v); or

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} Class 20 in Schedule II.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/78-377, s. 11
- SOR/86-1092, s. 9(F)
- SOR/2010-93, s. 17(F)
:::

## [PART XVIII]{.HLabel1}[Inventories]{.HTitleText1} {#h-588470 .Part}

### [Manner of Keeping Inventories]{.HTitleText2} {#h-588471 .Subheading}

**[[1800]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1800 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
section 230 of the Act, an inventory shall show quantities and nature of
the properties that should be included therein in such a manner and in
sufficient detail that the property may be valued in accordance with
this Part or section 10 of the Act.

### [Valuation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-588473 .Subheading}

**[[1801]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1801 .sectionLabel}** Except as provided in
section 1802, for the purpose of computing the income of a taxpayer from
a business, all the property described in all the inventories of the
business may be valued at its fair market value.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/89-419, s. 1
- SOR/94-686, s. 16(F)
:::

### [Valuation of Animals]{.HTitleText2} {#h-588477 .Subheading}

- **[[1802]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1802
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Except as provided in subsection
  (2), a taxpayer who is carrying on a business that includes the
  breeding and raising of animals may elect in prescribed form for a
  taxation year and subsequent taxation years to value each animal of a
  particular species (except a registered animal, an animal purchased
  for feedlot or similar operations, or an animal purchased by a drover
  or like person for resale) included in his inventory in respect of the
  business at a unit price determined in accordance with this section.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} An election made in accordance with subsection (1)
  may be revoked in writing by the taxpayer, but where a taxpayer has
  made a revocation in accordance with this subsection a further
  election may not be made under subsection (1) except with the
  concurrence of the Minister.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The unit price with respect to an animal of a
  particular class of animal shall be determined in accordance with the
  following rules:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where animals of a particular class of animal were
    included in the inventory of a taxpayer at the end of the taxation
    year immediately preceding the first year in respect of which the
    taxpayer elected under subsection (1), the unit price of an animal
    of that class shall be computed by dividing the total value of all
    animals of the class in the inventory of the preceding year by the
    number of animals of the class described in that inventory; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, the unit price of an animal of a
    class shall be determined by the Minister, having regard, among
    other things, to the unit prices of animals of a comparable class of
    animal used in valuing the inventories of other taxpayers in the
    district.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (1), where the aggregate
  value of the animals of a particular class determined in accordance
  with that subsection exceeds the market value of those animals, the
  animals of that class may be valued at fair market value.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} In this section,

  [[class of animal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[class of animal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a group of animals
      of a particular species segregated on the basis of age, breed or
      other recognized division, as determined by the taxpayer at the
      time of election under this section; ([catégorie
      d'animaux]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[district]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[district]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the territory served by a
      Tax Centre of the Canada Revenue
      Agency; ([district]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[registered animal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[registered animal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an animal for
      which a certificate of registration has been issued by the
      registrar of the breed to which the animal belongs or by the
      registrar of the Canadian National Livestock Records; ([animal
      enregistré]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  a reference to "taxation year" shall be deemed to include a reference
  to the fiscal period of a business.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/94-686, ss. 17(F), 81(F)
- SOR/2007-116, s. 6
:::

## [PART XIX]{.HLabel1}[Investment Income Tax]{.HTitleText1} {#h-588492 .Part}

### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-588493 .Subheading}

- **[[1900]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1900 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  this Part,

  [[benefit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[benefit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} under a policy includes a policy
      dividend, an experience rating refund, a refund of premiums and
      any amount deemed by paragraph 138.1(1)(g) of the Act for the
      purposes of Part I of the Act to be a payment under the terms and
      conditions of the policy, but does not include a policy loan or
      interest on funds left on deposit with the insurer under the terms
      of the policy; ([prestation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[excluded arrangement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[excluded arrangement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an insurer at any
      time means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a life insurance policy in Canada issued by the
        insurer (or in respect of which the insurer has assumed the
        obligations of the issuer of the policy to the policyholder),
        which is at that time a registered life insurance policy, an
        annuity contract (including a settlement annuity), a group term
        life insurance policy or an existing guaranteed life insurance
        policy,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a registered pension fund or plan in respect of
        which the insurer is at that time a plan sponsor, or a
        retirement compensation arrangement in respect of which the
        insurer is the custodian,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a life insurance policy (other than a life
        insurance policy in Canada) issued by the insurer before that
        time (or in respect of which the insurer has before that time
        assumed the obligations of the issuer of the policy to the
        policyholder), and

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a reinsurance arrangement under which the
        insurer has before that time assumed, directly or indirectly,
        risks under life insurance policies (other than policies issued
        by the insurer or in respect of which the insurer has assumed
        the obligations of the issuer of the policy to the
        policyholder), to the extent that the arrangement relates to
        those risks; ([mécanisme exclu]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[existing guaranteed life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[existing guaranteed life insurance
      policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} at any time means a non-participating
      life insurance policy in Canada in respect of which the amount of
      every premium that became payable before that time and after March
      2, 1988 was fixed and determined on or before March 2, 1988,
      adjusted for any specified transaction or event that occurs after
      March 2, 1988 in respect of the policy; ([police d'assurance-vie
      garantie existante]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[group term life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[group term life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} is a
      group life insurance policy under which

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} no amount (other than a policy dividend, an
        experience rating refund or a refund of premiums) may become
        payable to any person, except in the event of the death or
        disability of a person whose life was insured under the policy,
        and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} no amount may become payable to a person (other
        than the group policyholder) in respect of a policy dividend, an
        experience rating refund or a refund of premiums that has been
        funded by contributions made to or under the policy by another
        person; ([police collective d'assurance temporaire sur la
        vie]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[guaranteed interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[guaranteed interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in respect of a life
      insurance policy for a taxation year means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a life insurance policy (other
        than a pre-funded group life insurance policy), the total of all
        amounts each of which is the amount in respect of a guaranteed
        benefit in respect of which an amount is determined under
        paragraph 1401(1)(a), (c) or (d) for the year, where that
        benefit is provided under the terms and conditions of the policy
        as they existed on March 2, 1988, determined by multiplying the
        greater of

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the rate of interest used by the issuer of
          the policy in respect of the year in determining the amount of
          the benefit, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} 4%

        by 1/2 of the total of

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the maximum amount that would be deductible
          under subparagraph 138(3)(a)(i) of the Act pursuant to
          paragraph 1401(1)(a), (c) or (d), as the case may be, in
          respect of the benefit in computing the insurer's income for
          the year, if that amount were determined without reference to
          any policy loan or reinsurance arrangement, and

        - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the maximum amount that would have been
          deductible under subparagraph 138(3)(a)(i) of the Act pursuant
          to paragraph 1401(1)(a), (c) or (d), as the case may be, in
          respect of the benefit in computing the insurer's income for
          the immediately preceding taxation year, if that amount were
          determined without reference to any policy loan or reinsurance
          arrangement, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a pre-funded group life insurance
        policy, 80 per cent of the amount that would be determined under
        paragraph (a) in respect of the policy for the year, if that
        paragraph were read without reference to the words "(other than
        a pre-funded group life insurance policy)"; ([intérêts
        garantis]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} does not include

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that part of a policy in respect of which the
        policyholder is deemed by paragraph 138.1(1)(e) of the Act to
        have an interest in a segregated fund trust, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a reinsurance arrangement; ([police
        d'assurance-vie]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[life insurance policy in Canada]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[life insurance policy in Canada]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} does not
      include

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that part of a policy in respect of which the
        policyholder is deemed by paragraph 138.1(1)(e) of the Act to
        have an interest in a segregated fund trust, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a reinsurance arrangement; ([police
        d'assurance-vie au Canada]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[maximum tax actuarial reserve]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[maximum tax actuarial reserve]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the
      meaning assigned by subsection 138(12) of the Act; ([réserve
      actuarielle maximale aux fins de l'impôt]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[mortality experience]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mortality experience]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an insurer for a
      taxation year means the positive or negative amount, as the case
      may be, determined by the formula

      ::: {#588522 .Definition}
      (A - B - C)

      where

      [A]{.dfn}
      :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount that
          became payable in the year by the insurer under a taxable life
          insurance policy of the insurer as a consequence of the
          receipt of a claim in respect of the death of a person whose
          life was insured under the policy, determined without
          reference to any policy loan,

      [B]{.dfn}
      :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of a
          reserve that would be determined in accordance with
          paragraph 1401(1)(a), (c) or (d), if that amount were
          determined without reference to any policy loan or reinsurance
          arrangement, in respect of a taxable life insurance policy of
          the insurer that would have been released in the year as a
          consequence of the receipt of a claim in respect of the death
          of a person whose life was insured under the policy, and

      [C]{.dfn}
      :   is 90 per cent of the total of all amounts, each of which is
          the net cost of pure insurance determined in accordance with
          section 308 for the year in respect of an interest in a
          taxable life insurance policy of the insurer; ([facteur de
          mortalité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})
      :::

  [[mortality loss adjustment account]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mortality loss adjustment account]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an
      insurer at the end of a taxation year is the positive amount, if
      any, determined by the formula

      ::: {#588528 .Definition}
      A + B - C

      where

      [A]{.dfn}
      :   is the mortality loss adjustment account of the insurer for
          the immediately preceding taxation year,

      [B]{.dfn}
      :   is
          - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where the mortality experience of the
            insurer for the year is a negative amount, the amount of the
            mortality experience of the insurer for the year, and

          - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, the amount, if any, by
            which the amount claimed by the insurer under the
            description of F in computing the amount determined under
            subsection (6) for the year exceeds the amount of the
            mortality loss adjustment account of the insurer for the
            immediately preceding taxation year, and

      [C]{.dfn}

      :   is 1.2 times the amount, if any, by which

          - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the net cost of insurance of the insurer
            for the year

          exceeds

          - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the total of all amounts each of which is
            the net cost of pure insurance determined in accordance with
            section 308 for the year in respect of an interest in a
            taxable life insurance policy of the insurer; ([compte de
            redressement pour pertes de mortalité]{.DefinedTermLink
            lang="fr"})
      :::

  [[net cost of insurance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[net cost of insurance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an insurer for a
      taxation year means the amount, if any, by which

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount determined in the description of A
        in the definition [[mortality experience]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}
        in respect of the insurer for the year

      exceeds

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount determined in the description of B
        in the definition [[mortality experience]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}
        in respect of the insurer for the year; ([coût net de
        l'assurance]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[net level premium]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[net level premium]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in respect of a
      particular premium under a policy (other than a prepaid premium
      that cannot be refunded except on termination or cancellation of
      the policy) means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where benefits (other than policy dividends)
        and premiums (other than the frequency of payment thereof) in
        respect of the policy have been determined at the date of issue
        of the policy, the amount determined by the formula

        ::: {#588543 .Paragraph}
        A × (B / C)

        where

        [A]{.dfn}
        :   is the amount of the particular premium,

        [B]{.dfn}
        :   is the present value, at the date of issue of the policy, of
            the amount of the benefits (other than policy dividends) to
            be provided under the terms of the policy after the issue of
            the policy, and

        [C]{.dfn}
        :   is the present value, at the date of issue of the policy, of
            the amount of the premiums payable under the terms of the
            policy on or after the issue of the policy, and
        :::

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the amounts of the benefits or premiums
        in respect of the policy are not determined at the date of issue
        of the policy, the amount that would be determined under
        paragraph (a) in respect of the particular premium if the amount
        were adjusted in a manner that is reasonable in the
        circumstances and consistent with the manner of the adjustment
        referred to in the definition [[modified net
        premium]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 1404(2) in respect
        of the particular premium; ([prime constante
        nette]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[net level premium reserve]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[net level premium reserve]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in respect of a
      life insurance policy for a taxation year means the maximum amount
      that would be deductible under subparagraph 138(3)(a)(i) of the
      Act pursuant to paragraph 1401(1)(c) in respect of the policy in
      computing the insurer's income for the year, if any reference to
      [[modified net premium]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in sections 1401,
      1403 and 1404 were a reference to [[net level
      premium]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}; ([réserve de primes constantes
      nettes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[non-participating life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[non-participating life insurance
      policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a life insurance policy other
      than a participating life insurance policy within the meaning
      assigned by subsection 138(12) of the Act; ([police
      d'assurance-vie sans participation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[policy loan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[policy loan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning assigned by
      subsection 138(12) of the Act; ([prêt sur police]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[pre-funded group life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[pre-funded group life insurance
      policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a group term life insurance
      policy, other than a policy under which each premium payable is in
      respect of coverage for a period, including the day on which the
      premium becomes payable, that does not exceed twelve
      months; ([police collective d'assurance-vie par capitalisation
      anticipée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[premium]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[premium]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} consideration received for settlement
        annuities,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} amounts received by an insurer in respect of
        employee contributions under registered pension funds or plans
        in respect of which the insurer is a plan sponsor or a
        retirement compensation arrangement in respect of which the
        insurer is the custodian, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any amount deemed by paragraph 138.1(1)(h) of
        the Act for the purposes of Part I of the Act to be a premium
        received by an insurer,

      but does not include amounts received in respect of the repayment
      of a policy loan or in respect of interest on a policy loan and,
      for greater certainty, the amount of a premium is not reduced by
      the amount of a refund of premiums; ([prime]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[registered life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[registered life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the
      meaning assigned by section 211 of the Act; ([police
      d'assurance-vie agréée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[reinsurance arrangement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[reinsurance arrangement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} does not include
      an arrangement under which an insurer has assumed the obligations
      of the issuer of a life insurance policy to the
      policyholder; ([mécanisme de réassurance]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[segregated fund]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[segregated fund]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning assigned
      by subsection 138(12) of the Act; ([fonds
      réservé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[specified transaction or event]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specified transaction or event]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in respect
      of a life insurance policy means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a change in underwriting class,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a change in premium due to a change in
        frequency of premium payments within a year that does not alter
        the present value, at the beginning of the year, of the total
        premiums to be paid under the policy in the year,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an addition under the terms of the policy as
        they existed on March 2, 1988, of accidental death,
        dismemberment, disability or guaranteed purchase option
        benefits,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a deletion of a rider,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} redating lapsed policies within 60 days after
        the end of the calendar year in which the lapse occurred, or
        redating for policy loan indebtedness,

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a change in premium due to a correction of
        erroneous information,

      - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the payment of a premium after its due date, or
        no more than 30 days before its due date, as established on or
        before March 2, 1988, or

      - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the payment of an amount of interest described
        in subparagraph 148(9)(e.1)(i) of the Act; ([opération ou
        événement déterminé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[taxable life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[taxable life insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an
      insurer at any time means a life insurance policy in Canada issued
      by the insurer (or in respect of which the insurer has assumed the
      obligations of the issuer of the policy to the policyholder),
      other than a policy that is at that time an excluded
      arrangement. ([police d'assurance-vie imposable]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any rider added, at any time after March 2, 1988,
    to a life insurance policy shall be deemed to be a separate life
    insurance policy issued at that time; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an insurer's first taxation year that
    commences after June 17, 1987 and ends after 1987, the maximum
    amount that would have been deductible under subparagraph
    138(3)(a)(i), (ii) or (iv) of the Act, as the case may be, in
    computing the insurer's income for the immediately preceding year
    shall be determined as though the provisions that apply in
    determining that maximum amount for that first taxation year were
    applicable in respect of that immediately preceding year.

#### [Prescribed Provisions]{.HTitleText2} {#prescribed-provisions .SchedHeadL2}

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraph (b) of the description
  of C in subsection 211.1(3) of the Act, as it read in its application
  to taxation years beginning before 1990, the provisions of the Act
  that are prescribed are paragraphs 12(1)(i), (i.1), (n), (n.1), (n.2),
  (n.3), (o), (t) and (v) and subsections 13(1), 59(3.2) and (3.3),
  138(4.4) and 140(2).

#### [Prescribed Arrangements]{.HTitleText2} {#prescribed-arrangements .SchedHeadL2}

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of the description of D in
  subsection 211.1(3) of the Act, as it read in its application to
  taxation years beginning before 1990, prescribed arrangements in
  respect of an insurer are

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} life insurance policies in Canada issued by the
    insurer (or in respect of which the insurer has assumed the
    obligations of the issuer of the policy to the policyholder) that
    are group term life insurance policies or existing guaranteed life
    insurance policies;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} life insurance policies (other than life insurance
    policies in Canada) issued by the insurer (or in respect of which
    the insurer has assumed the obligations of the issuer of the policy
    to the policyholder);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} retirement compensation arrangements in respect of
    which the insurer is the custodian; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} reinsurance arrangements under which the insurer
    has assumed or ceded risks insured under life insurance policies
    (other than policies issued by the insurer or in respect of which
    the insurer has assumed the obligations of the issuer of the policy
    to the policyholder).

#### [Prescribed Rules for Determining Amounts]{.HTitleText2} {#prescribed-rules-for-determining-amounts .SchedHeadL2}

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The amount in the description of D in subsection
  211.1(3) of the Act, as it read in its application to taxation years
  beginning before 1990, in respect of a life insurer for a taxation
  year is determined by the formula

  ::: {#588584 .Subsection}
  A - B + C - D - E - F

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the maximum amount
      that would be deductible under subparagraph 138(3)(a)(i), (ii)
      or (iv) of the Act in respect of an excluded arrangement of the
      insurer in computing the insurer's income for the year, if that
      amount were determined without reference to any policy loan;

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the maximum amount
      that would have been deductible under
      subparagraph 138(3)(a)(i), (ii) or (iv) of the Act in respect of
      an excluded arrangement of the insurer in computing the insurer's
      income for the immediately preceding year, if that amount were
      determined without reference to any policy loan;

  [C]{.dfn}
  :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of a
      benefit, determined on a net of reinsurance ceded basis, that has
      become payable by the insurer in the year in respect of an
      excluded arrangement of the insurer, to the extent that the
      benefit is deducted in computing the insurer's income for the year
      under Part I of the Act from carrying on a life insurance business
      in Canada;

  [D]{.dfn}
  :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of a
      premium, determined on a net of reinsurance ceded basis, that has
      become receivable by the insurer in the year in respect of an
      excluded arrangement of the insurer, to the extent that the
      premium is included in computing the insurer's income for the year
      under Part I of the Act from carrying on a life insurance business
      in Canada;

  [E]{.dfn}
  :   is the positive or negative amount, as the case may be, in respect
      of the insurer for the year determined by the formula
      ::: {#588591 .NestedFormula}
      (G - H) - (I - J) + (K - L) - (M - N)

      where

      [G]{.dfn}
      :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the maximum
          amount that would be deductible under
          subparagraph 138(3)(a)(i), (ii) or (iv) of the Act in respect
          of a taxable life insurance policy of the insurer in computing
          the insurer's income for the year, if that amount were
          determined without reference to any policy loan or reinsurance
          arrangement,

      [H]{.dfn}
      :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the maximum
          amount that would be deductible under
          subparagraph 138(3)(a)(i), (ii) or (iv) of the Act in respect
          of a taxable life insurance policy of the insurer in computing
          the insurer's income for the year, if that amount were
          determined without reference to any policy loan,

      [I]{.dfn}
      :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the maximum
          amount that would have been deductible under
          subparagraph 138(3)(a)(i), (ii) or (iv) of the Act in respect
          of a taxable life insurance policy of the insurer in computing
          the insurer's income for the immediately preceding taxation
          year, if that amount were determined without reference to any
          policy loan or reinsurance arrangement,

      [J]{.dfn}
      :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the maximum
          amount that would have been deductible under
          subparagraph 138(3)(a)(i), (ii) or (iv) of the Act in respect
          of a taxable life insurance policy of the insurer in computing
          the insurer's income for the immediately preceding taxation
          year, if that amount were determined without reference to any
          policy loan,

      [K]{.dfn}
      :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of a
          benefit that has become payable in the year by the insurer
          under a taxable life insurance policy of the insurer,

      [L]{.dfn}
      :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of a
          benefit, determined on a net of reinsurance ceded basis, that
          has become payable by the insurer under a taxable life
          insurance policy of the insurer, to the extent that it is
          deducted in computing the insurer's income from carrying on a
          life insurance business in Canada for the year,

      [M]{.dfn}
      :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of a
          premium that has become receivable by the insurer in the year
          under a taxable life insurance policy of the insurer, and

      [N]{.dfn}
      :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of a
          premium, determined on net of reinsurance ceded basis, that
          has become receivable by the insurer in the year under a
          taxable life insurance policy of the insurer, to the extent
          that the premium is included in computing the insurer's income
          from carrying on a life insurance business in Canada for the
          year; and
      :::

  [F]{.dfn}
  :   is the positive or negative amount, as the case may be, determined
      by the formula
      ::: {#588602 .NestedFormula}
      O + P - Q - R

      where

      [O]{.dfn}
      :   is the total of all amounts each of which is an amount in
          respect of a group term life insurance policy equal to the
          lesser of
          - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount of interest credited by the
            insurer in the year on account of the policy (other than
            interest payable in respect of the period ending on its
            first anniversary date after March 2, 1988), and

          - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount, if any, by which the maximum
            amount that would be deductible under subparagraph
            138(3)(a)(i) of the Act pursuant to paragraph 1401(1)(c.1)
            in respect of the policy in computing the insurer's income
            for the year, if that amount were determined without
            reference to any reinsurance arrangement, exceeds the
            maximum amount that would have been so deductible in
            computing the insurer's income for the immediately preceding
            year,

      [P]{.dfn}

      :   is 80 per cent of the total of all amounts each of which is
          the amount in respect of a liability of the insurer, a
          benefit, a risk or a guarantee, in respect of which an amount
          is determined under paragraph 1401(1)(a), (c) or (d) for the
          year, in respect of a pre-funded group life insurance policy
          of the insurer, determined by multiplying

          - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the rate of interest used in determining
            the amount under paragraph 1401(1)(a), (c) or (d), as the
            case may be, for the year in respect of the liability,
            benefit, risk or guarantee, as the case may be,

          by 1/2 of the total of

          - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the maximum amount that would be deductible
            under subparagraph 138(3)(a)(i) of the Act pursuant to
            paragraph 1401(1)(a), (c) or (d), as the case may be, in
            respect of the liability, benefit, risk or guarantee, as the
            case may be, in computing the insurer's income for the year
            if that amount were determined without reference to any
            policy loan or reinsurance arrangement, and

          - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the maximum amount that would have been
            deductible under subparagraph 138(3)(a)(i) of the Act
            pursuant to paragraph 1401(1)(a), (c) or (d), as the case
            may be, in respect of the liability, benefit, risk or
            guarantee, as the case may be, in computing the insurer's
            income for the immediately preceding taxation year if that
            amount were determined without reference to any policy loan
            or reinsurance arrangement,

      [Q]{.dfn}

      :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount
          determined for the year in respect of a taxable life insurance
          policy of the insurer by multiplying

          - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the rate of interest used in determining
            the maximum amount deductible under subparagraph
            138(3)(a)(i) of the Act pursuant to paragraph 1401(1)(c) in
            respect of the policy in computing the insurer's income for
            the year,

          by 1/2 of the total of

          - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the maximum amount that would be deductible
            under subparagraph 138(3)(a)(ii) of the Act in respect of
            the policy in computing the insurer's income for the year,
            if that amount were determined without reference to any
            reinsurance arrangement, and

          - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the maximum amount that would have been
            deductible under subparagraph 138(3)(a)(ii) of the Act in
            respect of the policy in computing the insurer's income for
            the immediately preceding taxation year, if that amount were
            determined without reference to any reinsurance arrangement,
            and

      [R]{.dfn}

      :   is the total of all amounts each of which is an amount in
          respect of a group term life insurance policy equal to the
          amount, if any, by which

          - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the total of all amounts determined in
            respect of the insurer under the description of O in respect
            of the policy for taxation years ending before the year

          exceeds the total of

          - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the total of all amounts determined in
            respect of the insurer under the description of R in respect
            of the policy for taxation years ending before the year, and

          - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the maximum amount that would be deductible
            under subparagraph 138(3)(a)(i) of the Act pursuant to
            paragraph 1401(1)(c.1) in respect of the policy in computing
            the insurer's income for the year, if that amount were
            determined without reference to any reinsurance arrangement.
      :::
  :::

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} The amount of the term insurance component in the
  description of E in subsection 211.1(3) of the Act, as it read in its
  application to taxation years beginning before 1990, in respect of a
  life insurer for a taxation year is determined by the formula

  ::: {#588620 .Subsection}
  A + B + C - D + E - F + G + H

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the amount determined by multiplying 0.0035 by the total of all
      amounts each of which is the amount of new insurance effected in
      the year (other than amounts rescinded in the year) under a
      taxable life insurance policy of the insurer;

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the amount determined by multiplying 0.0002 by 1/2 of the total
      of
      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} all amounts of insurance in force at the end of
        the year under taxable life insurance policies of the insurer
        (other than paid-up policies), and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} all amounts of insurance in force at the end of
        the immediately preceding taxation year under taxable life
        insurance policies of the insurer (other than paid-up policies);

  [C]{.dfn}
  :   is the amount determined by multiplying 0.20 by the net cost of
      insurance in respect of the insurer for the year;

  [D]{.dfn}
  :   is the greater of
      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the lesser of \$2,500,000 and the amount, if
        any, by which

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the total of the amounts determined under the
          descriptions of A, B, C and E in respect of the insurer for
          the year

        exceeds

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} 50 per cent of the amount that would be
          determined under the description of N in subsection (5) in
          respect of the insurer for the year, if that amount were
          determined without reference to any reinsurance arrangement,
          and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount, if any, by which

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the total of the amounts determined under the
          descriptions of A, B, C and E in respect of the insurer for
          the year

        exceeds

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} 75 per cent of the amount that would be
          determined under the description of N in subsection (5) in
          respect of the insurer for the year, if that amount were
          determined without reference to any reinsurance arrangement;

  [E]{.dfn}
  :   is the amount determined under the description of D in respect of
      the insurer for the immediately preceding taxation year;

  [F]{.dfn}
  :   is such amount as the insurer may claim, not exceeding the
      positive amount, if any, determined by adding
      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the mortality experience of the insurer for the
        year, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount determined under the description of
        G in respect of the insurer for the year;

  [G]{.dfn}
  :   is the mortality loss adjustment account of the insurer for the
      immediately preceding year; and

  [H]{.dfn}
  :   is 1 per cent of the total of all amounts each of which is the
      amount of a premium that has become receivable by the insurer in
      the year under a taxable life insurance policy of the insurer in
      respect of which a positive amount of guaranteed interest is
      determined for the year under subsection (8).
  :::

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} The amount of the amortization adjustment amount in
  the description of E in subsection 211.1(3) of the Act, as it read in
  its application to taxation years beginning before 1990, in respect of
  a life insurer for a taxation year is determined by the formula

  ::: {#588641 .Subsection}
  (A - B) - (C - D)

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount that would
      be the net level premium reserve for the year in respect of a
      taxable life insurance policy of the insurer (other than a policy
      in respect of which a positive amount of guaranteed interest is
      determined for the year under subsection (8)), if that amount were
      determined without reference to any policy loan or reinsurance
      agreement;

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount that would
      be the net level premium reserve for the immediately preceding
      taxation year in respect of a taxable life insurance policy of the
      insurer (other than a policy in respect of which a positive amount
      of guaranteed interest is determined for the year under
      subsection (8)), if that amount were determined without reference
      to any policy loan or reinsurance arrangement;

  [C]{.dfn}
  :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the maximum amount
      that would be deductible under subparagraph 138(3)(a)(i) of the
      Act pursuant to paragraph 1401(1)(c) in computing the insurer's
      income for the year, in respect of a taxable life insurance policy
      of the insurer (other than a policy in respect of which a positive
      amount of guaranteed interest is determined for the year under
      subsection (8)), if that amount were determined without reference
      to any policy loan or reinsurance arrangement; and

  [D]{.dfn}
  :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the maximum amount
      that would have been deductible under subparagraph 138(3)(a)(i) of
      the Act pursuant to paragraph 1401(1)(c) in computing the
      insurer's income for the immediately preceding taxation year, in
      respect of a taxable life insurance policy of the insurer (other
      than a policy in respect of which a positive amount of guaranteed
      interest is determined for the year under subsection (8)), if that
      amount were determined without reference to any policy loan or
      reinsurance arrangement.
  :::

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} The amount of guaranteed interest in the description
  of F in subsection 211.1(3) of the Act, as it read in its application
  to taxation years beginning before 1990, in respect of a life insurer
  for a taxation year is the total of all amounts each of which is the
  guaranteed interest for the year in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a life insurance policy in Canada (other than a
    policy that was at any time an excluded arrangement), or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a pre-funded group life insurance policy,

  where the policy was issued by the insurer (or in respect of which the
  insurer has assumed the obligations of the issuer of the policy to the
  policyholder) and the terms and conditions of the policy relating to
  premiums and benefits were determined on or before March 2, 1988,
  except that where, at any time after March 2, 1988, the terms and
  conditions of the policy relating to premiums and benefits have been
  changed (other than to give effect to terms and conditions which were
  determined prior to March 3, 1988 or pursuant to a specified
  transaction or event), the amount of guaranteed interest in respect of
  the policy for the year in which the change is made and any subsequent
  taxation year is deemed to be nil.

#### [Prescribed Portion]{.HTitleText2} {#prescribed-portion .SchedHeadL2}

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} The prescribed portion of an amount referred to in
  the description of G in subsection 211.1(3) of the Act, as it read in
  its application to taxation years beginning before 1990, for a
  taxation year is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where the amount is in respect of a life insurance
    policy (other than a policy in respect of which a positive amount of
    guaranteed interest is determined for the year under subsection
    (8)), 100 per cent of the amount; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, nil.

#### [Prescribed Arrangements]{.HTitleText2} {#prescribed-arrangements-1 .SchedHeadL2}

- [(10)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of the description of G in
  subsection 211.1(3) of the Act, as it read in its application to
  taxation years beginning before 1990, prescribed arrangements of an
  insurer are life insurance policies in Canada issued by the insurer
  (or in respect of which the insurer has assumed the obligations of the
  issuer of the policy to the policyholder) that are group term life
  insurance policies or policies that, at any time, were existing
  guaranteed life insurance policies.
