## [PART XXXVIII]{.HLabel1}[Social Insurance Number Applications]{.HTitleText1} {#h-589893 .Part}

**[[3800]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-3800 .sectionLabel}** Every individual who
is required by subsection 237(1) of the Act to apply to the Minister of
National Health and Welfare for assignment to him of a Social Insurance
Number shall do so by delivering or mailing to the local office of the
Canada Employment and Immigration Commission nearest to the individual's
residence, a completed application in the form prescribed by the
Minister for that purpose.

## [PART XXXIX]{.HLabel1}[Mining Taxes]{.HTitleText1} {#h-589895 .Part}

- **[[3900]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-3900
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in
  this section.

  [[income]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[income]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a taxpayer for a taxation year
      from mining operations in a province means the income, for the
      taxation year, that is derived from mining operations in the
      province as computed under the laws of the province that impose an
      eligible tax described in subsection
      (3). ([revenu]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[mine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes any work or undertaking in
      which a mineral ore is extracted or produced and includes a
      quarry. ([mine]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[mineral ore]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mineral ore]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes an unprocessed
      mineral or mineral-bearing substance. ([minerai]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[mining operations]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mining operations]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the extraction or production of mineral ore
        from or in a mine;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the transportation of mineral ore to the point
        of egress from the mine; and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the processing of

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} mineral ore (other than iron ore) to the
          prime metal stage or its equivalent, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} iron ore to a stage that is not beyond the
          pellet stage or its equivalent. ([exploitation
          minière]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[non-Crown royalty]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[non-Crown royalty]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a royalty
      contingent on production of a mine or computed by reference to the
      amount or value of production from mining operations in a province
      but does not include a royalty that is payable to the Crown in
      right of Canada or a province. ([redevance non
      gouvernementale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[processing]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[processing]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes all forms of
      beneficiation, smelting and
      refining. ([transformation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of paragraph 20(1)(v) of the Act, the
  amount allowed for a taxation year in respect of taxes on income from
  mining operations of a taxpayer is the total of all amounts each of
  which is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an eligible tax that is paid or payable by the
    taxpayer

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} on the income of the taxpayer for the taxation
      year from mining operations, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} on a non-Crown royalty included in computing the
      income of the taxpayer for the taxation year;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an eligible tax that is paid by the taxpayer in the
    taxation year on either the income of the taxpayer for a previous
    taxation year from mining operations or a non-Crown royalty included
    in computing the income of the taxpayer for a previous taxation
    year, if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amount was deductible in computing the income
      of the taxpayer for the previous taxation year,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount has not been deducted in computing
      the income of the taxpayer for a taxation year that is prior to
      the taxation year, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} an assessment of the taxpayer to take into
      account a deduction in respect of the eligible tax under the Act
      for the previous taxation year would be precluded because of
      subsections 152(4) to (5) of the Act; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} interest in respect of eligible tax referred to in
    paragraph (a) or (b) that is paid in the taxation year by the
    taxpayer to the province imposing the eligible tax.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} An eligible tax referred to in subsection (2) is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a tax, on the income of a taxpayer for a taxation
    year from mining operations in a province, that is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} levied under a law of the province,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} imposed only on persons engaged in mining
      operations in the province, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} paid or payable to

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the province,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} an agent of Her Majesty in right of the
        province, or

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} a municipality in the province, in lieu of
        taxes on property or on any interest, or for civil law any
        right, in property (other than in lieu of taxes on residential
        property or on any interest, or for civil law any right, in
        residential property); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a tax, on an amount received or receivable by a
    person as a non-Crown royalty, that is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} levied under a law of a province,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} imposed specifically on persons who hold a
      non-crown royalty on mining operations in the province, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} paid or payable to the province or to an agent
      of Her Majesty in right of the province.

### [Prescribed Rate of Interest]{.HTitleText2} {#h-589953 .Subheading}

**[[4301]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4301 .sectionLabel}** Subject to section
4302, for the purposes of

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} every provision of the Act that requires interest at
  a prescribed rate to be paid to the Receiver General, the prescribed
  rate in effect during any particular quarter is the total of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the rate that is the simple arithmetic mean,
    expressed as a percentage per year and rounded to the next higher
    whole percentage where the mean is not a whole percentage, of all
    amounts each of which is the average equivalent yield, expressed as
    a percentage per year, of Government of Canada Treasury Bills that
    mature approximately three months after their date of issue and that
    are sold at auctions of Government of Canada Treasury Bills during
    the first month of the quarter preceding the particular quarter, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} 4 per cent;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} every provision of the Act that requires interest at
  a prescribed rate to be paid or applied on an amount payable by the
  Minister to a taxpayer, the prescribed rate in effect during any
  particular quarter is the total of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the rate determined under subparagraph (a)(i) in
    respect of the particular quarter, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if the taxpayer is a corporation, zero per cent,
    and in any other case, 2 per cent;

- [(b.1)]{.lawlabel} subsection 17.1(1) of the Act, the prescribed rate
  in effect during any particular quarter is the rate that would be
  determined under paragraph (a) in respect of the particular quarter if
  the reference in subparagraph (a)(i) to "the next higher whole
  percentage where the mean is not a whole percentage" were read as "two
  decimal points"; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} every other provision of the Act in which reference
  is made to a prescribed rate of interest or to interest at a
  prescribed rate, the prescribed rate in effect during any particular
  quarter is the rate determined under subparagraph (a)(i) in respect of
  the particular quarter.

## [PART XLV]{.HLabel1}[Elections in Respect of Expropriation Assets]{.HTitleText1} {#h-589985 .Part}

**[[4500]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4500 .sectionLabel}** Any election by a
taxpayer under subsection 80.1(1), (2), (4), (5), (6) or (9) of the Act

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is included or would, but for Class 28, 41,
    41.1 or 41.2 in Schedule II, be included in paragraph (g) of Class
    10 in Schedule II.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Property is prescribed machinery and equipment for
  the purposes of the definitions [[qualified
  property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} and [[qualified resource
  property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 127(9) of the Act if it
  is depreciable property of the taxpayer (other than property referred
  to in subsection (1)) that is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a property included in paragraph (k) of Class 1 or
    paragraph (a) of Class 2 in Schedule II;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an oil or water storage tank;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a property included in Class 8 in Schedule II
    (other than railway rolling stock);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a vessel, including the furniture, fittings and
    equipment attached thereto;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a property included in paragraph (a) of Class 10 or
    Class 22 or 38 in Schedule II (other than a car or truck designed
    for use on highways or streets);

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} notwithstanding paragraph (e), a logging truck
    acquired after March 31, 1977 to be used in the activity of logging
    and having a weight, including the weight of property the capital
    cost of which is included in the capital cost of the truck at the
    time of its acquisition (but for greater certainty not including the
    weight of fuel), in excess of 16,000 pounds;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a property included in any of paragraphs (b) to
    (f), (h), (j), (k), (o), (r), (t) or (u) of Class 10 in Schedule II,
    or property included in paragraph (b) of Class 41 in Schedule II and
    that would otherwise be included in paragraph (j), (k), (r), (t)
    or (u) of Class 10 in Schedule II;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a property included in paragraph (n) of Class 10,
    or Class 15, in Schedule II (other than a roadway);

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a property included in any of paragraphs (a) to (f)
    of Class 9 in Schedule II;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a property included in Class 28, in paragraph (a),
    (a.1), (a.2) or (a.3) of Class 41 or in Class 41.1 or 41.2 in
    Schedule II that would, but for Class 28, 41, 41.1 or 41.2, as the
    case may be, be included in paragraph (k) or (r) of Class 10 of
    Schedule II;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} a property included in Class 21, 24, 27, 29, 34,
    39, 40, 43, 45, 46, 50, 52 or 53 in Schedule II;

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} a property included in paragraph (c) or (d) of
    Class 41 in Schedule II;

  - [(m)]{.lawlabel} property included in Class 43.1 in Schedule II
    because of paragraph (c) of that Class; or

  - [(n)]{.lawlabel} a property included in Class 43.2 in Schedule II
    because of paragraph (a) of that Class.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Property is prescribed energy generation and
  conservation property for the purposes of the definition [[qualified
  property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 127(9) of the Act if it
  is depreciable property of the taxpayer (other than property referred
  to in subsection (1) or (2)) that is a property included in any of
  subparagraph (a.1)(i) of Class 17 and Classes 43.1, 43.2 and 48 in
  Schedule II.

### [Qualified Transportation Equipment]{.HTitleText2} {#h-590013 .Subheading}

**[[4601]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4601 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
the definition [[qualified transportation
equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 127(9) of the Act, the
following depreciable property of a taxpayer (other than qualified
property as defined by subsection 127(9) of the Act) is prescribed
equipment:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} property that is

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} included in Class 1 in Schedule II by virtue of
    paragraph (h) or (i) of that Class,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a bridge, culvert, subway or tunnel included in
    Class 1 in Schedule II that is ancillary to railway track and
    grading,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a trestle included in Class 3 in Schedule II that
    is ancillary to railway track and grading,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} machinery or equipment included in Class 8 in
    Schedule II that is ancillary to

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} railway track and grading, or

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} railway traffic control or signalling equipment,
      including switching, block signalling, interlocking, crossing
      protection, detection, speed control or retarding equipment, but
      not including property that is principally electronic equipment or
      systems software therefor,

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} included in Class 10 in Schedule II by virtue of
    subparagraph (m)(i), (ii) or (iii) of that Class, or

  - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} property described in paragraph (m) of Class 10 in
    Schedule II (other than property described in subparagraph (iv)
    thereof) that is included in Class 28 or 41 in Schedule II;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} property that is

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} included in Class 6 in Schedule II by virtue of
    paragraph (j) of that Class,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} machinery or equipment included in Class 8 in
    Schedule II that

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} was acquired principally for the purpose of
      maintaining or servicing, or

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} is ancillary to and used as part of,

    a railway locomotive or railway car, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} included in Class 35 in Schedule II;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} property that is

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a truck, tractor or trailer that

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} is included in Class 10 in Schedule II because of
      paragraph (e) of that Class or in Class 16 in Schedule II because
      of paragraph (g) of that Class,

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} is designed for the purpose of carrying freight,
      or hauling a trailer that carries freight, on highways, and

    - [(C)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/85-696, s. 12\]]{.Repealed}

    - [(D)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a truck or tractor, has a "gross
      vehicle weight rating" (within the meaning assigned that
      expression by the [Motor Vehicle Safety
      Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._1038)) of 26,001 pounds
      or more, and in the case of a trailer, is of a type designed to be
      hauled under normal operating conditions by a truck or tractor
      described in this subparagraph,

    but for greater certainty,

    - [(E)]{.lawlabel} was not acquired principally for the purpose of
      carrying or hauling freight locally or making local pickups or
      deliveries, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} machinery or equipment included in Class 8 or 10
    in Schedule II that is ancillary to and used as part of any property
    described in subparagraph (i) that is qualified transportation
    equipment within the meaning of subsection 127(9) of the Act;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} property included in Class 10 in Schedule II by
  virtue of paragraph (a) of that Class that is a bus designed for the
  purpose of seating 20 or more passengers and carrying their luggage,
  but not including

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a bus acquired principally for the purpose of
    transportation within any metropolitan area, city, town, village,
    municipality or other similar community or area, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a school bus;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} property that is

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a vessel included in Class 7 in Schedule II (other
    than a vessel under construction),

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} machinery or equipment included in Class 7 or 8 in
    Schedule II that is ancillary to and used as part of any property
    described in subparagraph (i) that is qualified transportation
    equipment within the meaning of subsection 127(9) of the Act, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a vessel included in a separate class prescribed
    by subsection 1101(2a);

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} property that is

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} included in Class 9 in Schedule II by virtue of
    paragraph (g) of that Class, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} machinery or equipment included in Class 9 in
    Schedule II by virtue of paragraph (h) or (i) of that Class that is
    ancillary to and used as part of any property described in
    subparagraph (i) that is qualified transportation equipment within
    the meaning of subsection 127(9) of the Act; and

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} property included in Class 8 in Schedule II that is a
  reusable cargo container designed with external fittings for the
  purpose of handling, securing or stacking and having a carrying
  capacity of 500 cubic feet or more.

### [Certified Property]{.HTitleText2} {#h-590053 .Subheading}

- **[[4602]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4602
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of the definition
  [[certified property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 127(9) of the
  Act, each of the following areas is a prescribed area:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that portion of the Province of Newfoundland
    comprising the census divisions 2 to 4 and 7 to 10;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that portion of the Province of Prince Edward
    Island comprising the Kings census division;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} that portion of the Province of Nova Scotia
    comprising the census divisions of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} Cape Breton,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} Guysborough,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} Inverness,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} Richmond, and

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} Victoria;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} that portion of the Province of New Brunswick
    comprising the census divisions of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} Gloucester,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} Kent,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} Madawaska,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} Northumberland, and

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} Restigouche;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} that portion of the Province of Quebec comprising

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} all of the area north of the 50th parallel of
      latitude, other than the area within the limits of the city of
      Sept-Iles,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the Magdalen Islands, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the census divisions of

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} Bonaventure,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} Gaspé-Est,

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} Gaspé-Ouest,

      - [(D)]{.lawlabel} Matane,

      - [(E)]{.lawlabel} Matapédia,

      - [(F)]{.lawlabel} Rimouski, other than the area within the limits
        of the city of Rimouski,

      - [(G)]{.lawlabel} Rivière-du-Loup, and

      - [(H)]{.lawlabel} Témiscouata;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} that portion of the Province of Ontario that is
    north of the 50th parallel of latitude;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} that portion of the Province of Manitoba comprising
    the census divisions 19 and 21 to 23, other than the area within the
    limits of the city of Thompson;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} that portion of the Province of Saskatchewan
    comprising the census division of Northern Saskatchewan;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} that portion of the Province of Alberta comprising
    the census division of Peace River, other than the area within the
    limits of the city of Grande Prairie;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} that portion of the Province of British Columbia
    comprising the Peace River-Liard census division; and

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} all of the Yukon Territory and the Northwest
    Territories.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), the expression
  "census divisions" has the same meaning as in the Dictionary of 1971
  Census Terms, Statistics Canada Catalogue Number 12-540, and the
  Census Divisions and Subdivisions, Statistics Canada Catalogues
  Numbered 92-704, 92-705, 92-706 and 92-707.

### [Qualified Construction Equipment]{.HTitleText2} {#h-590091 .Subheading}

**[[4603]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4603 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
the definition [[qualified construction equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}
in subsection 127(9) of the Act, [[prescribed
equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means depreciable property of a
taxpayer, other than qualified property as defined by subsection 127(9)
of the Act or qualified transportation equipment as defined by
subsection 127(9) of the Act, that is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a property included in Class 22 or 38 in Schedule II;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a crane;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a pile driver; or

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a dredge.

  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]

### [Approved Project Property]{.HTitleText2} {#h-590099 .Subheading}

- **[[4604]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4604
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraphs (a)
  and (c) of the definition [[approved project
  property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 127(9) of the Act,
  property is a prescribed building if it is depreciable property of the
  taxpayer that is a building or grain elevator, erected on land owned
  or leased by the taxpayer,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is included in Class 1, 3, 6, 24, 27 or 37 or
    paragraph (c), (d) or (e) of Class 8 in Schedule II; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is included or would, but for Class 28 or
    Class 41 in Schedule II, be included in paragraph (g) of Class 10 in
    Schedule II.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraphs (b) and (d) of the
  definition [[approved project property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in
  subsection 127(9) of the Act, property is prescribed machinery and
  equipment if it is depreciable property of the taxpayer (other than
  property referred to in subsection (1)) that is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a property included in paragraph (k) of Class 1 or
    paragraph (a) of Class 2 in Schedule II;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an oil or water storage tank;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a property included in Class 8 in Schedule II
    (other than railway rolling stock);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} subject to paragraph (e), a property included in
    paragraph (a) of Class 10 or Class 22 or 38 in Schedule II (other
    than a car or truck designed for use on highways or streets);

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a logging truck acquired to be used in the activity
    of logging and having a weight, including the weight of property the
    capital cost of which is included in the capital cost of the truck
    at the time of its acquisition (but for greater certainty not
    including the weight of fuel), in excess of 16,000 pounds;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a property included in any of paragraphs (b) to
    (f), (h) to (k), (o), (q), (r), (t) or (u) of Class 10 in Schedule
    II;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a property included in paragraph (n) of Class 10,
    or Class 15, in Schedule II (other than a roadway);

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a property included in any of paragraphs (a) to (f)
    of Class 9 in Schedule II;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a property included in Class 28 or 41 in Schedule
    II that would, but for that classes, be included in paragraph (k)
    or (r) of Class 10 in Schedule II;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a property included in any of Classes 21, 24, 27,
    29, 34, 39, 40 and 43 in Schedule II;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} a property included in Class 37 in Schedule II; or

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} a vessel (other than a supply boat, workboat,
    drilling rig, workover rig or shuttle tanker), including the
    furniture, fittings and equipment attached thereto, that is used
    primarily for

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} heavy-lifting or pipe-laying in the construction
      of, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the provision of lodging services in the
      servicing of,

    an installation, structure, apparatus or artificial island that is
    used for offshore hydrocarbon exploration or exploitation.

### [Prescribed Activities]{.HTitleText2} {#h-590122 .Subheading}

**[[4605]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4605 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
the definition [[for an approved purpose]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in
paragraph (e) of the definition [[approved project
property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 127(9) of the Act, a
prescribed activity of a taxpayer is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} operating a hotel, motel, camping ground, travel
  trailer park or any similar lodging facility;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} providing facilities that are ancillary to a lodging
  facility referred to in paragraph (a) that is owned by the taxpayer
  and that are intended for the use and enjoyment of the occupants of
  the lodging facility;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} providing facilities that are primarily for the
  receiving, storage and distribution of goods owned by persons with
  whom the taxpayer deals at arm's length;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} providing to a business owned by a person with whom
  the taxpayer deals at arm's length

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} engineering or architectural services,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} computer services, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} other technical or scientific services,

  but not including financial, legal, accounting, medical or dental
  services;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} providing to a business owned by a person with whom
  the taxpayer deals at arm's length

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the services of an employment agency, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} advertising services, other than advertising
    services in a medium owned by the taxpayer; or

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} operating a vessel described in paragraph 4604(2)(l).

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/86-1136, s. 7
:::

### [Prescribed Amount]{.HTitleText2} {#h-590138 .Subheading}

**[[4606]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4606 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
paragraph (b) of the definition [[contract payment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}
in subsection 127(9) of the Act, a prescribed amount is an amount
received from the Canadian Commercial Corporation in respect of an
amount received by that Corporation from a government, municipality or
other public authority other than the government of Canada or of a
province, a Canadian municipality or other Canadian public authority.

- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text

- SOR/94-686, s. 24(F)
:::

### [Prescribed Designated Regions]{.HTitleText2} {#h-590142 .Subheading}

**[[4607]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4607 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
the definition [[specified percentage]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in
subsection 127(9) of the Act, [[prescribed designated
region]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a region of Canada, other than the
Gaspé peninsula and the provinces of Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Prince
Edward Island, and Newfoundland, including Labrador, that was a
designated region on December 31, 1984, under the Regional Development
Incentives Designated Region Order, 1974.

### [Prescribed Expenditure for Qualified Canadian Exploration Expenditure]{.HTitleText2} {#h-590146 .Subheading}

- **[[4608]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4608 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  this section,

  [[joint exploration corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[joint exploration corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the
      meaning assigned by paragraph 66(15)(g) of the Act; ([société
      d'exploration en commun]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[principal-business corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[principal-business corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the
      meaning assigned by paragraph 66(15)(h) of the Act; ([société
      exploitant une entreprise principale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[shareholder corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[shareholder corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning
      assigned by paragraph 66(15)(i) of the Act; ([société
      actionnaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[well]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[well]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an exploratory probe or an oil
      or gas well. ([puits]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of the definition [[qualified
  Canadian exploration expenditure]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
  127(9) of the Act, the prescribed expenditure of a taxpayer for a
  taxation year is the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the
  amount, if any, by which

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the specified expenses of the taxpayer for the year
    in respect of the well

  exceed

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the base amount of the taxpayer at the end of the
    year in respect of the well.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, the specified
  expenses of a taxpayer for a taxation year in respect of a well that
  is an exploratory probe is the aggregate of all expenses that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} would be Canadian exploration expenses of the
    taxpayer by reason of any of subparagraphs 66.1(6)(a)(i), (iv)
    and (v) of the Act if the references in subparagraphs 66.1(6)(a)(iv)
    and (v) of the Act (as those subparagraphs read on November
    30, 1985) to "any of subparagraphs (i) to (iii.1)" were read as
    references to "subparagraph (i)";

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} were incurred

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the year, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} after November 1985 and before 1991;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} were incurred in the drilling or completing of the
    exploratory probe or in building a temporary access road to, or
    preparing the site in respect of, the probe; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} are not non-qualifying expenses of the taxpayer.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, the specified
  expenses of a taxpayer for a taxation year in respect of a well that
  is an oil or gas well is the aggregate of all expenses that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} would be Canadian exploration expenses of the
    taxpayer by virtue of any of subparagraphs 66.1(6)(a)(ii) to
    (ii.2), (iv) and (v) of the Act if the references in subparagraphs
    66.1(6)(a)(iv) and (v) of the Act (as those subparagraphs read on
    November 30, 1985) to "subparagraphs (i) to (iii.1)" were read as
    references to "subparagraphs (ii) to (ii.2)";

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} were incurred in respect of the well

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the year, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} after November 1985 and before 1991; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} are not non-qualifying expenses of the taxpayer.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsections (3) and (4), a
  non-qualifying expense of a taxpayer is an expense that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} may reasonably be regarded as having been incurred
    as consideration for services to be rendered after 1990 or for
    property that cannot reasonably be considered to be for use by the
    taxpayer before 1991;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} was or is to be renounced by the taxpayer at any
    time under subsection 66(10.1) or (12.6) of the Act;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is or was a Canadian exploration and development
    overhead expense, within the meaning of section 1206, of the
    taxpayer, of a partnership of which the taxpayer was a member or of
    a joint exploration corporation of which the taxpayer was a
    shareholder corporation;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} is an eligible cost or expense within the meaning
    of the Petroleum Incentives Program Act or the Petroleum Incentives
    Program Act, Chapter P-4.1 of the Statutes of Alberta, 1981, in
    respect of which, or in respect of part of which, the taxpayer, a
    partnership of which the taxpayer was a member, a joint exploration
    corporation of which the taxpayer was a shareholder corporation or a
    principal-business corporation of which the taxpayer was a
    shareholder, has received, is deemed to have received, is entitled
    to receive or may reasonably be expected to receive an incentive
    under either of those Acts; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} was included in determining the specified expenses
    of any other taxpayer for a taxation year.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, the base amount of
  a taxpayer at the end of a particular taxation year in respect of a
  well is the amount, if any, by which the taxpayer's threshold amount
  in respect of the well exceeds the aggregate of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} all amounts that would have been the taxpayer's
    specified expenses for any taxation year in respect of the well if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the references in subparagraphs (3)(b)(ii) and
      (4)(b)(ii) to "after November 1985 and before 1991" were read as
      "after March 1985 and before December 1985", and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} subsection (5) were read without reference to
      paragraph (d) thereof;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} all amounts referred to in paragraph (5)(d) for the
    particular taxation year or a preceding taxation year in respect of
    the well that would have been included in determining the taxpayer's
    specified expenses for the particular taxation year or the preceding
    taxation year but for that paragraph; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} all amounts that are the taxpayer's specified
    expenses for any preceding taxation year in respect of the well.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, the threshold
  amount of a taxpayer in respect of a well is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where no agreement has been filed with the Minister
    under subsection (8) in respect of the well, \$5,000,000; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where an agreement has been filed with the Minister
    under subsection (8) in respect of the well, the amount, if any,
    allocated to the taxpayer under the agreement.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, where the aggregate
  of all expenses in respect of a well, each of which

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} would be included in determining the specified
    expenses of a taxpayer for a taxation year in respect of the well if
    subsection (5) were read without reference to paragraph (d) thereof,
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} would be included in determining the specified
    expenses of a taxpayer for a taxation year in respect of the well if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the references in subparagraphs (3)(b)(ii) and
      (4)(b)(ii) to "after November 1985 and before 1991" were read as
      "after March 1985 and before December 1985", and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} subsection (5) were read without reference to
      paragraph (d) thereof,

  exceeds \$5,000,000, all taxpayers who have incurred those expenses or
  in whose favour or to whom any of those expenses have been renounced
  under subsection 66(10.1) or (12.6) of the Act may file with the
  Minister an agreement in writing in the prescribed form in respect of
  the well allocating amounts to some or all of those taxpayers if

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the amount allocated to each taxpayer does not
    exceed the total of such expenses that were incurred by the taxpayer
    in respect of the well, and that are not to be renounced by the
    taxpayer under subsection 66(10.1) or (12.6) of the Act in favour of
    or to any other person, and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of all amounts so allocated is not
    less than \$5,000,000.

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the drilling of a well (in this subsection referred
    to as the "abandoned well") is abandoned not because of the results
    obtained but because of geological or mechanical difficulties and
    the drilling of a new well (in this subsection referred to as the
    "new well") is commenced, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} having regard to all the circumstances, including
    the lapse of time between the abandonment of the abandoned well and
    the commencement of the new well and the proximity of the sites of
    the wells, it is reasonable to regard the new well as a replacement
    for the abandoned well,

  the abandoned well and the new well shall be deemed to be one well.

- [(10)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this section, where an expense of
  a joint exploration corporation is deemed by subsection 66(10.1) or
  (10.2) of the Act to be an expense of a shareholder corporation of the
  joint exploration corporation, the shareholder corporation shall be
  deemed to have incurred the expense at the time it was incurred by the
  joint exploration corporation.

- [(11)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this section, where an expense of
  a principal-business corporation is deemed by subsection 66(12.61) or
  (12.63) of the Act to be an expense of a shareholder of the
  corporation, the shareholder shall be deemed to have incurred the
  expense at the time it was incurred by the principal-business
  corporation.

- [(12)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, where an expense
  incurred by a partnership is, under subparagraph 66.1(6)(a)(iv) of the
  Act, a Canadian exploration expense of a taxpayer who was a member of
  the partnership, the taxpayer shall be deemed to have incurred the
  Canadian exploration expense at the time the expense was incurred by
  the partnership.

- [(13)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, where an expense
  is a Canadian development expense of a taxpayer that is, under
  subsection 66.1(9) of the Act, deemed to be a Canadian exploration
  expense of the taxpayer, the taxpayer shall be deemed to have incurred
  the Canadian exploration expense at the time the Canadian development
  expense was incurred.

### [Prescribed Offshore Region]{.HTitleText2} {#h-590203 .Subheading}

**[[4609]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4609 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
the definition [[specified percentage]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in
subsection 127(9) of the Act, the following region is a prescribed
offshore region:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} that submarine area, not within a province, adjacent
  to the coast of Canada and extending throughout the natural
  prolongation of that portion of the land territory of Canada
  comprising the Gaspé Peninsula and the provinces of Newfoundland,
  Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia and New Brunswick to the outer edge
  of the continental margin or to a distance of two hundred nautical
  miles from the baselines from which the territorial sea of Canada is
  measured, whichever is the greater; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the waters above the submarine area referred to in
  paragraph (a).

  text

- **[[4800]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4800
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subparagraph
  (b)(i) of the definition [[public corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in
  subsection 89(1) of the Act, the following conditions are prescribed
  in respect of a corporation other than a cooperative corporation
  (within the meaning assigned by section 136 of the Act) or a credit
  union:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a class of shares of the capital stock of the
    corporation designated by the corporation in its election or by the
    Minister in his notice to the corporation, as the case may be, shall
    be qualified for distribution to the public;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} there shall be no fewer than

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} where the shares of that class are equity shares,
      150, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, 300

    persons, other than insiders of the corporation, each of whom holds

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} not less than one block of shares of that
      class, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} shares of that class having an aggregate fair
      market value of not less than \$500; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} insiders of the corporation shall not hold more
    than 80 per cent of the issued and outstanding shares of that class.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subparagraph (c)(i) of the
  definition [[public corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
  89(1) of the Act, the following conditions are prescribed in respect
  of a corporation:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} insiders of the corporation shall hold more than 90
    per cent of the issued and outstanding shares of each class of
    shares of the capital stock of the corporation that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} was, at any time after the corporation last
      became a public corporation, listed on a designated stock exchange
      in Canada, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} was a class, designated as described in
      paragraph (1)(a), by virtue of which the corporation last became a
      public corporation;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of each class of shares described in
    subparagraph (a)(i) or (ii), there shall be fewer than

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} where the shares of that class are equity shares,
      50, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, 100

    persons, other than insiders of the corporation, each of whom holds

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} not less than one block of shares of that
      class, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} shares of that class having an aggregate fair
      market value of not less than \$500; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} there shall be no class of shares of the capital
    stock of the corporation that is qualified for distribution to the
    public and complies with the conditions described in paragraphs
    (1)(b) and (c).

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where, by virtue of an amalgamation (within the
  meaning assigned by section 87 of the Act) of predecessor corporations
  any one or more of which was, immediately before the amalgamation, a
  public corporation, shares of any class of the capital stock of any
  such public corporation that was

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} at any time after the corporation last became a
    public corporation, listed on a designated stock exchange in Canada,
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the class, designated as described in paragraph
    (1)(a), by virtue of which the corporation last became a public
    corporation,

  are converted into shares of any class (in this subsection referred to
  as the "new class") of the capital stock of the new corporation, the
  new class shall, for the purposes of subsection (2), be deemed to be a
  class, designated as described in paragraph (1)(a), by virtue of which
  the new corporation last became a public corporation.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Any election under subparagraphs (b)(i) or (c)(i) of
  the definition [[public corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in
  subsection 89(1) of the Act shall be made by filing with the Minister
  the following documents:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the form prescribed by the Minister;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the directors of the corporation are legally
    entitled to administer the affairs of the corporation, a certified
    copy of their resolution authorizing the election to be made;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} where the directors of the corporation are not
    legally entitled to administer the affairs of the corporation, a
    certified copy of the authorization of the making of the election by
    the person or persons legally entitled to administer the affairs of
    the corporation; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a statutory declaration made by a director of the
    corporation stating that, after reasonable inquiry for the purpose
    of informing himself in that regard, to the best of his knowledge
    the corporation complies with all the prescribed conditions that
    must be complied with at the time the election is made.

**[[4800.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4800.1 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes
of paragraph 107(1)(a) and subsections 107(1.1), (2) and (4.1) of the
Act, the following are prescribed trusts:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a trust maintained primarily for the benefit of
  employees of a corporation or two or more corporations which do not
  deal at arm's length with each other, where one of the main purposes
  of the trust is to hold interests in shares of the capital stock of
  the corporation or corporations, as the case may be, or any
  corporation not dealing at arm's length therewith;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a trust established exclusively for the benefit of
  one or more persons each of whom was, at the time the trust was
  created, either a person from whom the trust received property or a
  creditor of that person, where one of the main purposes of the trust
  is to secure the payments required to be made by or on behalf of that
  person to such creditor; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a trust all or substantially all of the properties of
  which consist of shares of the capital stock of a corporation, where
  the trust was established pursuant to an agreement between two or more
  shareholders of the corporation and one of the main purposes of the
  trust is to provide for the exercise of voting rights in respect of
  those shares pursuant to that agreement.

**[[4801]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4801 .sectionLabel}** In applying at any
time paragraph 132(6)(c) of the Act, the following are prescribed
conditions in respect of a trust:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} either

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the following conditions are met:

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} there has been at or before that time a lawful
      distribution in a province to the public of units of the trust and
      a prospectus, registration statement or similar document was not,
      under the laws of the province, required to be filed in respect of
      the distribution, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the trust

      - [(I)]{.lawlabel} was created after 1999 and on or before that
        time, or

      - [(II)]{.lawlabel} satisfies, at that time, the conditions
        prescribed in section 4801.001, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a class of the units of the trust is, at that
    time, qualified for distribution to the public; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a class of the trust's units that meets
  at that time the conditions described in paragraph (a), there are at
  that time no fewer than 150 beneficiaries of the trust, each of whom
  holds

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} not less than one block of units of the class, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} units of the class having an aggregate fair market
    value of not less than \$500.

- **[[4802]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4802
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of clause
  149(1)(o.2)(iv)(D) of the Act, the following are prescribed persons:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a trust all the beneficiaries of which are trusts
    described in clause 149(1)(o.2)(iv)(B) of the Act;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a corporation incorporated before November 17, 1978
    solely in connection with, or for the administration of, a
    registered pension plan;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a trust or corporation established by or arising by
    virtue of an act of a province the principal activities of which are
    to administer, manage or invest the monies of a pension fund or plan
    that is established pursuant to an act of the province or an order
    or regulation made thereunder;

  - [(c.1)]{.lawlabel} the Canada Pension Plan Investment Board;

  - [(c.2)]{.lawlabel} the Public Sector Pension Investment Board;

  - [(c.3)]{.lawlabel} a pooled registered pension plan;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a trust or corporation established by or arising by
    virtue of an act of a province in connection with a scheme or
    program for the compensation of workers injured in an accident
    arising out of or in the course of their employment;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} Her Majesty in right of a province;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a trust all of the beneficiaries of which are any
    combination of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} registered pension plans,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} trusts described in clause 149(1)(o.2)(iv)(B)
      or (C) of the Act, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} persons described in this subsection;

  - [(f.1)]{.lawlabel} the Pension Benefits Guarantee Fund under the
    Pension Benefits Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. P.8 and any corporation
    established solely for investing the assets of the Pension Benefits
    Guarantee Fund; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a corporation all of the shares of the capital
    stock of which are owned by one or more of the following:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} registered pension plans,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} trusts described in clause 149(1)(o.2)(iv)(B)
      or (C) of the Act, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} persons described in this subsection.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subparagraph 127.55(f)(iii) and
  paragraphs 149(1)(o.4) and 150(1.2)(i) of the Act, a trust is
  prescribed at any particular time if, at all times after its creation
  and before the particular time,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it was resident in Canada;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} its only undertaking was the investing of its
    funds;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} it never borrowed money except where the borrowing
    was for a term not exceeding 90 days and it is established that the
    borrowing was not part of a series of loans or other transactions
    and repayments;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} it never accepted deposits; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} each of the beneficiaries of the trust was a trust
    governed by a deferred profit sharing plan, a pooled registered
    pension plan or a registered pension plan.

- [(1.2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraph 8502(i.2), if an
  amount is borrowed (other than an amount described in paragraph
  (1.1)(c)) at a particular time by a trust described in subsection
  (1.1) in relation to defined benefit provisions of one or more
  registered pension plans that are beneficiaries of the trust, each
  such defined benefit provision is deemed to have borrowed at the
  particular time an amount that is equal to the following amount:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if paragraph (b) does not apply, the amount
    determined by the formula

    ::: {#1417506 .Paragraph}
    A × (B ÷ C)

    where

    [A]{.dfn}
    :   is the amount borrowed by the trust at the particular time,

    [B]{.dfn}
    :   is the fair market value at the particular time of the interest
        of the defined benefit provision in
        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if the borrowing relates to a particular
          class of units of the trust, that class of units, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, the income and capital of
          the trust, and

    [C]{.dfn}
    :   is the fair market value at the particular time of all interests
        of defined benefit provisions in
        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if the borrowing relates to a particular
          class of units of the trust, that class of units, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, the income and capital of
          the trust; and
    :::

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the portion of the amount borrowed by the trust at
    the particular time that is allocated to the defined benefit
    provision under an agreement entered into between the trust and the
    defined benefit provision, provided that the agreement allocates to
    the beneficiaries the total amount borrowed by the trust.

- [(1.3)]{.lawlabel} If an amount borrowed by a trust is deemed to have
  been borrowed by a defined benefit provision under subsection (1.2),
  the amount is deemed not to have been borrowed by the trust for the
  purposes of paragraph (1.1)(c).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2017, c. 20, s. 33\]]{.Repealed}

- **[[4803]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4803 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  this Part,

  [[block of shares]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[block of shares]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, with respect to any
      class of the capital stock of a corporation,

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 100 shares, if the fair market value of one
        share of the class is less than \$25,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 25 shares, if the fair market value of one
        share of the class is \$25 or more but less than \$100, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} 10 shares, if the fair market value of one
        share of the class is \$100 or more; ([tranche
        d'actions]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[block of units]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[block of units]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, with respect to any
      class of units of a trust,

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 100 units, if the fair market value of one unit
        of the class is less than \$25,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 25 units, if the fair market value of one unit
        of the class is \$25 or more but less than \$100, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} 10 units, if the fair market value of one unit
        of the class is \$100 or more; ([tranche
        d'unités]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[equity share]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[equity share]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning assigned by
      section 204 of the Act; ([action à revenu
      variable]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[insider of a corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[insider of a corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning
      that would be assigned by section 100 of the [Canada Corporations
      Act](/eng/acts/C-1.8), as it read on June 22, 2009, if the
      references in that section to "insider of a company", "public
      company" and "equity shares" were read as references to "insider
      of a corporation", "corporation" and "shares" respectively, and
      includes a person who is an employee of the corporation, or of a
      person who does not deal at arm's length with the corporation, and
      whose right to sell or transfer any share of the capital stock of
      the corporation, or to exercise the voting rights, if any,
      attaching to the share, is restricted by

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the terms and conditions attaching to the
        share, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any obligation of the person, under a contract,
        in equity or otherwise, to the corporation or to any person with
        whom the corporation does not deal at arm's length. ([dirigeant
        d'une société]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, a class of shares of
  the capital stock of a corporation or a class of units of a trust is
  qualified for distribution to the public only if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a prospectus, registration statement or similar
    document has been filed with, and, where required by law, accepted
    for filing by, a public authority in Canada pursuant to and in
    accordance with the law of Canada or of any province and there has
    been a lawful distribution to the public of shares or units of that
    class in accordance with that document;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the class is a class of shares, any of which were
    issued by the corporation at any time after 1971 while it was a
    public corporation in exchange for shares of any other class of the
    capital stock of the corporation that was, immediately before the
    exchange, qualified for distribution to the public;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of any class of shares, any of which
    were issued and outstanding on January 1, 1972, the class complied
    on that date with the conditions described in paragraphs 4800(1)(b)
    and (c); or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of any class of units, any of which
    were issued and outstanding on January 1, 1972, the class complied
    on that date with the condition described in paragraph 4801(b).

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraphs 4800(1)(b), 4800(2)(b)
  and 4801(b), where a group of persons holds

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} not less than one block of shares of any class of
    shares of the capital stock of a corporation or one block of units
    of any class of a trust, as the case may be, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} shares or units, as the case may be, of that class
    having an aggregate fair market value of not less than \$500,

  that group shall, subject to subsection (4), be deemed to be one
  person for the purposes of determining the number of persons who hold
  shares or units, as the case may be, of that class.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} In determining under subsection (3) the persons who
  belong to a group for the purposes of determining the number of
  persons who hold shares or units, as the case may be, of a particular
  class, the following rules apply:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} no person shall be included in more than one group;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} no person shall be included in a group if he holds

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} not less than one block of shares or one block of
      units, as the case may be, of that class, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} shares or units, as the case may be, of that
      class having an aggregate fair market value of not less than
      \$500; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the membership of each group shall be determined in
    the manner that results in the greatest possible number of groups.

- **[[4900]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4900
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraph (d) of
  the definition [[qualified investment]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in
  subsection 146(1) of the Act, paragraph (e) of the definition
  [[qualified investment]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection 146.1(1)
  of the Act, paragraph (c) of the definition [[qualified
  investment]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection 146.3(1) of the Act,
  paragraph (d) of the definition [[qualified
  investment]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection 146.4(1) of the Act,
  paragraph (h) of the definition [[qualified
  investment]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in section 204 of the Act and
  paragraph (c) of the definition [[qualified
  investment]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection 207.01(1) of the Act,
  each of the following investments is prescribed as a qualified
  investment for a plan trust at a particular time if at that time it is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an interest in a trust or a share of the capital
    stock of a corporation that was a registered investment for the plan
    trust during the calendar year in which the particular time occurs
    or the immediately preceding year;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a share of the capital stock of a public
    corporation other than a mortgage investment corporation;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a share of the capital stock of a mortgage
    investment corporation that does not hold as part of its property at
    any time during the calendar year in which the particular time
    occurs any indebtedness, whether by way of mortgage or otherwise, of
    a person who is a connected person under the governing plan of the
    plan trust;

  - [(c.1)]{.lawlabel} a bond, debenture, note or similar obligation of
    a public corporation other than a mortgage investment corporation;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a unit of a mutual fund trust;

  - [(d.1)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2007, c. 29, s. 32\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(d.2)]{.lawlabel} a unit of a trust if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the trust would be a mutual fund trust if Part
      XLVIII were read without reference to paragraph 4801(a), and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} there has been a lawful distribution in a
      province to the public of units of the trust and a prospectus,
      registration statement or similar document was not required under
      the laws of the province to be filed in respect of the
      distribution;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} an option, a warrant or a similar right (each of
    which is, in this paragraph, referred to as the "security") issued
    by a person or partnership (in this paragraph referred to as the
    "issuer") that gives the holder the right to acquire, either
    immediately or in the future, property all of which is a qualified
    investment for the plan trust or to receive a cash settlement in
    lieu of delivery of that property, where

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the property is

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} a share of the capital stock of, a unit of, or
        a debt issued by, the issuer or another person or partnership
        that does not, when the security is issued, deal at arm's length
        with the issuer, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} a warrant issued by the issuer or another
        person or partnership that does not, when the security is
        issued, deal at arm's length with the issuer, that gives the
        holder the right to acquire a share or unit described in clause
        (A), and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the issuer is not a connected person under the
      governing plan of the plan trust;

  - [(e.01)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2007, c. 29, s. 32\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(e.1)]{.lawlabel} a share of, or deposit with, a société d'entraide
    économique,

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a share of, or similar interest in a credit union;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a bond, debenture, note or similar obligation (in
    this paragraph referred to as the "obligation") issued by, or a

    calendar year in which the particular time occurs granted any
    benefit or privilege to a person who is a connected person under the
    governing plan of the plan trust, as a result of the ownership by

    and a credit union shall be deemed to have granted a benefit or

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a bond, debenture, note or similar obligation (in

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} that throughout the taxation year of the

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the last taxation year, if any, of the

      whichever of the periods referred to in clause (A) or (B)

  investment]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection 146.3(1) of the Act
  and paragraph (c) of the definition [[qualified
  investment]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection 207.01(1) of the Act,
  a property is prescribed as a qualified investment for a trust
  governed by a FHSA, RESP, RRIF, RRSP or TFSA at any time if, at the
  time the property was acquired by the trust, the property

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} was

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a share of the capital stock of a specified small
      business corporation,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a share of the capital stock of a venture
      capital corporation described in any of sections 6700 to 6700.2,
      or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a qualifying share in respect of a specified
      cooperative corporation and the FHSA, RESP, RRIF, RRSP or TFSA;
      and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} was not a prohibited investment for the trust.

- [(15)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of the definition [[prohibited
  investment]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection 207.01(1) of the Act,
  property that is a qualified investment for a trust governed by a
  FHSA, RESP, RRIF, RRSP or TFSA solely because of subsection (14) is
  prescribed property for the trust at any time if, at that time, the
  property is not described in any of subparagraphs (14)(a)(i) to (iii).

### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-590502 .Subheading}

- **[[4901]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4901
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraphs
  204.4(2)(b), (d) and (f) and of subsection 204.6(1) of the Act, a
  property is a prescribed investment for a corporation or trust, as the
  case may be, if it is a qualified investment for a plan or fund
  described in paragraphs 204.4(1)(a) to (d) of the Act in respect of
  which the corporation or trust is seeking registration or has been
  registered, as the case may be.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/94-471, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} In this Part,

  [[allocation in proportion to patronage]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[allocation in proportion to patronage]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has
      the meaning assigned by subsection 135(4) of the
      Act; ([répartition proportionnelle à l'apport
      commercial]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[connected person]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[connected person]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} under a governing plan of
      a plan trust means a person who is an annuitant, a beneficiary, an
      employer or a subscriber under, or a holder of, the governing plan
      and any person who does not deal at arm's length with that
      person; ([personne rattachée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[connected shareholder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[connected shareholder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a corporation at
      any time is a person (other than an exempt person in respect of
      the corporation) who owns, directly or indirectly, at that time,
      not less than 10% of the issued shares of any class of the capital
      stock of the corporation or of any other corporation that is
      related to the corporation and, for the purposes of this
      definition,

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} paragraphs (a) to (e) of the definition
        [[specified shareholder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
        248(1) of the Act apply, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an exempt person in respect of a corporation is
        a person who deals at arm's length with the corporation where
        the total of all amounts, each of which is the cost amount of
        any share of the capital stock of the corporation, or of any
        other corporation that is related to it, that the person owns or
        is deemed to own for the purposes of the definition [[specified
        shareholder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 248(1) of the
        Act, is less than \$25,000; ([actionnaire
        rattaché]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[consumer goods or services]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[consumer goods or services]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning
      assigned by subsection 135(4) of the Act; ([marchandises de
      consommation ou services]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[designated shareholder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[designated shareholder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a corporation at
      any time means a taxpayer who at that time

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is, or is related to, a person (other than an
        exempt person) who owns, directly or indirectly, not less than
        10% of the issued shares of any class of the capital stock of
        the corporation or of any other corporation that is related to
        the corporation and, for the purposes of this definition,

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} paragraphs (a) to (e) of the definition
          [[specified shareholder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
          248(1) of the Act apply, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an exempt person in respect of a corporation
          is a person who deals at arm's length with the corporation
          where the total of all amounts, each of which is the cost
          amount of any share of the capital stock of the corporation,
          or of any other corporation that is related to it, that the
          person owns or is deemed to own for the purposes of the
          definition [[specified shareholder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in
          subsection 248(1) of the Act, is less than \$25,000,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is or is related to a member of a partnership
        that controls the corporation,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is or is related to a beneficiary under a trust
        that controls the corporation,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} is or is related to an employee of the
        corporation or a corporation related thereto, where any group of
        employees of the corporation or of the corporation related
        thereto, as the case may be, controls the corporation, except
        where the group of employees includes a person or a related
        group that controls the corporation, or

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} does not deal at arm's length with the
        corporation; ([actionnaire désigné]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[governing plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[governing plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a deferred profit
      sharing plan or a revoked plan, a FHSA, a registered disability
      savings plan, a registered education savings plan, a registered
      retirement income fund, a registered retirement savings plan or a
      TFSA; ([régime d'encadrement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[plan trust]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[plan trust]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a trust governed by a
      governing plan; ([fiducie de régime]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[qualifying share]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[qualifying share]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a
      specified cooperative corporation and a governing plan, means a
      share of the capital or capital stock of the corporation where

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} ownership of the share or a share identical to
        the share is not a condition of membership in the corporation,
        or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a connected person under the governing plan

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} has not received a payment from the
          corporation pursuant to an allocation in proportion to
          patronage in respect of consumer goods or services, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} can reasonably be expected not to receive a
          payment, after the acquisition of the share by the plan trust,
          from the corporation pursuant to an allocation in proportion
          to patronage in respect of consumer goods or services; ([part
          admissible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[revoked plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[revoked plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning assigned by
      section 204 of the Act; ([régime dont l'agrément est
      retiré]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[small business investment limited partnership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[small business investment limited
      partnership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning assigned by
      subsection 5102(1); ([société de personnes en commandite de
      placement dans des petites entreprises]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[small business investment trust]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[small business investment trust]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the
      meaning assigned by subsection 5103(1); ([fiducie de placement
      dans des petites entreprises]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[small business security]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[small business security]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning
      assigned by subsection 5100(2); ([titre de petite
      entreprise]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[specified cooperative corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specified cooperative corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a cooperative corporation within the meaning
        assigned by subsection 136(2) of the Act, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a corporation that would be a cooperative
        corporation within the meaning assigned by subsection 136(2) of
        the Act if the purpose described in that subsection were the
        purpose of providing employment to the corporation's members or
        customers; ([coopérative déterminée]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[specified small business corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specified small business corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, at
      any time, means a corporation (other than a cooperative
      corporation) that would, at that time or at the end of the last
      taxation year of the corporation that ended before that time, be a
      small business corporation if the expression "Canadian-controlled
      private corporation" in the definition [[small business
      corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 248(1) of the Act
      were read as "Canadian corporation (other than a corporation
      controlled at that time, directly or indirectly in any manner
      whatever, by one or more non-resident persons)". ([société
      déterminée exploitant une petite entreprise]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

- [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of the definition [[connected
  shareholder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection (2) and of subsection
  (2.2), each share of the capital of a specified cooperative
  corporation and all other shares of the capital of the corporation
  that have attributes identical to the attributes of that share shall
  be deemed to be shares of a class of the capital stock of the
  corporation.

- [(2.2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this Part, a person is deemed to
  be a connected shareholder of a corporation at any time where the
  person would be a connected shareholder of the corporation at that
  time if, at that time,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person had each right that the person would be
    deemed to own at that time for the purposes of the definition
    [[specified shareholder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 248(1)
    of the Act if that right were a share of the capital stock of a
    corporation;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the person owned each share of a class of the
    capital stock of a corporation that the person had a right at that
    time under a contract, in equity or otherwise, either immediately or
    in the future and either absolutely or contingently, to acquire; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the cost amount to the person of a share referred
    to in paragraph (b) were the cost amount to the person of the right
    to which the share relates.

- [(2.3)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this Part, a person is deemed to
  be a designated shareholder of a corporation at any time if the person
  would be a designated shareholder of the corporation at that time if,
  at that time, paragraphs (2.2)(a) to (c) applied in respect of that
  person.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2005-264, s. 7\]]{.Repealed}
