## [PART LI]{.HLabel1}[Deferred Income Plans, Investments in Small Business]{.HTitleText1} {#h-590555 .Part}

- **[[5100]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-5100 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  this Part,

  [[designated rate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[designated rate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, at any time, means 150
      per cent of the highest of the prime rates generally quoted at
      that time by the banks to which Schedule A to the [Bank
      Act](/eng/acts/B-1.01) applies; ([taux déterminé]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[eligible corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[eligible corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, at any time, means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a particular corporation that is a taxable
        Canadian corporation all or substantially all of the property of
        which is at that time

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} used in a qualifying active business carried
          on by the particular corporation or by a corporation
          controlled by it,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} shares of the capital stock of one or more
          eligible corporations that are related to the particular
          corporation, or debt obligations issued by those eligible
          corporations, or

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} any combination of the properties described
          in subparagraphs (i) and (ii),

      - [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} a specified holding corporation, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a venture capital corporation described in
        section 6700,

      but does not include

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a corporation (other than a mutual fund
        corporation) that is

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a trader or dealer in securities,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a bank,

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a corporation licensed or otherwise
          authorized under the laws of Canada or a province to carry on
          in Canada the business of offering to the public its services
          as a trustee,

        - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a credit union,

        - [(v)]{.lawlabel} an insurance corporation, or

        - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} a corporation the principal business of
          which is the lending of money or the purchasing of debt
          obligations or a combination of them,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a corporation controlled by one or more
        non-resident persons,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a venture capital corporation, other than a
        venture capital corporation described in section 6700, or

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a corporation that has made an election in
        respect of a particular taxation year under subparagraph (iv) of
        the description of B in paragraph 204.82(2.2)(c.1) of the Act,
        if that time is in the 12-month period that begins on the day
        that is six months after the day on which the particular
        taxation year ends; ([société admissible]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[qualifying active business]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[qualifying active business]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, at any time,
      means any business carried on primarily in Canada by a
      corporation, but does not include

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a business (other than a business of leasing
        property other than real property) the principal purpose of
        which is to derive income from property (including interest,
        dividends, rent and royalties), or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a business of deriving gains from the
        disposition of property (other than property in the inventory of
        the business),

      and, for the purposes of this definition, a business carried on
      primarily in Canada by a corporation, at any time, includes a
      business carried on by the corporation if, at that time,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} at least 50 per cent of the full time employees
        of the corporation and all corporations related thereto employed
        in respect of the business are employed in Canada, or

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} at least 50 per cent of the salaries and wages
        paid to employees of the corporation and all corporations
        related thereto employed in respect of the business are
        reasonably attributable to services rendered in
        Canada; ([entreprise admissible exploitée
        activement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[qualifying obligation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[qualifying obligation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, at any time, means
      a bond, debenture, mortgage, note or other similar obligation of a
      corporation described in paragraph 149(1)(o.2) or (o.3) of the
      Act, if

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the obligation was issued by the corporation
        after October 31, 1985,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the corporation used all or substantially all
        of the proceeds of the issue of the obligation within 90 days
        after the receipt thereof to acquire

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} small business securities,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} interests of a limited partner in small
          business investment limited partnerships,

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} interests in small business investment
          trusts, or

        - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} any combination of the properties described
          in subparagraphs (i) to (iii)

        and, except as provided in subsection 5104(1), the corporation
        was the first person (other than a broker or dealer in
        securities) to have acquired the properties and the corporation
        has owned the properties continuously since they were so
        acquired,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the corporation does not hold, and no group of
        persons who do not deal with each other at arm's length and of
        which it is a member holds, more than 30 per cent of the
        outstanding shares of any class of voting stock of another
        corporation, except where all or any part of those shares were
        acquired in specified circumstances, within the meaning of
        subsection 5104(2),

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the recourse of the holder of the obligation
        against the corporation with respect to the obligation is
        limited to the properties acquired with the proceeds of the
        issue of the obligation and any properties substituted therefor,
        and

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the properties acquired with the proceeds of
        the issue of the obligation have not been disposed of, unless
        the disposition occurred within the 90 day period immediately
        preceding that time; ([titre admissible]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[specified holding corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specified holding corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, at any
      time, means a taxable Canadian corporation where

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} all or substantially all of the collective
        property of the corporation and of all other corporations
        controlled by it (each of which other corporations is referred
        to in this definition as a "controlled corporation"), other than
        shares in the capital stock of the corporation or of a
        corporation related to it and debt obligations issued by it or
        by a corporation related to it, is at that time used in a
        qualifying active business carried on by the corporation, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} all or substantially all of the property of the
        corporation is at that time

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} property used in a qualifying active business
          carried on by the corporation or a controlled corporation,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} shares of the capital stock of one or more
          controlled corporations or eligible corporations related to
          the corporation,

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} debt obligations issued by one or more
          controlled corporations or eligible corporations related to
          the corporation, or

        - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} any combination of the properties described
          in subparagraphs (i), (ii) and (iii),

      and in a determination of whether property is used in a qualifying
      active business for the purposes of paragraph (a),

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} where a business is carried on by a controlled
        corporation,

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the business shall be deemed to be a business
          carried on only by the corporation, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the controlled corporation shall be deemed
          to be the corporation in the application of paragraphs (c)
          and (d) of the definition [[qualifying active
          business]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, and

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} if a business of the corporation is
        substantially similar to one or more other businesses of the
        corporation, all those businesses shall be deemed collectively
        to be one business of the corporation; ([société de portefeuille
        déterminé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[specified property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specified property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means property
      described in any of paragraphs (a), (b), (c), (f) and (g) of the
      definition [[qualified investment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in section
      204 of the Act. ([bien déterminé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part and clause (b)(iii)(A)
  of the definition [[eligible investment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in
  subsection 204.8(1) of the Act, a small business security of a person,
  at any time, is property of that person that is, at that time,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a share of the capital stock of an eligible
    corporation,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a debt obligation of an eligible corporation (other
    than a venture capital corporation described in section 6700) that
    does not by its terms or any agreement related to the obligation
    restrict the corporation from incurring other debts and that is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} secured solely by a floating charge on the assets
      of the corporation and that by its terms or any agreement related
      thereto is subordinate to all other debt obligations of the
      corporation (other than a small business security issued by the
      corporation, or a debt obligation that is owing by the corporation
      to a shareholder of the corporation or a person related to a
      shareholder of the corporation and that is not secured in any
      manner whatever), or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} not secured in any manner whatever,

    other than a debt obligation that

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} where the debt obligation specifies an
      invariant rate of interest, has an effective annual rate of return
      that exceeds the designated rate for the day on which the
      obligation was issued, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, may have an effective annual
      rate of return at a particular time that exceeds the designated
      rate at the particular time,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an option or right granted by an eligible
    corporation in conjunction with the issue of a share or debt
    obligation that qualifies as a small business security to acquire a
    share of the capital stock of the corporation, or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an option or right granted for no consideration by
    an eligible corporation to a holder of a share that qualifies as a
    small business security to acquire a share of the capital stock of
    the corporation

  if, immediately after the time of acquisition thereof,

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of the cost amounts to the person of
    all shares, options, rights and debt obligations of the eligible
    corporation and all corporations associated therewith held by the
    person does not exceed \$10,000,000, and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the total assets (determined in accordance with
    generally accepted accounting principles, on a consolidated or
    combined basis, where applicable) of the eligible corporation and
    all corporations associated with it do not exceed \$50,000,000

  and includes

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} property of the person that is, at that time,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a qualifying obligation, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2005-264, s. 10\]]{.Repealed}

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a security (in this subparagraph referred to as
      the "new security") described in any of paragraphs (a) to (d),
      where the new security was issued at a particular time

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} in exchange for, on the conversion of, or in
        respect of rights pertaining to a security (in this paragraph
        referred to as the "former security") that would, if this
        subsection were read without reference to this subparagraph and
        paragraph (h), be a small business security of the person
        immediately before the particular time, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} pursuant to an agreement entered into before
        the particular time and at or before the time that the former
        security was last acquired by the person, or

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} where the person is a small business investment
    corporation, small business investment limited partnership or small
    business investment trust, property of the person that is, at that
    time, a security (in this paragraph referred to as the "new
    security") described in any of paragraphs (a) to (d), where the new
    security was issued at a particular time not more than 5 years
    before that time in exchange for, on the conversion of, or in
    respect of rights pertaining to a security that would, if this
    subsection were read without reference to this paragraph, be a small
    business security of the person immediately before the particular
    time.

- [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} Where all or part of the property of a person
  consists of the shares of the capital stock of a venture capital
  corporation described in section 6700, options or rights granted by
  the corporation, or debt obligations of the corporation,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of the cost amounts to the person of
    all such property shall be deemed for the purposes of paragraph
    (2)(e) not to exceed \$10,000,000; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the total assets (determined in accordance with
    generally accepted accounting principles, on a consolidated or
    combined basis, where applicable) of the corporation and all
    corporations associated with it shall be deemed for the purposes of
    paragraph (2)(f) not to exceed \$50,000,000.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (2),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in determining the effective annual rate of return
    in respect of a debt obligation of an eligible corporation, the
    value of any right to convert the debt obligation or any part
    thereof into, or to exchange the debt obligation or any part thereof
    for, shares of the capital stock of the corporation or an option or
    right to acquire such shares shall not be considered; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a corporation shall be deemed not to be associated
    with another at any time where the corporation would not be
    associated with the other if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the references to "controlled, directly or
      indirectly, in any manner whatever" in section 256 of the Act
      (other than subsection (5.1) thereof) were read as references to
      "controlled", and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} such rights described in subsection 256(1.4) of
      the Act and shares, as were held at that time by a small business
      investment corporation, small business investment limited
      partnership or small business investment trust, were disregarded.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2005-264, s. 10\]]{.Repealed}

- **[[5101]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-5101
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (4), for the
  purposes of this Part and paragraph 149(1)(o.3) and paragraph (b) of
  the definition [[small business property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in
  subsection 206(1) of the Act, a corporation is a small business
  investment corporation at any time if it is a Canadian corporation
  incorporated after May 22, 1985 and at all times after it was
  incorporated and before that time

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} all of the shares, and rights to acquire shares, of
    the capital stock of the corporation were owned by

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} one or more registered pension plans,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} one or more trusts all the beneficiaries of
      which were registered pension plans,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} one or more related segregated fund trusts
      (within the meaning assigned by paragraph 138.1(1)(a) of the Act)
      all the beneficiaries of which were registered pension plans, or

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} one or more persons prescribed by section 4802
      for the purposes of clause 149(1)(o.2)(iv)(D) of the Act;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} its only undertaking was the investing of its funds
    and its investments consisted solely of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} small business securities,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} interests of a limited partner in small business
      investment limited partnerships,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} interests in small business investment trusts,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} property (other than a small business security)
      that is

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} a share of the capital stock of a corporation
        (other than a share that is issued to the corporation and that
        is either a share described in section 66.3 of the Act or a
        share in respect of which an amount has been designated under
        subsection 192(4) of the Act), or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} a put, call, warrant or other right to acquire
        or sell a share described by clause (A),

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} specified properties, or

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} any combination of properties described in any
      of subparagraphs (i) to (v)

    and, except as provided in subsection 5104(1), with respect to
    properties referred to in any of subparagraphs (i) to (iii), the
    corporation was the first person (other than a broker or dealer in
    securities) to have acquired the properties and the corporation has
    owned the properties continuously since they were so acquired;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} it has complied with subsection (2);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} it did not hold, and no group of persons who did
    not deal with each other at arm's length and of which it was a
    member held, more than 30 per cent of the outstanding shares of any
    class of voting stock of a corporation, except where

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} all or any part of those shares were acquired in
      specified circumstances within the meaning of subsection 5104(2),
      or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} those shares were of any class of voting stock
      of a venture capital corporation described in section 6700;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} it has not borrowed money except from its
    shareholders; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} it has not accepted deposits.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every small business investment corporation shall at
  all times hold properties referred to in subparagraphs (1)(b)(i) to
  (iii), the aggregate of the cost amounts of which is not less than 75
  per cent of the amount, if any, by which

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the
    amount of consideration for the issue of shares of its capital stock
    or debt to its shareholders or the amount of a contribution of
    capital by its shareholders received by it more than 90 days before
    that time

  exceeds

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} all amounts paid by it before that time to its
      shareholders as a return of capital or a repayment of debt, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount, if any, by which the aggregate of
      its losses from the disposition of properties disposed of before
      that time exceeds the aggregate of its gains from the disposition
      of properties disposed of before that time.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (2), where a small
  business investment corporation disposes of a property referred to in
  subparagraphs (1)(b)(i) to (iii), it shall be deemed to continue to
  hold the investment for a period of 90 days following the date of the
  disposition.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraph 149(1)(o.3) of the Act,
  where a small business investment corporation holds an interest in a
  partnership or trust that qualified as a small business investment
  limited partnership or small business investment trust, as the case
  may be, when the interest was acquired and that, but for this
  subsection, would cease at a subsequent time to so qualify, the
  interest in the partnership or trust shall be deemed to be an interest
  in a small business investment limited partnership or small business
  investment trust, as the case may be, for the 24 months immediately
  following the subsequent time.

- **[[5102]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-5102
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this Part, a
  partnership is a small business investment limited partnership at any
  particular time if at all times after it was formed and before the
  particular time

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it had only one general partner;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the share of the general partner, as general
    partner, in any income of the partnership from any source in any
    place, for any period, was the same as his share, as general
    partner, in

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the income of the partnership from that source in
      any other place,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the income of the partnership from any other
      source,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the loss of the partnership from any source,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} any capital gain of the partnership, and

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} any capital loss of the partnership

    for that period, except that the share of the general partner, as
    general partner, in the income or loss of the partnership from
    specified properties may differ from his share, as general partner,
    in the income or loss of the partnership from other sources;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the share of the general partner, as general
    partner, in any income or loss of the partnership for any period was
    not less than his share, as general partner, in the income or loss
    of the partnership for any preceding period;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the interests of the limited partners were
    described by reference to units of the partnership that were
    identical in all respects;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} no limited partner or group of limited partners who
    did not deal with each other at arm's length held more than 30 per
    cent of the units of the partnership and, for the purposes of this
    paragraph,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a small business investment corporation that has
      not borrowed money and in which no shareholder or group of
      shareholders who did not deal with each other at arm's length held
      more than 30 per cent of the outstanding shares of any class of
      voting stock shall be deemed not to be a limited partner, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the general partner shall be deemed not to hold
      any unit of the partnership as a limited partner;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} its only undertaking was the investing of its funds
    and its investments consisted solely of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} small business securities where, except as
      provided in subsection 5104(1), the partnership was the first
      person (other than a broker or dealer in securities) to have
      acquired the securities and it has owned the securities
      continuously since they were so acquired,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} property (other than a small business security)
      that is

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} a share of the capital stock of a corporation
        (other than a share that is issued to the partnership and that
        is either a share described in section 66.3 of the Act or a
        share in respect of which an amount has been designated under
        subsection 192(4) of the Act), or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} a put, call, warrant or other right to acquire
        or sell a share described by clause (A),

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} specified properties, or

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} any combination of properties described in any
      of subparagraphs (i) to (iii);

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} it has complied with subsection (2);

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} it has not borrowed money except for the purpose of
    earning income from its investments and the amount of any such
    borrowings at any time did not exceed 20 per cent of the partnership
    capital at that time; and

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it has not accepted deposits.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The aggregate of the cost amounts to a small business
  investment limited partnership of small business securities held by it
  at any time shall not be less than the amount, if any, by which the
  aggregate of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 25 per cent of the amount, if any, by which

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of all amounts received by it more
      than 12 months before that time and not more than 24 months before
      that time as consideration for the issue of its units or in
      respect of its units

    exceeds

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of all amounts paid by it before
      that time to its members and designated by the partnership as a
      return of the consideration referred to in subparagraph (i),

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 50 per cent of the amount, if any, by which

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of all amounts received by it more
      than 24 months before that time and not more than 36 months before
      that time as consideration for the issue of its units or in
      respect of its units

    exceeds

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of all amounts paid by it before
      that time to its members and designated by the partnership as a
      return of the consideration referred to in subparagraph (i), and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} 75 per cent of the amount, if any, by which

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of all amounts received by it more
      than 36 months before that time as consideration for the issue of
      its units or in respect of its units

    exceeds

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of all amounts paid by it before
      that time to its members and designated by the partnership as a
      return of the consideration referred to in subparagraph (i),

  exceeds 75 per cent of the amount, if any, by which the aggregate of
  its losses from the disposition of properties disposed of before that
  time exceeds the aggregate of its gains from the disposition of
  properties disposed of before that time.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (2), where a small
  business investment limited partnership disposes of a small business
  security it shall be deemed to continue to hold the investment for a
  period of 90 days following the date of the disposition.

    exceeds

  exceeds 75 per cent of the amount, if any, by which the aggregate of

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (2), where a small

- **[[5104]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-5104
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding paragraph (b) of the
  definition [[qualifying obligation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
  5100(1) and paragraphs 5101(1)(b), 5102(1)(f) and 5103(1)(d), the
  corporation, partnership or trust, as the case may be, may acquire a
  small business security that another person (other than a broker or
  dealer in securities) had previously acquired if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the small business security is a share of the
    capital stock of an eligible corporation having full voting rights
    under all circumstances; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} except where the share was acquired in specified
    circumstances within the meaning of subsection (2), the share was
    acquired from an officer or employee of the eligible corporation or
    a person related to the officer or employee.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where a person acquires a share of a corporation

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} as part of a proposal to, or an arrangement with,
      the corporation's creditors that has been approved by a court
      under the [Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act](/eng/acts/B-3) or the
      [Companies' Creditors Arrangement Act](/eng/acts/C-36),

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} at a time when all or substantially all of the
      corporation's assets were under the control of a receiver,
      receiver-manager, sequestrator or trustee in bankruptcy, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} at a time when, by reason of financial
      difficulty, the corporation was in default, or could reasonably be
      expected to default, on a debt obligation held by a person with
      whom the corporation was dealing at arm's length,

    the person shall be deemed, at any time within 36 months after he
    acquired the share, to have acquired it in specified circumstances;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where a person acquires a share of a corporation
    for the purposes of facilitating the disposition of the entire
    investment of the person in the corporation, the person shall be
    deemed, at any time within 12 months after he acquired the share, to
    have acquired it in specified circumstances; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a qualified trust (within the meaning assigned by
    subsection 259(3) of the Act) is deemed not to hold any property for
    any period in respect of which subsection 259(1) of the Act is
    applicable.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where the purchaser of a property that, but for this
  subsection, would at the time of its acquisition be a small business
  security (or, where the purchaser is a partnership, a member thereof)
  knew at the time of acquisition that the issuer of the security would,
  within the immediately following 12 months, cease to qualify as an
  eligible corporation, the property shall be deemed never to have been
  a small business security of the purchaser.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where a person who holds a share of or an interest in
  a corporation, partnership or trust that, but for this subsection,
  would be a small business investment corporation, small business
  investment limited partnership or small business investment trust knew
  at the time of issue of the share or interest, as the case may be, or
  at the time of making any contribution in respect of the share or
  interest, that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a substantial portion of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the consideration for the issue of the share or
      interest, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the contribution in respect of the share or
      interest

    would not be invested by the corporation, partnership or trust, as
    the case may be, directly or indirectly in small business
    securities, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} all or substantially all of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the consideration for the issue of the share or
      interest, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the contribution in respect of the share or
      interest

    would be returned to the purchaser within the immediately following
    24 months,

  the corporation, partnership or trust shall be deemed to have ceased
  at that time to be a small business investment corporation, small
  business investment limited partnership or small business investment
  trust.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Where, but for this subsection, a property that
  qualified as a small business security when it was acquired would
  cease at a subsequent time to so qualify, the property shall be deemed
  to be a small business security for the 24 months immediately
  following the subsequent time.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, a partnership shall be
  deemed to be a person.

## [PART LII]{.HLabel1}[Canadian Manufacturing and Processing Profits]{.HTitleText1} {#h-590773 .Part}

### [Basic Formula]{.HTitleText2} {#h-590774 .Subheading}

**[[5200]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-5200 .sectionLabel}** Subject to section
5201, for the purposes of subsection 125.1(3) of the Act, "Canadian
manufacturing and processing profits" of a corporation for a taxation
year are hereby prescribed to be that proportion of the corporation's
adjusted business income for the year that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of its cost of manufacturing and
  processing capital for the year and its cost of manufacturing and
  processing labour for the year,

is of

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of its cost of capital for the year and
  its cost of labour for the year.

### [Small Manufacturers' Rule]{.HTitleText2} {#h-590781 .Subheading}

**[[5201]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-5201 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
subsection 125.1(3) of the Act, "Canadian manufacturing and processing
profits" of a corporation for a taxation year are hereby prescribed to
be equal to the corporation's adjusted business income for the year
where

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the activities of the corporation during the year
  were primarily manufacturing or processing in Canada of goods for sale
  or lease;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the
    income of the corporation for the year from an active business minus
    the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the loss of the
    corporation for the year from an active business, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if the corporation is associated in the year with
    a Canadian corporation, the aggregate of all amounts each of which
    is the income of the latter corporation from an active business for
    its taxation year coinciding with or ending in the year,

  did not exceed \$200,000;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the corporation was not engaged in any of the
  activities listed in paragraphs (a) to (k) of the definition
  [[manufacturing or processing]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection
  125.1(3) of the Act at any time during the year;

- [(c.1)]{.lawlabel} the corporation was not engaged in the processing
  of ore (other than iron ore or tar sands) from a mineral resource
  located outside Canada to any stage that is not beyond the prime metal
  stage or its equivalent;

- [(c.2)]{.lawlabel} the corporation was not engaged in the processing
  of iron ore from a mineral resource located outside Canada to any
  stage that is not beyond the pellet stage or its equivalent;

- [(c.3)]{.lawlabel} the corporation was not engaged in the processing
  of tar sands located outside Canada to any stage that is not beyond
  the crude oil stage or its equivalent; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the corporation did not carry on any active business
  outside Canada at any time during the year.

### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-590795 .Subheading}

**[[5202]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-5202 .sectionLabel}** In this Part, except
as otherwise provided in section 5203 or 5204,

[[adjusted business income]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[adjusted business income]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a corporation
    for a taxation year means the amount, if any, by which

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the
      income of the corporation for the year from an active business
      carried on in Canada

    exceeds

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the
      loss of the corporation for the year from an active business
      carried on in Canada; ([revenu rajusté tiré d'une
      entreprise]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Canadian resource profits]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Canadian resource profits]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning
    that would be assigned to the expression [[resource
    profits]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} by section 1204 if

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} section 1204 were read without reference to
      subparagraph 1204(1)(b)(iv), and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the definition [[resource
      activity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 1206(1) were read
      without reference to paragraph (d) of that definition; ([bénéfices
      relatifs à des ressources au Canada]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[cost of capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[cost of capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a corporation for a
    taxation year means an amount equal to the aggregate of

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 10 per cent of the aggregate of all amounts each
      of which is the gross cost to the corporation of a property
      referred to in paragraph 1100(1)(e), (f), (g) or (h), paragraph
      1102(1)(d) or (g) or Schedule II that

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} was owned by the corporation at the end of the
        year, and

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} was used by the corporation at any time during
        the year, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the
      rental cost incurred by the corporation during the year for the
      use of any property a portion of the gross cost of which would be
      included by virtue of paragraph (a) if the property were owned by
      the corporation at the end of the year,

    but for the purposes of this definition, the gross cost of a
    property or rental cost for the use of any property does not include
    that portion of those costs that reflects the extent to which the
    property was used by the corporation during the year

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in an active business carried on outside Canada,
      or

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} to earn Canadian investment income or foreign
      investment income as defined in subsection 129(4) of the
      Act; ([coût en capital]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[cost of labour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[cost of labour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a corporation for a
    taxation year means an amount equal to the aggregate of

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the salaries and wages paid or payable during the
      year to all employees of the corporation for services performed
      during the year, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} all other amounts each of which is an amount paid
      or payable during the year for the performance during the year, by
      any person other than an employee of the corporation, of functions
      relating to

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the management or administration of the
        corporation,

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} scientific research and experimental
        development, or

      - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a service or function that would normally be
        performed by an employee of the corporation,

    but for the purposes of this definition, the salaries and wages
    referred to in paragraph (a) or other amounts referred to in
    paragraph (b) do not include that portion of those amounts that

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} was included in the gross cost to the corporation
      of a property (other than a property that was manufactured by the
      corporation and leased during the year by the corporation to
      another person) that was included in computing the cost of capital
      of the corporation for the year, or

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} was related to an active business carried on
      outside Canada by the corporation; ([coût en
      main-d'oeuvre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[cost of manufacturing and processing capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[cost of manufacturing and processing
    capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a corporation for a taxation year
    means 100/85 of that portion of the cost of capital of the
    corporation for that year that reflects the extent to which each
    property included in the calculation thereof was used directly in
    qualified activities of the corporation during the year, but the
    amount so calculated shall not exceed the cost of capital of the
    corporation for the year; ([coût en capital de fabrication et de
    transformation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[cost of manufacturing and processing labour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[cost of manufacturing and processing
    labour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a corporation for a taxation year
    means 100/75 of that portion of the cost of labour of the
    corporation for that year that reflects the extent to which

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the salaries and wages included in the
      calculation thereof were paid or payable to persons for the
      portion of their time that they were directly engaged in qualified
      activities of the corporation during the year, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the other amounts included in the calculation
      thereof were paid or payable to persons for the performance of
      functions that would be directly related to qualified activities
      of the corporation during the year if those persons were employees
      of the corporation,

    but the amount so calculated shall not exceed the cost of labour of
    the corporation for the year; ([coût en main-d'oeuvre de fabrication
    et de transformation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[gross cost]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[gross cost]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} to a particular person of a
    property at any time means, in respect of property that has become
    available for use by the particular person for the purposes of
    subsection 13(26) of the Act, the capital cost to the particular
    person of the property computed without reference to subsections
    13(7.1), (7.4) and (10), sections 21 and 80 and paragraph 111(4)(e)
    of the Act and, in respect of any other property, nil, and where the
    particular person acquired the property

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the course of a reorganization in respect of
      which, if a dividend were received by the particular person in the
      course of the reorganization, subsection 55(2) of the Act would
      not apply to the dividend by reason of the application of
      paragraph 55(3)(b) of the Act, or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} from another person with whom the particular
      person was not dealing at arm's length (otherwise than by reason
      of a right referred to in paragraph 251(5)(b) of the Act)
      immediately after the property was acquired,

    the capital cost to the particular person of the property for the
    purposes of this definition shall be computed as if the property had
    been acquired at a capital cost equal to the gross cost of the
    property to the person from whom the property was acquired by the
    particular person; ([coût brut]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[qualified activities]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[qualified activities]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any of the following activities, when they are
      performed in Canada in connection with manufacturing or processing
      (not including the activities listed in paragraphs (a) to (k) of
      the definition [[manufacturing or
      processing]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection 125.1(3) of the
      Act) in Canada of goods for sale or lease:

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} engineering design of products and production
        facilities,

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} receiving and storing of raw materials,

      - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} producing, assembling and handling of goods
        in process,

      - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} inspecting and packaging of finished goods,

      - [(v)]{.lawlabel} line supervision,

      - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} production support activities including
        security, cleaning, heating and factory maintenance,

      - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} quality and production control,

      - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} repair of production facilities, and

      - [(ix)]{.lawlabel} pollution control,

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} all other activities that are performed in Canada
      directly in connection with manufacturing or processing (not
      including the activities listed in paragraphs (a) to (k) of the
      definition [[manufacturing or processing]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}
      in subsection 125.1(3) of the Act) in Canada of goods for sale or
      lease, and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} scientific research and experimental development,
      as defined in section 2900, carried on in Canada,

    but does not include any of

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} storing, shipping, selling and leasing of
      finished goods,

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} purchasing of raw materials,

    - [(f)]{.lawlabel} administration, including clerical and personnel
      activities,

    - [(g)]{.lawlabel} purchase and resale operations,

    - [(h)]{.lawlabel} data processing, and

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} providing facilities for employees, including
      cafeterias, clinics and recreational facilities; ([activités
      admissibles]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing activities]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing
    activities]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} qualified activities that are

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} performed in connection with the manufacturing
        or processing of

        - [(A)]{.lawlabel} solar energy conversion equipment, including
          solar thermal collectors, photovoltaic solar arrays and custom
          supporting structures or frames, but excluding passive solar
          heating equipment,

        - [(B)]{.lawlabel} wind energy conversion equipment, including
          wind turbine towers, nacelles and rotor blades,

        - [(C)]{.lawlabel} water energy conversion equipment, including
          hydroelectric, water current, tidal and wave energy conversion
          equipment,

        - [(D)]{.lawlabel} geothermal energy equipment,

        - [(E)]{.lawlabel} equipment for a ground source heat pump
          system,

        - [(E.1)]{.lawlabel} air-source heat pump equipment designed for
          space or water heating,

        - [(F)]{.lawlabel} electrical energy storage equipment used for
          storage of renewable energy or for providing grid-scale
          storage or other ancillary services, including battery,
          compressed air and flywheel storage systems,

        - [(G)]{.lawlabel} equipment used to charge, or to dispense
          hydrogen to, property included in clause (J),

        - [(H)]{.lawlabel} equipment used for the production of hydrogen
          by electrolysis of water,

        - [(I)]{.lawlabel} equipment that is a component of property
          included in clauses (A) to (H) or (L) to (O), if such
          equipment is purpose-built or designed exclusively to form an
          integral part of that property,

        - [(J)]{.lawlabel} property that

          - [(I)]{.lawlabel} would be a [[zero-emission
            vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} (as defined in subsection
            248(1) of the Act if that definition were read without
            reference to its paragraphs (b) to (d)), or

          - [(II)]{.lawlabel} is described in subparagraph (a)(i) of
            Class 56 of Schedule II,

        - [(K)]{.lawlabel} integral components of the powertrain of
          property included in clause (J), including batteries or fuel
          cells,

        - [(L)]{.lawlabel} nuclear energy equipment,

        - [(M)]{.lawlabel} heavy water used for nuclear energy
          generation,

        - [(N)]{.lawlabel} nuclear fuels used for nuclear energy
          generation, and

        - [(O)]{.lawlabel} nuclear fuel rods, and

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} not the manufacturing or processing of general
        purpose components or equipment which components or equipment
        are suitable for integration into property other than property
        described in subparagraph (i);

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} qualified activities that are performed in
      connection with production in Canada of

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} hydrogen by electrolysis of water,

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} [[gaseous biofuel]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} (as
        defined in subsection 1104(13)),

      - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} [[liquid biofuel]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} (as
        defined in subsection 1104(13)), and

      - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} [[solid biofuel]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} (as
        defined in subsection 1104(13)); and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the conversion of a vehicle, performed in Canada,
      into a property described in clause (a)(i)(J); ([activités
      admissibles de fabrication de technologies à zéro
      émission]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[rental cost]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[rental cost]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a property means the rents
    incurred for the use of that property; ([coût de
    location]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[resource profits]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[resource profits]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning assigned by
    section 1204; ([bénéfices relatifs à des
    ressources]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[salaries and wages]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[salaries and wages]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means salaries, wages and
    commissions, but does not include any other type of remuneration,
    any superannuation or pension benefits, any retiring allowances or
    any amount referred to in section 6 or 7 of the Act; ([traitements
    et salaires]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[specified percentage]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[specified percentage]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} for a taxation year
    means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where the year commences after 1998, 100%, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, the total of

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} that proportion of 10% that the number of days
        in the year that are in 1990 is of the number of days in the
        year,

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} that proportion of 20% that the number of days
        in the year that are in 1991 is of the number of days in the
        year,

      - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} that proportion of 30% that the number of
        days in the year that are in 1992 is of the number of days in
        the year,

      - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} that proportion of 50% that the number of days
        in the year that are in 1993 is of the number of days in the
        year,

      - [(v)]{.lawlabel} that proportion of 64.3% that the number of
        days in the year that are in 1994 is of the number of days in
        the year,

      - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} that proportion of 71.4% that the number of
        days in the year that are in 1995 is of the number of days in
        the year,

      - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} that proportion of 78.6% that the number of
        days in the year that are in 1996 is of the number of days in
        the year,

      - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} that proportion of 85.7% that the number of
        days in the year that are in 1997 is of the number of days in
        the year,

      - [(ix)]{.lawlabel} that proportion of 92.9% that the number of
        days in the year that are in 1998 is of the number of days in
        the year, and

      - [(x)]{.lawlabel} that proportion of 100% that the number of days
        in the year that are in 1999 is of the number of days in the
        year; ([pourcentage désigné]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ZETM cost of capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ZETM cost of capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, of a corporation for a
    taxation year, means the portion of the cost of capital of the
    corporation for the year that reflects the extent to which each
    property included in the calculation of the cost of capital was used
    directly in qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing
    activities of the corporation during the year; ([coût en capital de
    FTZE]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ZETM cost of labour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ZETM cost of labour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, of a corporation for a
    taxation year, means the portion of the cost of labour of the
    corporation for that year that reflects the extent to which  

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the salaries and wages included in the
      calculation of the cost of labour were paid or payable to persons
      for the portion of their time that they were directly engaged in
      qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing activities of the
      corporation during the year, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the other amounts included in the calculation of
      the cost of labour were paid or payable to persons for the
      performance of functions that would be directly related to
      qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing activities of the
      corporation during the year if those persons were employees of the
      corporation. ([coût en main-d'œuvre de FTZE]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

### [Resource Income]{.HTitleText2} {#h-590868 .Subheading}

- **[[5203]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-5203
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where a corporation has resource
  activities for a taxation year the following rules apply, except as
  otherwise provided in section 5204:

  [[adjusted business income]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[adjusted business income]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of the
      corporation for the year means the amount, if any, by which

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount otherwise determined under section
        5202 to be the adjusted business income of the corporation for
        the year

      exceeds the total of

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount, if any, by which the corporation's
        net resource income for the year exceeds the corporation's net
        resource adjustment for the year, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} all amounts each of which is an amount in
        respect of refund interest included in computing the taxpayer's
        income for the year, to the extent that the amount is included
        in the amount determined to be the adjusted business income,
        within the meaning of section 5202, of the corporation for the
        year; ([revenue rajusté d'une entreprise]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} \[Repealed, SOR/2007-19, s. 7\]

  [[cost of capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[cost of capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of the corporation for the
      year means the amount, if any, by which

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount otherwise determined under section
        5202 to be the cost of capital of the corporation for the year

      exceeds

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that portion of the gross cost of property or
        rental cost for the use of property included in computing the
        cost of capital of the corporation for the year that reflects
        the extent to which the property was used by the corporation
        during the year,

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in activities engaged in for the purpose of
          earning Canadian resource profits of the corporation, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in activities referred to in subparagraph
          66(15)(b)(i), (ii) or (v), subparagraph 66(15)(e)(i) or (ii),
          subparagraph 66.1(6)(a)(i), (ii), (iii) or (v) or subparagraph
          66.2(5)(a)(i), (ii) or (v) of the Act; ([coût en
          capital]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[cost of labour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[cost of labour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of the corporation for the
      year means the amount, if any, by which

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount otherwise determined under section
        5202 to be the cost of labour of the corporation for the year

      exceeds

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that portion of the salaries and wages and
        other amounts included in computing the cost of labour of the
        corporation for the year that,

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} was related to the activities engaged in for
          the purpose of earning Canadian resource profits of the
          corporation, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} was included in the Canadian exploration and
          development expenses, foreign exploration and development
          expenses, Canadian exploration expense or Canadian development
          expense, within the meanings assigned by paragraphs 66(15)(b)
          and (e), 66.1(6)(a) and 66.2(5)(a) of the Act respectively, of
          the corporation. ([coût en main-d'oeuvre]{.DefinedTermLink
          lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), a corporation has
  "resource activities" for a taxation year if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in computing its income for the year, an amount is
    deductible pursuant to any of sections 65 to 66.2 of the Act;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the corporation was at any time during the year
    engaged in activities for the purpose of earning resource profits of
    the corporation; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in computing the corporation's income for the year,
    an amount was included pursuant to section 59 of the Act.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} In subsection (1), [[net resource
  income]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a corporation for a taxation year
  means the amount, if any, by which the total of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the resource profits of the corporation for the
    year, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount, if any, by which

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the total of amounts included in computing the
      income of the corporation for the year, from an active business
      carried on in Canada, pursuant to section 59 of the Act (other
      than amounts that may reasonably be regarded as having been
      included in computing the resource profits of the corporation for
      the year),

    exceeds

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the total of amounts deducted in computing the
      income of the corporation for the year under section 64 of the
      Act, as that section applies with respect to dispositions
      occurring before November 13, 1981 and to dispositions occurring
      after November 12, 1981 pursuant to the terms in existence on that
      date of an offer or agreement in writing made or entered into on
      or before that date, except those amounts that may reasonably be
      regarded as having been deducted in computing the resource profits
      of the corporation for the year,

  exceeds the total of

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the total of amounts deducted in computing the
    income of the corporation for the year under section 65 of the Act
    (other than amounts that may reasonably be regarded as having been
    deducted in computing the resource profits of the corporation for
    the year), and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the specified percentage for the year of the
    amount, if any, by which

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the corporation's resource profits for the year

    exceeds the total of

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the corporation's Canadian resource profits for
      the year, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the earned depletion base (within the meaning
      assigned by subsection 1205(1)) of the corporation at the
      beginning of its immediately following taxation year.

- [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} In subsection (1), the net resource adjustment of a
  corporation for a taxation year is the amount determined by the
  formula

  ::: {#590907 .Subsection}
  A - B

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the amount of Canadian resource profits of the corporation for
      the year, and

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the amount that would be the Canadian resource profits of the
      corporation for the year if
      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} subsections 1204(1) and (1.1) provided for the
        computation of negative amounts where the amounts subtracted in
        computing gross resource profits (as defined by subsection
        1204(1)) and resource profits " exceed the amounts added in
        computing those amounts, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} paragraph 1206(3)(a) applied so that a negative
        amount of resource profits of a partnership for a fiscal period
        that ended in the year were, to the extent of the corporation's
        share thereof, deducted in computing the corporation's resource
        profits for the year.
  :::

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (1), [[refund
  interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an amount that is received, or
  that becomes receivable, after March 6, 1996 from an authority
  (including a government or municipality) situated in Canada as a
  consequence of the overpayment of a tax that was not deductible under
  the Act in computing any taxpayer's income and that was imposed by an
  Act of Canada or a province or a bylaw of a municipality.

### [Partnerships]{.HTitleText2} {#h-590916 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/94-686, s. 78(F)

\]

**[[5204]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-5204 .sectionLabel}** If a corporation is a
member of a partnership at any time in a taxation year of the
corporation, the following definitions apply:

[[cost of capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[cost of capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of the corporation for the
    year means an amount equal to the aggregate of

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 10 per cent of the aggregate of all amounts each
      of which is the gross cost to the corporation of a property
      referred to in paragraph 1100(1)(e), (f), (g) or (h), paragraph
      1102(1)(d) or (g) or Schedule II that

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} was owned by the corporation at the end of the
        year, and

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} was used by the corporation at any time during
        the year,

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the
      rental cost incurred by the corporation during the year for the
      use of any property a portion of the gross cost of which would be
      included by virtue of paragraph (a) if the property were owned by
      the corporation at the end of the year, and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} that proportion of the aggregate of the amounts
      that would be determined under paragraphs (a) and (b) in respect
      of the partnership for its fiscal period coinciding with or ending
      in the taxation year of the corporation if the references in those
      paragraphs to "the corporation" were read as references to "the
      partnership" and the references in those paragraphs to "the year"
      were read as references to "the fiscal period of the partnership
      coinciding with or ending in the year", that

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the corporation's share of the income or loss
        of the partnership for that fiscal period

      is of

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the income or loss of the partnership for that
        fiscal period, as the case may be,

    but for the purposes of this definition, the gross cost of a
    property or rental cost for the use of any property does not include
    that portion of those costs that reflects the extent to which the
    property was used by the corporation during the year or by the
    partnership during its fiscal period coinciding with or ending in
    the year

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in an active business carried on outside Canada,

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} to earn Canadian investment income or foreign
      investment income as defined in subsection 129(4) of the Act on
      the assumption that subsection 129(4) of the Act applied to a
      partnership as well as to a corporation,

    - [(f)]{.lawlabel} in activities engaged in for the purpose of
      earning Canadian resource profits of the corporation or the
      partnership, as the case may be, or

    - [(g)]{.lawlabel} in activities referred to in subparagraph
      66(15)(b)(i), (ii) or (v), subparagraph 66(15)(e)(i) or (ii),
      subparagraph 66.1(6)(a)(i), (ii), (iii) or (v) or subparagraph
      66.2(5)(a)(i), (ii) or (v) of the Act; ([coût en
      capital]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[cost of labour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[cost of labour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of the corporation for the
    year means an amount equal to the aggregate of

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the salaries and wages paid or payable during the
      year to all employees of the corporation for services performed
      during the year,

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} all other amounts each of which is an amount paid
      or payable during the year for the performance during the year, by
      any person other than an employee of the corporation, of functions
      relating to

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the management or administration of the
        corporation,

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} scientific research as defined in section
        2900, or

      - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a service or function that would normally be
        performed by an employee of the corporation, and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} that proportion of the aggregate of the amounts
      that would be determined under paragraphs (a) and (b) in respect
      of the partnership for its fiscal period coinciding with or ending
      in the taxation year of the corporation if the references in those
      paragraphs to "the corporation" were read as references to "the
      partnership" and the references in those paragraphs to "the year"
      were read as references to the "fiscal period of the partnership
      coinciding with or ending in the year", that

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the corporation's share of the income or loss
        of the partnership for that fiscal period

      is of

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the income or loss of the partnership for that
        fiscal period, as the case may be,

    but for the purposes of this definition, the salaries and wages
    referred to in paragraph (a) or other amounts referred to in
    paragraph (b), of the corporation or the partnership, as the case
    may be, do not include that portion of those amounts that

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} was included in the gross cost to the corporation
      or partnership of a property (other than a property that was
      manufactured by the corporation or partnership and leased during
      the year by the corporation or the partnership to another person)
      that was included in computing the cost of capital of the
      corporation for the year,

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} was related to an active business carried on
      outside Canada by the corporation or the partnership,

    - [(f)]{.lawlabel} was related to the activities engaged in for the
      purpose of earning Canadian resource profits of the corporation or
      the partnership, as the case may be, or

    - [(g)]{.lawlabel} was included in the Canadian exploration and
      development expenses, foreign exploration and development
      expenses, Canadian exploration expense or Canadian development
      expense, within the meanings assigned by paragraphs 66(15)(b) and
      (e), 66.1(6)(a) and 66.2(5)(a) of the Act respectively, of the
      corporation; ([coût en main-d'oeuvre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[cost of manufacturing and processing capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[cost of manufacturing and processing
    capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of the corporation for the year means
    100/85 of that portion of the cost of capital of the corporation for
    that year that reflects the extent to which each property included
    in the calculation thereof was used directly in qualified activities

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} of the corporation during the year, or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} of the partnership during its fiscal period
      coinciding with or ending in the year, as the case may be,

    but the amount so calculated shall not exceed the cost of capital of
    the corporation for the year; ([coût en capital de fabrication et de
    transformation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[cost of manufacturing and processing labour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[cost of manufacturing and processing
    labour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of the corporation for the year means
    100/75 of that portion of the cost of labour of the corporation for
    that year that reflects the extent to which

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the salaries and wages included in the
      calculation thereof were paid or payable to persons for the
      portion of their time that they were directly engaged in qualified
      activities

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} of the corporation during the year, or

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} of the partnership during its fiscal period
        coinciding with or ending in the year, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the other amounts included in the calculation
      thereof were paid or payable to persons for the performance of
      functions that would be directly related to qualified activities

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} of the corporation during the year, or

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} of the partnership during its fiscal period
        coinciding with or ending in the year,

      if those persons were employees of the corporation or the
      partnership, as the case may be,

    but the amount so calculated shall not exceed the cost of labour of
    the corporation for the year; ([coût en main-d'oeuvre de fabrication
    et de transformation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[gross cost]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[gross cost]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a property at any time means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a property that has become
      available for use by the partnership for the purposes of
      subsection 13(26) of the Act, the capital cost to the partnership
      of the property computed without reference to subsections 13(7.1),
      (7.4) and (10) and sections 21 and 80 of the Act, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of any other property of the
      partnership, nil,

    and, for the purposes of paragraph (a), if the partnership acquired
    the property from a person who was a majority-interest partner of
    the partnership immediately after the property was acquired, the
    capital cost to the partnership of the property is to be computed as
    if the property had been acquired at a capital cost equal to the
    gross cost to the person of the property, except that if the
    property was partnership property on December 31, 1971, its gross
    cost is its capital cost to the partnership as determined under
    subsection 20(3) or (5) of the [Income Tax Application
    Rules](/eng/acts/I-3.31); ([coût brut]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ZETM cost of capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ZETM cost of capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, of the corporation for
    the year, means the portion of the cost of capital of the
    corporation for that year that reflects the extent to which each
    property included in the calculation of the cost of capital was used
    directly in qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing
    activities 

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} of the corporation during the year, or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} of the partnership during its fiscal period
      coinciding with or ending in the year, as the case may be; ([coût
      en capital de FTZE]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ZETM cost of labour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ZETM cost of labour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, of the corporation for
    the year, means the portion of the cost of labour of the corporation
    for that year that reflects the extent to which

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the salaries and wages included in the
      calculation of the cost of labour were paid or payable to persons
      for the portion of their time that they were directly engaged in
      qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing activities

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} of the corporation during the year, or

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} of the partnership during its fiscal period
        coinciding with or ending in the year, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the other amounts included in the calculation of
      the cost of labour were paid or payable to persons for the
      performance of functions that would be directly related to
      qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing activities of the
      corporation during the year, or of the partnership during its
      fiscal period coinciding with or ending in the year, if those
      persons were employees of the corporation or the partnership, as
      the case may be. ([coût en main-d'œuvre de FTZE]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

## [PART LIII]{.HLabel1}[Instalment Base]{.HTitleText1} {#h-590968 .Part}

### [Individuals]{.HTitleText2} {#h-590971 .Subheading}

**[[5300]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-5300 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
subsections 155(2), 156(3) and 161(9) of the Act, the instalment base of
an individual for a taxation year is the amount by which

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the individual's tax payable under Part I of the Act
  for the year, determined before taking into consideration the
  specified future tax consequences for the year,

exceeds

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount deemed by subsection 120(2) of the Act to
  have been paid on account of the individual's tax under Part I of the
  Act for the year, determined before taking into consideration the
  specified future tax consequences for the year.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
