##### [Minimum Prescribed Amount]{.HTitleText3} {#minimum-prescribed-amount .SchedHeadL3}

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where an amount is transferred in full satisfaction
  of an individual's entitlement to benefits under a defined benefit
  provision of a registered pension plan, the prescribed amount for the
  purposes of paragraph 147.3(4)(c) of the Act in respect of the
  transfer is the greater of the amount that would, but for this
  subsection, be the prescribed amount, and the balance, at the time of
  the transfer, in the individual's net contribution account (within the
  meaning assigned by subsection 8503(1)) in relation to the provision.

##### [Underfunded Pension]{.HTitleText3} {#underfunded-pension .SchedHeadL3}

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (3.01) applies in respect of a transfer of
  an amount on behalf of an individual in full or partial satisfaction
  of the individual's entitlement to benefits under a defined benefit
  provision of a registered pension plan if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the individual is an employee or a former employee
    of an employer (or a predecessor employer of the employer);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the employer

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} was a participating employer under the provision,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} is the subject of proceedings commenced under
      the [Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act](/eng/acts/B-3) or the
      [Companies' Creditors Arrangement Act](/eng/acts/C-36), and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} has ceased making regular contributions under
      the provision;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} after the commencement of the proceedings, lifetime
    retirement benefits paid or payable to the individual under the
    provision have been reduced because the assets of the plan are
    insufficient to pay the benefits provided under the provision of the
    plan as registered;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the plan is not a designated plan; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has approved the application of
    subsection (3.01) in respect of the transfer.

- [(3.001)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (3.01) applies in respect of a
  transfer of an amount on behalf of an individual in full or partial
  satisfaction of the individual's entitlement to benefits under a
  defined benefit provision of a registered pension plan if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the individual is an employee or a former employee
    of an employer (or a predecessor employer of the employer) that was
    a participating employer under the provision;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} lifetime retirement benefits paid or payable to the
    individual under the provision have been reduced because the assets
    of the plan are insufficient to pay the benefits provided under the
    provision of the plan as registered;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has approved the application of
    subsection (3.01) in respect of the transfer; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} either

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the plan is not an individual pension plan and
      the reduction in the lifetime retirement benefits paid or payable
      to the individual has been approved under the [Pension Benefits
      Standards Act, 1985](/eng/acts/P-7.01) or a similar law of a
      province, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the plan is an individual pension plan, the
      amount transferred from the plan on behalf of the individual is
      the last payment from the plan to the individual and all the
      property held in connection with the plan is distributed from the
      plan on behalf of plan members within 90 days of the transfer.

- [(3.01)]{.lawlabel} If this subsection applies, the description of A
  in subsection (1) is to be read as follows in respect of the transfer:

  > :::: ReadAsText
  > ::: {#596305 .ReadAsText}
  >
  > [A]{.dfn}
  > :   is the amount of the individual's lifetime retirement benefits
  >     under the provision commuted in connection with the transfer, as
  >     determined under subsection (4), but without reference to the
  >     benefit reduction referred to in paragraph (3)(c) or (3.001)(b),
  >     as the case may be; and
  > :::
  > ::::

- [(3.02)]{.lawlabel} If a particular amount is transferred in full or
  partial satisfaction of an individual's entitlement to benefits under
  a defined benefit provision of a registered pension plan and
  subsection (3.01) had applied in respect of a transfer (in this
  subsection referred to as the "initial transfer") of an amount on
  behalf of the individual under the provision, for the purpose of
  paragraph 147.3(4)(c) of the Act the prescribed amount in respect of
  the transfer of the particular amount is the lesser of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the particular amount, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount, if any, by which the prescribed amount
    in respect of the initial transfer exceeds the total of all amounts
    each of which is the amount of a previous transfer to which this
    subsection or subsection (3.01) applied in respect of the
    individual's entitlement to benefits under the provision.

##### [Benefits Provided With Surplus on Plan Wind-up]{.HTitleText3} {#benefits-provided-with-surplus-on-plan-wind-up-1 .SchedHeadL3}

- [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} Where an amount is transferred in full or partial
  satisfaction of an individual's entitlement to benefits under a
  defined benefit provision of a registered pension plan and the
  benefits include benefits (in this subsection referred to as
  "ancillary benefits") that are permissible solely because of
  subsection 8501(7), the prescribed amount for the purpose of paragraph
  147.3(4)(c) of the Act in respect of the transfer is the total of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount that would, but for this subsection, be
    the prescribed amount, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an amount approved by the Minister not exceeding
    the lesser of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the present value (at the time of the transfer)
      of the ancillary benefits that, as a consequence of the transfer,
      cease to be provided, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the total of all amounts each of which is, in
      respect of a previous transfer from the provision to a money
      purchase provision of a registered pension plan, a registered
      retirement savings plan or a registered retirement income fund in
      full or partial satisfaction of the individual's entitlement to
      other benefits under the defined benefit provision, the amount, if
      any, by which

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the prescribed amount for the purpose of
        paragraph 147.3(4)(c) of the Act in respect of the previous
        transfer

      exceeds

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the amount of the previous transfer.

##### [Amount of Lifetime Retirement Benefits Commuted]{.HTitleText3} {#amount-of-lifetime-retirement-benefits-commuted .SchedHeadL3}

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), and subject to
  subsection (7), the amount of an individual's lifetime retirement
  benefits under a defined benefit provision of a registered pension
  plan commuted in connection with the transfer of an amount on behalf
  of the individual in full or partial satisfaction of the individual's
  entitlement to benefits under the provision is the aggregate of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where retirement benefits have commenced to be paid
    under the provision to the individual, the amount (expressed on an
    annualized basis) by which the individual's lifetime retirement
    benefits under the provision are reduced as a result of the
    transfer,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where retirement benefits have not commenced to be
    paid under the provision to the individual, the amount (expressed on
    an annualized basis) by which the individual's normalized pension
    (computed in accordance with subsection (5)) under the provision at
    the time of the transfer is reduced as a result of the transfer, and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} where, in conjunction with the transfer, any other
    payment (other than an amount that is transferred in accordance with
    subsection 147.3(5) of the Act or that is transferred after 1991 in
    accordance with subsection 147.3(3) of the Act) is made from the
    plan in partial satisfaction of the individual's entitlement to
    benefits under the provision, the amount (expressed on an annualized
    basis) by which

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if paragraph (a) is applicable, the individual's
      lifetime retirement benefits under the provision are reduced, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if paragraph (b) is applicable, the individual's
      normalized pension (computed in accordance with subsection (5))
      under the provision at the time of the payment is reduced,

    as a result of the payment, except to the extent that such reduction
    is included in determining, for the purposes of subsection (1), the
    amount of the individual's lifetime retirement benefits under the
    provision commuted in connection with the transfer of another amount
    on behalf of the individual.

##### [Normalized Pensions]{.HTitleText3} {#normalized-pensions-2 .SchedHeadL3}

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (4), the normalized
  pension of an individual under a defined benefit provision of a
  registered pension plan at a particular time is the amount (expressed
  on an annualized basis) of lifetime retirement benefits that would be
  payable under the provision at the particular time if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} lifetime retirement benefits commenced to be paid
    to the individual at the particular time;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the individual has not attained 65 years of
    age before the particular time, the individual attained that age at
    the particular time;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} all benefits to which the individual is entitled
    under the provision were fully vested;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} where the amount of the individual's lifetime
    retirement benefits would otherwise be determined with a reduction
    computed by reference to the individual's age, duration of service,
    or both, or with any other similar reduction, no such reduction were
    applied;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} where the amount of the individual's lifetime
    retirement benefits depends on the amount of benefits provided under
    another benefit provision of the plan or under another plan or
    arrangement, a reasonable estimate were made of those other
    benefits;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} where the individual's lifetime retirement benefits
    would otherwise include benefits that the plan is required to
    provide by reason of a designated provision of the law of Canada or
    a province, or that the plan would be required to provide if each
    such provision were applicable to the plan with respect to all its
    members, such benefits were not included; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} except as otherwise provided by subsection (6),
    where the amount of the individual's lifetime retirement benefits
    depends on

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the form of benefits provided with respect to the
      individual under the provision (whether or not at the option of
      the individual), including

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the benefits to be provided after the death of
        the individual,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the amount of retirement benefits, other than
        lifetime retirement benefits, provided to the individual, or

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} the extent to which the lifetime retirement
        benefits will be adjusted to reflect changes in the cost of
        living, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} circumstances that are relevant in determining
      the form of benefits,

    the form of benefits and the circumstances were such as to maximize
    the amount of the individual's lifetime retirement benefits on
    commencement of payment.

##### [Optional Forms]{.HTitleText3} {#optional-forms-1 .SchedHeadL3}

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the terms of a defined benefit provision of a
    registered pension plan permit an individual to elect to receive
    additional lifetime retirement benefits in lieu of benefits that
    would, in the absence of the election, be payable after the death of
    the individual if the individual dies after retirement benefits
    under the provision commence to be paid to the individual, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the elections available to the individual include
    an election

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} to receive additional lifetime retirement
      benefits, not exceeding additional benefits determined on an
      actuarially equivalent basis, in lieu of all or a portion of a
      guarantee that retirement benefits will be paid for a minimum
      period of 10 years or less, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} to receive additional lifetime retirement
      benefits in lieu of retirement benefits that would otherwise be
      payable to a person who is a spouse or common-law partner or
      former spouse or common-law partner of the individual for a period
      beginning after the death of the individual and ending with the
      death of the person, where

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the election may be made only if the life
        expectancy of the person is significantly shorter than normal
        and has been so certified in writing by a medical doctor or a
        nurse practitioner licensed to practise under the laws of a
        province or of the place where the person resides, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the additional benefits do not exceed
        additional benefits determined on an actuarially equivalent
        basis and on the assumption that the person has a normal life
        expectancy,

  paragraph (5)(g) applies as if

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the election described in subparagraph (b)(i) were
    not available to the individual, and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} where the particular time the normalized pension of
    the individual is determined under subsection (5) is after 1991, the
    election described in subparagraph (b)(ii) were not available to the
    individual.

##### [Replacement Benefits]{.HTitleText3} {#replacement-benefits .SchedHeadL3}

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} Where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an amount is transferred on behalf of an individual
    in full or partial satisfaction of the individual's entitlement to
    benefits under a defined benefit provision (in this subsection
    referred to as the "particular provision") of a registered pension
    plan,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in conjunction with the transfer, benefits become
    provided to the individual under another defined benefit provision
    of the plan or under a defined benefit provision of another
    registered pension plan, and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an employer who participated under the particular
    provision for the benefit of the individual also participates under
    the other provision for the individual's benefit,

  the amount of the individual's lifetime retirement benefits under the
  particular provision commuted in connection with the transfer is the
  amount that would be determined under subsection (4) if the benefits
  provided under the other provision were provided under the particular
  provision.

### [Association of Benefits with Time Periods]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596364 .Subheading}

**[[8519]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-8519 .sectionLabel}** Where, for the
purposes of Part LXXXIII or this Part or subsection 147.1(10) of the
Act, it is necessary to associate benefits provided under a defined
benefit provision of a pension plan with periods of time, the
association shall be made in a manner acceptable to the Minister.

- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/92-51, s. 7
:::

### [Minister's Actions]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596368 .Subheading}

**[[8520]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-8520 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
this Part, a waiver, extension of time or other modification of the
requirements of this Part granted by the Minister or an approval by the
Minister in respect of any matter is not effective unless it is in
writing and expressly refers to the requirement that is modified or the
matter in respect of which the approval is given.

## [PART LXXXVI]{.HLabel1}[Taxable Capital Employed in Canada]{.HTitleText1} {#h-596372 .Part}

**[[8600]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-8600 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
this Part and Part I.3 of the Act,

[[attributed surplus]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[attributed surplus]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a non-resident insurer
    for a taxation year has the meaning assigned by subsection
    2400(1); ([surplus attribué]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Canadian assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Canadian assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a corporation that is a
    financial institution (as defined in subsection 181(1) of the Act)
    at any time in a taxation year means, in respect of the year, the
    amount, if any, by which

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the total of all amounts each of which is the
      amount at which an asset of the corporation (which asset is
      required, or, if the corporation were a bank to which the [Bank
      Act](/eng/acts/B-1.01) applied, would be required, to be reflected
      in a return under subsection 223(1) of the [Bank
      Act](/eng/acts/B-1.01), as that Act read on May 31, 1992, if that
      return were prepared on a non-consolidated basis) would be shown
      on the corporation's balance sheet at the end of the year if its
      balance sheet were prepared on a non-consolidated basis

    exceeds

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the investment allowance of the corporation for
      the year determined under subsection 181.3(4) of the Act; ([actif
      canadien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2013, c. 33, s. 38\]]{.Repealed}

[[Canadian premiums]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Canadian premiums]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} for a taxation year, in
    respect of an insurance corporation that was resident in Canada at
    any time in the year and throughout the year did not carry on a life
    insurance business, means the total of the insurance corporation's
    net premiums for the year

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of insurance on property situated in
      Canada, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of insurance, other than on property,
      from contracts with persons resident in Canada,

    and, for the purposes of this definition, [[net
    premiums]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in subsection
    403(2), and subsection 403(3) applies as if the references therein
    to "province" were read as references to "country"; ([primes
    canadiennes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Canadian reserve liabilities]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Canadian reserve liabilities]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an insurer
    as at the end of a taxation year has the meaning assigned by
    subsection 2400(1); ([(passif de réserve
    canadienne)]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[contractual service margin]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[contractual service margin]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} for a group of
    insurance contracts of an insurer, or a group of reinsurance
    contracts held by the insurer, at the end of a taxation year, has
    the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the Act; ([marge sur
    services contractuels]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[group of insurance contracts]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[group of insurance contracts]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an insurer
    has the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the Act; ([groupe
    de contrats d'assurance]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[group of reinsurance contracts]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[group of reinsurance contracts]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} held by an
    insurer has the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the
    Act; ([groupe de contrats de réassurance]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[group of segregated fund policies]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[group of segregated fund policies]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an
    insurer has the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the
    Act; ([groupe de polices à fonds réservé]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[permanent establishment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[permanent establishment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning
    as in subsection 400(2); ([établissement stable]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[policyholders' liabilities]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[policyholders' liabilities]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an insurer at
    the end of a taxation year has the same meaning as in subsection
    138(12) of the Act; ([obligation envers les titulaires de
    polices]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[reinsurance contract held amount]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[reinsurance contract held amount]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} for a group
    of reinsurance contracts held by an insurer at the end of a taxation
    year has the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the
    Act; ([montant au titre des contrats de réassurance
    détenus]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[total assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[total assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a corporation that is a
    financial institution (as defined in subsection 181(1) of the Act)
    at any time in a taxation year means, in respect of that year, the
    amount, if any, by which

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the total of all amounts each of which is the
      amount at which an asset of the corporation would be shown on the
      corporation's balance sheet at the end of the year if its balance
      sheet were prepared on a non-consolidated basis

    exceeds

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the investment allowance of the corporation for
      the year determined under subsection 181.3(4) of the Act; ([actif
      total]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[total premiums]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[total premiums]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} for a taxation year, in
    respect of an insurance corporation that was resident in Canada at
    any time in the year and throughout the year did not carry on a life
    insurance business, means the total of the corporation's net
    premiums for the year (as defined in subsection 403(2)) that are
    included in computing its income under Part I of the Act; ([total
    des primes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[total reserve liabilities]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[total reserve liabilities]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an insurer as
    at the end of a taxation year means the amount determined by the
    formula

    ::: {#1389489 .Definition}
    A − A.1 + A.2 + A.3 − (0.9 × B) − (C − (0.9 × D))

    where

    [A]{.dfn}
    :   is the total of the insurer's liabilities and reserves including
        liabilities for segregated fund guarantees (other than
        policyholders' liabilities or a liability for an obligation to
        pay a benefit under a segregated fund policy in respect of which
        subparagraphs 1406(b)(i) and (ii) apply) as at the end of the
        year in respect of insurance policies, as determined for the
        purposes of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions, if the
        insurer is required by law to report to the Superintendent of
        Financial Institutions, or, in any other case, the
        superintendent of insurance or other similar officer or
        authority of the province under the laws of which the insurer is
        incorporated;

    [A.1]{.dfn}
    :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of an
        item reported by the insurer as an insurance contract asset as
        at the end of the year;

    [A.2]{.dfn}
    :   is the total of all amounts each of which is an amount of funds
        withheld as at the end of the year by the insurer in respect of
        the reinsurance of a risk under an insurance policy;

    [A.3]{.dfn}
    :   is the total of all amounts each which is an amount recoverable
        as at the end of the year by the insurer under a funds withheld
        arrangement in respect of the reinsurance of a risk by the
        insurer under an insurance policy;

    [B]{.dfn}
    :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the contractual
        service margin for a group of insurance contracts (other than a
        group of segregated fund policies) of the insurer at the end of
        the year;

    [C]{.dfn}
    :   is the total of all amounts each of which is an amount, in
        respect of a group of reinsurance contracts held by the insurer
        at the end of the year, that is
        - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the reinsurance contract held amount for the
          group, if there is no reinsurance contract held amount for the
          group that is in respect of the reinsurance of an obligation
          to pay a benefit under a segregated fund policy in respect of
          which subparagraphs 1406(b)(i) and (ii) apply, and

        - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, the amount that would be
          the reinsurance contract held amount for the group if the
          reinsurance contract held amount were determined excluding any
          portion that is in respect of the reinsurance of an obligation
          to pay a benefit under a segregated fund policy in respect of
          which subparagraphs 1406(b)(i) and (ii) apply; and

    [D]{.dfn}
    :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount, in
        respect of a group of reinsurance contracts held by the insurer
        at the end of the year, that is
        - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if no portion of the contractual service
          margin for the group is in respect of a risk under a
          segregated fund policy, the contractual service margin for the
          group, and

        - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, the amount that would be
          the contractual service margin for the group if the
          contractual service margin were determined excluding any
          portion that is in respect of the reinsurance of a risk under
          a segregated fund policy. ([passif total de
          réserve]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})
    :::

**[[8601]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-8601 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
determining the taxable capital employed in Canada of a corporation for
a taxation year under subsection 181.2(1) of the Act, the prescribed
proportion of the corporation's taxable capital (as determined under
Part I.3 of the Act) for the year is the amount determined by the
formula

::: {#596399 .Section}
A × (B / C)

where

[A]{.dfn}
:   is the taxable capital (as determined under Part I.3 of the Act) of
    the corporation for the year,

[B]{.dfn}
:   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount, determined
    in accordance with Part IV (or, in the case of an airline
    corporation, that would be so determined if the corporation had a
    permanent establishment in every province and if paragraphs
    407(1)(a) and (b) were read without reference to the words "in
    Canada"), of the corporation's taxable income earned in the year in
    a particular province or the amount of its taxable income that
    would, pursuant to that Part, be earned in the year in a province if
    all permanent establishments of the corporation in Canada were in a
    province, and

[C]{.dfn}
:   is the corporation's taxable income for the year,
:::

except that, where the corporation's taxable income for the year is nil,
the corporation shall, for the purposes of this section, be deemed to
have a taxable income for the year of \$1,000.

**[[8602]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-8602 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
paragraph (b) of the definition [[Canadian surtax
payable]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 125.3(4) of the Act, the
prescribed proportion of the amount determined under section 123.2 of
the Act in respect of a corporation for a taxation year is the amount
determined by the formula

::: {#596408 .Section}
A × (B / C)

where

[A]{.dfn}
:   is the amount determined under section 123.2 of the Act in respect
    of the corporation for the year;

[B]{.dfn}
:   is
    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where the corporation carried on a life insurance
      business at any time in the year, the corporation's taxable
      capital (as determined under Part I.3 of the Act) for the year,
      and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, the corporation's taxable
      capital employed in Canada (as would be determined under Part I.3
      of the Act if that Part were read without reference to paragraphs
      181.3(1)(a) and (b) thereof) for the year; and

[C]{.dfn}
:   is the corporation's taxable capital (as determined under Part I.3
    of the Act) for the year.
:::

Part VI of the Act,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} [[Canadian assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a
  corporation that is a financial institution (as defined in subsection
  190(1) of the Act) at any time in a taxation year means, in respect of

  [[Canadian assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in section 8600 in respect of

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} [[total assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a corporation
  that is a financial institution (as defined in subsection 190(1) of
  the Act) at any time in a taxation year means, in respect of that
  year, the amount that would be determined under the definition [[total
  assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in section 8600 in respect of the
  corporation for the year if the reference in that definition to

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} [[attributed surplus]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm},
  [[Canadian reserve liabilities]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} and [[total
  reserve liabilities]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} have the same respective
  meanings as in section 8600.

- **[[8605]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-8605
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subclause
  181.3(1)(c)(ii)(A)(II) and clause 190.11(b)(i)(B) of the Act, the
  amount prescribed in respect of a particular corporation for a
  taxation year ending at a particular time is the total of all amounts
  each of which is the amount determined in respect of a corporation
  that is, at the particular time, a foreign insurance subsidiary of the
  particular corporation, determined by the formula

  ::: {#1389503 .Subsection}
  A − B

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the amount determined by the formula
      ::: {#1389506 .NestedFormula}
      C + D + (0.9 × E) − (0.9 × F) − G

      where

      [C]{.dfn}
      :   is the amount of the subsidiary's long-term debt at the end of
          the subsidiary's last taxation year ending at or before the
          particular time (in this subsection referred to as the "last
          taxation year"),

      [D]{.dfn}
      :   is the total amount at the end of the subsidiary's last
          taxation year of the subsidiary's
          - [(a)]{.lawlabel} capital stock (or, in the case of an
            insurance corporation incorporated without share capital,
            the amount of its members' contributions),

          - [(b)]{.lawlabel} retained earnings,

          - [(c)]{.lawlabel} accumulated other comprehensive income,

          - [(d)]{.lawlabel} policyholders' liabilities,

          - [(e)]{.lawlabel} contributed surplus, and

          - [(f)]{.lawlabel} any other surpluses,

      [E]{.dfn}
      :   is total of all amounts each of which is the contractual
          service margin for a group of insurance contracts of the
          subsidiary at the end of the subsidiary's last taxation year
          other than a group of segregated fund policies,

      [F]{.dfn}
      :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount, in
          respect of a group of reinsurance contracts held by the
          subsidiary at the end of the subsidiary's last taxation year,
          that is
          - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if no portion of the contractual service
            margin for the group is in respect of a risk under a
            segregated fund policy, the contractual service margin for
            the group, and

          - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, the amount that would be
            the contractual service margin for the group if the amount
            were determined excluding any portion that is in respect of
            the reinsurance of a risk under a segregated fund policy,
            and

      [G]{.dfn}
      :   is the amount of any deficit deducted in computing the
          subsidiary's shareholders' equity at the end of the
          subsidiary's last taxation year; and
      :::

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the amount determined by the formula
      ::: {#1389522 .NestedFormula}
      H + I

      where

      [H]{.dfn}
      :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the carrying
          value to its owner at the particular time for the taxation
          year that includes the particular time of a share of the
          subsidiary's capital stock or its long-term debt that is owned
          at the particular time by
          - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the particular corporation,

          - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a subsidiary of the particular corporation,

          - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a corporation

            - [(i)]{.lawlabel} that is resident in Canada,

            - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} that carried on a life insurance
              business in Canada at any time in its taxation year ending
              at or before the particular time, and

            - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} that is

              - [(A)]{.lawlabel} a corporation of which the particular
                corporation is a subsidiary, or

              - [(B)]{.lawlabel} a subsidiary of a corporation described
                in clause (A), or

          - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a subsidiary of a corporation described in
            paragraph (c), and

      [I]{.dfn}
      :   is the total of all amounts each of which is an amount
          included under the description of A in respect of any surplus
          of the subsidiary contributed by a corporation described in
          paragraphs (a) to (d) of the description of H, other than an
          amount included under the description of H.
      :::
  :::

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subclause 181.3(1)(c)(ii)(A)(III)
  and clause 190.11(b)(i)(C) of the Act, the amount prescribed in
  respect of a particular corporation for a taxation year ending at a
  particular time is the total of all amounts each of which is the
  amount determined in respect of a corporation that is, at the
  particular time, a foreign insurance subsidiary of the particular
  corporation, determined by the formula

  ::: {#1389536 .Subsection}
  A − B

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the amount determined for B in subsection (1) in respect of the
      subsidiary, and

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the amount determined for A in subsection (1) in respect of the
      subsidiary.
  :::

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subclause 181.3(1)(c)(ii)(A)(V)
  and clause 190.11(b)(i)(E) of the Act, the amount prescribed in
  respect of a particular corporation for a taxation year ending at a
  particular time means the total of all amounts each of which would be
  the total reserve liabilities of a foreign insurance subsidiary of the
  particular corporation as at the end of the subsidiary's last taxation
  year ending at or before the particular time if the subsidiary were
  required by law to report to the Superintendent of Financial
  Institutions for that year.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The definitions in this subsection apply in this
  section.

  [[foreign insurance subsidiary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[foreign insurance subsidiary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a
      particular corporation at any time means a non-resident
      corporation that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} carried on a life insurance business throughout
        its last taxation year ending at or before that time,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} did not carry on a life insurance business in
        Canada at any time in its last taxation year ending at or before
        that time, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is at that time

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a subsidiary of the particular corporation,
          and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} not a subsidiary of any corporation that

          - [(A)]{.lawlabel} is resident in Canada,

          - [(B)]{.lawlabel} carried on a life insurance business in
            Canada at any time in its last taxation year ending at or
            before that time, and

          - [(C)]{.lawlabel} is a subsidiary of the particular
            corporation. ([filiale d'assurance
            étrangère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[subsidiary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[subsidiary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a corporation (in this
      definition referred to as the [[parent
      corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}) means a corporation controlled
      by the parent corporation where shares of each class of the
      capital stock of the corporation having a fair market value of not
      less than 75% of the fair market value of all of the issued and
      outstanding shares of that class belong to

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the parent corporation,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a corporation that is a subsidiary of the
        parent corporation, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any combination of corporations each of which
        is a corporation referred to in paragraph (a) or described in
        paragraph (b). ([filiale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

## [PART LXXXVII]{.HLabel1}[National Arts Service Organizations]{.HTitleText1} {#h-596474 .Part}

**[[8700]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-8700 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
paragraph 149.1(6.4)(d) of the Act, the following conditions are
prescribed for a national arts service organization:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the organization is an organization

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} that is, because of paragraph 149(1)(l) of the Act,
    exempt from tax under Part I of the Act,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} that represents, in an official language of
    Canada, a community of artists from one or more of the following
    sectors of activity in the arts community, that is, theatre, opera,
    music, dance, painting, sculpture, drawing, crafts, design,
    photography, the literary arts, film, sound recording and other
    audio-visual arts,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} no part of the income of which may be payable to,
    or otherwise available for the personal benefit of, any proprietor,
    member, shareholder, trustee, or settlor of the organization, except
    where the payment is for services rendered or is an amount to which
    paragraph 56(1)(n) of the Act applies in respect of the recipient,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} all of the resources of which are devoted to the
    activities and objects described in its application for its last
    designation by the Minister of Canadian Heritage pursuant to
    paragraph 149.1(6.4)(a) of the Act,

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} more than 50 per cent of the directors, trustees,
    officers or other officials of which deal with each other at arm's
    length, and

  - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} no more than 50% of the property of which at any
    time has been contributed or otherwise paid into the organization by
    one person or members of a group of persons who do not deal with
    each other at arm's length and, for the purpose of this
    subparagraph, a reference to any person or to members of a group
    does not include a reference to Her Majesty in Right of Canada or a
    province, a municipality, a registered charity that is not a private
    foundation or any club, society or association described in
    paragraph 149(1)(l) of the Act; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the activities of the organization (which may include
  collective bargaining on behalf of its sector of activity under the
  [Status of the Artist Act](/eng/acts/S-19.6), provided it is not the
  organization's primary activity) are confined to one or more of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} promoting one or more art forms,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} conducting research into one or more art forms,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} sponsoring arts exhibitions or performances,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} representing interests of the arts community or a
    sector thereof (but not of individuals) before governmental,
    judicial, quasi-judicial or other public bodies,

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} conducting workshops, seminars, training programs
    and similar development programs relating to the arts for members of
    the organization, in respect of which the value of benefits received
    or enjoyed by members of the organization is required by paragraph
    56(1)(aa) of the Act to be included in computing the incomes of
    those members,

  - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} educating the public about the arts community or
    the sector represented by the organization,

  - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} organizing and sponsoring conventions,
    conferences, competitions and special events relating to the arts
    community or the sector represented by the organization,

  - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} conducting arts studies and surveys of interest
    to members of the organization relating to the arts community or the
    sector represented by the organization,

  - [(ix)]{.lawlabel} acting as an information centre by maintaining
    resource libraries and data bases relating to the arts community or
    the sector represented by the organization,

  - [(x)]{.lawlabel} disseminating information relating to the arts
    community or the sector represented by the organization, and

  - [(xi)]{.lawlabel} paying amounts to which paragraph 56(1)(n) of the
    Act applies in respect of the recipient and which relate to the arts
    community or the sector represented by the organization.

## [PART LXXXVIII]{.HLabel1}[Disability-related Modifications and Apparatus]{.HTitleText1} {#h-596497 .Part}

**[[8800]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-8800 .sectionLabel}** The renovations and
alterations that are prescribed for the purposes of paragraph 20(1)(qq)
of the Act are

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the installation of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an interior or exterior ramp, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a hand-activated electric door opener; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a modification to a bathroom, elevator or doorway to
  accommodate its use by a person in a wheelchair.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/93-565, s. 1
:::

**[[8801]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-8801 .sectionLabel}** The devices and
equipment that are prescribed for the purposes of paragraph 20(1)(rr) of
the Act are

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} an elevator car position indicator, such as a braille
  panel or an audio signal, for individuals having a sight impairment;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a visual fire alarm indicator, a listening device for
  group meetings or a telephone device, for individuals having a hearing
  impairment; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a disability-specific computer software or hardware
  attachment.

- **[[8901.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-8901.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraph (f) of
  the definition [[eligible entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection
  125.7(1) of the Act, the following entities are prescribed:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a corporation that meets the following conditions:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it is described in paragraph 149(1)(d.5) of the
      Act,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} not less than 90% of the shares, or the capital,
      of the corporation are owned by one or more [[Aboriginal
      governments]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} (as defined in subsection
      241(10) of the Act) --- or similar Indigenous governing bodies ---
      described in paragraph 149(1)(c) of the Act, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} it carries on a business;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a corporation that meets the following conditions:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it is described in paragraph 149(1)(d.6) of the
      Act,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} all of the shares (except directors' qualifying
      shares), or the capital, of the corporation are owned by one or
      more of

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} an [[Aboriginal
        government]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} (as defined in subsection
        241(10) of the Act) --- or a similar Indigenous governing body
        --- described in paragraph 149(1)(c) of the Act, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} a corporation described in this paragraph or
        paragraph (a), and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} it carries on a business;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a partnership, each member of which is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an eligible entity, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an [[Aboriginal
      government]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} (as defined in subsection
      241(10) of the Act) --- or a similar Indigenous governing body ---
      described in paragraph 149(1)(c) of the Act;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a partnership, in respect of a qualifying period,
    if throughout the qualifying period it is the case that

    ::: {#1335431 .Paragraph}
    A ≤ 0.5B

    where

    [A]{.dfn}
    :   is the total of all amounts, each of which is the fair market
        value of an interest in the partnership held --- directly or
        indirectly, through one or more partnerships --- by a person or
        partnership other than an eligible entity, and

    [B]{.dfn}
    :   is the total fair market value of all interests in the
        partnership;
    :::

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a person described in paragraph 149(1)(g) or (h) of
    the Act; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a person or partnership that operates a private
    school or private college.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection 125.7(1) of the Act,
  [[qualifying tourism or hospitality entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef},
  for a qualifying period, means an eligible entity that meets the
  following conditions:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the entity has a prior year revenue decline greater
    than or equal to 40%; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the total of all amounts, each of which is the
    eligible entity's qualifying revenue for the prior reference period
    for any of the first qualifying period to the thirteenth qualifying
    period (but including only one of the tenth qualifying period or the
    eleventh qualifying period), was earned primarily from carrying on
    one or more of the following activities:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} operating or managing a facility providing
      short-term lodging, such as a hotel, a motel, a cottage, a bed and
      breakfast or a youth hostel,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} preparing and serving meals, snacks and
      beverages made to order for immediate consumption on or off the
      premises,

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} such as a restaurant, a food truck, a
        cafeteria, a caterer, a coffee shop, a food concession, a bar, a
        pub or a nightclub, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} for greater certainty, not including the
        operation of a facility primarily engaged in retailing food or
        beverage products, such as a supermarket or a convenience store,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} operating a travel agency or as a tour
      operator, including:

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} acting as an agent for tour operators,
        transportation companies and short-term lodging establishments
        in selling travel, tour and accommodation services, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} arranging, assembling and marketing tours,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} organizing, promoting, hosting, supporting or
      participating in events that meet the artistic or cultural
      interests of their patrons, including live performances or
      exhibits intended for public viewing,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} preserving and exhibiting objects, sites and
      natural wonders of historical, cultural or educational value, such
      as the operation of a museum, a historic and heritage site, a zoo,
      a botanical garden or a nature park,

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} organizing, promoting or supporting scenic and
      sightseeing tours, such as sightseeing or dinner cruises, steam
      train excursions, horse-drawn sightseeing rides, air-boat rides,
      hot-air balloon rides or charter fishing services,

    - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} providing charter bus services, if

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the buses do not operate on fixed routes and
        schedules, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the entire vehicle is rented, rather than
        individual seats,

    - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} operating or managing an amusement or theme
      park, which includes

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} operating a variety of attractions, such as
        mechanical rides, water rides, games, shows or theme exhibits,
        and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} leasing space on a concession basis for these
        operations,

    - [(ix)]{.lawlabel} operating or managing a facility or providing a
      service that enables patrons to participate in recreational
      activities,

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} including

        - [(I)]{.lawlabel} fitness and recreational sports centres,

        - [(II)]{.lawlabel} downhill and cross-country ski/snowboard
          areas, and equipment such as ski lifts and tows (including
          revenues from equipment rental services and ski/snowboard
          instruction services provided at the area),

        - [(III)]{.lawlabel} the operation of docking and storage
          facilities for pleasure-craft owners, with or without related
          activities, such as retailing fuel and marine supplies, boat
          repair and maintenance and rental services,

        - [(IV)]{.lawlabel} the operation of recreation and amusement
          facilities and services including establishments primarily
          engaged in maintaining non-gambling coin-operated amusement
          devices, in businesses operated by others, and

        - [(V)]{.lawlabel} other amusement activities, such as amateur
          sports clubs, teams or leagues, archery or shooting, ballroom
          dancing, river rafting, curling clubs, mini golf and bowling,
          and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} excluding

        - [(I)]{.lawlabel} golf, golf instruction and the ownership or
          operation of a facility that is a golf course, a golf driving
          range, or a golf clubhouse,

        - [(II)]{.lawlabel} country clubs, and

        - [(III)]{.lawlabel} professional sports clubs, teams or leagues
          or facilities used primarily by such organizations,

    - [(x)]{.lawlabel} operating or managing serviced or unserviced
      sites to accommodate campers and their equipment for tents, tent
      trailers, travel trailers and recreational vehicles, excluding
      mobile home sites,

    - [(xi)]{.lawlabel} operating or managing an overnight recreational
      camp, such as a children's camp, a family vacation camp or an
      outdoor adventure retreat,

    - [(xii)]{.lawlabel} operating or managing a hunting camp or a
      fishing camp,

    - [(xiii)]{.lawlabel} operating or managing a duty-free retail store
      at a land border crossing where the only exit route is to the
      United States,

    - [(xiv)]{.lawlabel} operating or managing a facility that is
      primarily engaged in exhibiting motion pictures, such as a cinema
      or a drive-in theatre,

    - [(xv)]{.lawlabel} operating or managing an amusement arcade, such
      as a family fun centre, an indoor play area, a pinball arcade or a
      video game arcade,

    - [(xvi)]{.lawlabel} operating a facility allowing passengers to
      board and leave a cruise ship,

    - [(xvii)]{.lawlabel} operating or managing an airport, including
      renting hangar space and providing baggage handling, cargo
      handling and aircraft parking services,

    - [(xviii)]{.lawlabel} operating or managing a casino,

    - [(xix)]{.lawlabel} promoting a destination or region in Canada for
      the purpose of attracting tourism,

    - [(xx)]{.lawlabel} organizing, planning, promoting, hosting or
      supporting:

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} conventions, trade shows or festivals, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} weddings, parties or similar events, and

    - [(xxi)]{.lawlabel} promoting the interests of the members of an
      industry organization or association, if the members are primarily
      engaged in activities described in any of subparagraphs (i) to
      (xx).

- **[[8901.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-8901.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(0.1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in
  this section.

  [[partial public health restriction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[partial public health restriction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      [[public health restriction]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in
      subsection 125.7(1) of the Act if paragraphs (f) to (h) of that
      definition were replaced by the following:

      > ::: ReadAsText
      > - [(f)]{.lawlabel} as a result of the order or decision, some or
      >   all of the activities of the eligible entity --- or the
      >   specified tenant --- at, or in connection with, the qualifying
      >   property (that it is reasonable to expect the eligible entity
      >   --- or the specified tenant --- would, absent the order or
      >   decision, otherwise have engaged in) are required to be
      >   reduced by means of capacity or similar restrictions by not
      >   less than 50% (referred to in this subsection as the "limited
      >   activities"); and
      >
      > - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the limited activities are required to be
      >   reduced for a period of at least one week. ([restrictions
      >   sanitaires partielles]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})
      > :::

  [[qualifying partial public health restriction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[qualifying partial public health
      restriction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, of an eligible entity for a
      qualifying period, means that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} one or more qualifying properties of the
        eligible entity --- or of one or more specified tenants (within
        the meaning of the definition [[public health
        restriction]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}) of the eligible entity ---
        is subject to a partial public health restriction for at least
        seven days in the qualifying period; and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is reasonable to conclude that at least
        approximately 50% of the qualifying revenues of the eligible
        entity --- together with the qualifying revenues of any
        specified tenants of the eligible entity --- for the prior
        reference period were derived from the limited
        activities. ([restrictions sanitaires partielles
        admissibles]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(1)]{.lawlabel} The amount determined by regulation in respect of a
  qualifying entity for the purposes of clause (b)(iv)(B) of the
  description of A in subsection 125.7(2) of the Act for a week in a
  qualifying period is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the seventh qualifying period and the eighth

      subparagraph (a)(i) of the description of A in subsection 125.7(2)

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount determined for the week under

      125.7(2) of the Act;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the ninth qualifying period and the tenth

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} \$500, and

        remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} (as defined in subsection
        125.7(1) of the Act) in respect of the eligible employee
        determined for that week, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} \$573;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} for any of the eleventh qualifying period to the

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} \$500, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the lesser of

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} 55% of [[baseline
        remuneration]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} (as defined in subsection

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} \$595; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} for the twentieth qualifying period and any

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Base percentage

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The percentage determined for the purposes of the

## [PART XC]{.HLabel1}[Financial Institutions --- Prescribed Entities and Properties]{.HTitleText1} {#h-596527 .Part}

### [Prescribed Person not a Financial Institution]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596528 .Subheading}

**[[9000]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9000 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
paragraph (e) of the definition [[financial
institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 142.2(1) of the Act, the
following are prescribed persons:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Business Development Bank of Canada;

- [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} Farm Credit Canada;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} BDC Capital Inc.; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a trust, at any particular time, if at that
  particular time

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the trust is a related segregated fund trust
    (within the meaning assigned by paragraph 138.1(1)(a) of the Act),

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the trust is deemed, under paragraph 138.1(1)(a)
    of the Act, to have been created at a time that is not more than two
    years before that particular time, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the cost of the trustee's interest (as determined
    by paragraph 138.1(1)(c) and (d) of the Act) in the trust does not
    exceed \$5,000,000.

### [Prescribed Property not Mark-to-Market Property]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596538 .Subheading}

- **[[9001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9001 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  this section, [[qualified small business
  corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, at any time, means a corporation in
  respect of which the following conditions are satisfied at that time:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the corporation is a Canadian-controlled private
    corporation;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the corporation either is an eligible corporation
    (as defined in subsection 5100(1)) or would be an eligible
    corporation if the definition [[eligible
    corporation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 5100(1) were read
    without reference to its paragraph (e);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the carrying value of the total assets of the
    corporation and all corporations related to it (determined in
    accordance with generally accepted accounting principles on a
    consolidated or combined basis, where applicable) does not exceed
    \$50,000,000; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the number of employees of the corporation and all
    corporations related to it does not exceed 500.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of paragraph (e) of the definition
  [[excluded property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 142.2(1) of
  the Act, a share of the capital stock of a corporation is a prescribed
  property of a taxpayer if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} immediately after the time at which the taxpayer
    acquired the share, the corporation was a qualified small business
    corporation, and

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the corporation continued to be a qualified small
      business corporation for one year after that time, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the taxpayer could not reasonably expect at that
      time that the corporation would cease to be a qualified small
      business corporation within one year after that time; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the share was issued to the taxpayer in exchange
    for one or more shares of the capital stock of the corporation that
    were, at the time of the exchange, prescribed property of the
    taxpayer under this subsection.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- 2009, c. 2, s. 118
:::

### [Prescribed Property not Mark-to-Market Property]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596552 .Subheading}

- **[[9002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9002
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraph (e) of
  the definition [[excluded property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
  142.2(1) of the Act, and of subparagraph 142.6(4)(a)(ii) of the Act, a
  debt obligation held by a bank is a prescribed property of the bank if
  the obligation is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an exposure to a designated country (within the
    meaning assigned by section 8006);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a United Mexican States Collateralized Par Bond due
    2019; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a United Mexican States Collateralized Discount
    Bond due 2019.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of paragraph (e) of the definition
  [[excluded property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 142.2(1) of
  the Act, a share is a prescribed property of a taxpayer for a taxation
  year if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the share is a lending asset of the taxpayer in the
    year; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the share was, immediately after its issuance, a
    share described in paragraph (e) of the definition [[term preferred
    share]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 248(1) of the Act, and the
    share would, at any time in the year, be a term preferred share if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} that definition were read without ref- erence to
      the portion following paragraph (b), and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} where the share was issued or acquired on or
      before June 28, 1982, it were issued or acquired after that day.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of paragraph (e) of the definition
  [[excluded property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 142.2(1) of
  the Act, a share of the capital stock of a corporation that is held by
  a credit union is a prescribed property of the credit union for a
  taxation year if, throughout the period (referred to in this
  subsection as the "holding period") in that taxation year during which
  the credit union holds the share

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the corporation is a credit union; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the following conditions are satisfied:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} credit unions hold shares of the corporation that

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} give those credit unions at least 50% of the
        votes that could be cast under all circumstances at an annual
        meeting of shareholders of the corporation, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} have a fair market value of at least 50% of the
        fair market value of all the issued shares of the corporation,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the corporation is not controlled, directly or
      indirectly in any manner whatever, by any person that is not a
      credit union, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the corporation would not be controlled by a
      person that is not a credit union if each share of the corporation
      that is not owned at any time in the holding period by a credit
      union were owned, at that time, by the person.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- 2009, c. 2, s. 118
:::

### [Prescribed Payment Card Corporation Share not Mark-to-Market Property]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596573 .Subheading}

**[[9002.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9002.1 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose
of paragraph (b) of the definition [[excluded
property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 142.2(1) of the Act, a
prescribed payment card corporation share of a taxpayer at any time
means a share of the capital stock of a particular corporation if, at
that time,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the particular corporation is any one of the
  following

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} MasterCard International Incorporated,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} MasterCard Incorporated,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} Visa Inc., or

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} Interac Corp.; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the share

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is of a class of shares that is not listed on a
    stock exchange,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} is not convertible into or exchangeable for a
    share of the class of the capital stock of a corporation that is
    listed on a stock exchange, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} was issued by the particular corporation to the
    taxpayer or to a person related to the taxpayer.

### [Financing Arrangement not a Specified Debt Obligation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596592 .Subheading}

**[[9004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9004 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
paragraph (c) of the definition [[specified debt
obligation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 142.2(1) of the Act, a
property is a prescribed property throughout a taxation year if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the property is a direct financing lease, or any
  other financing arrangement, of a taxpayer that is reported as a loan
  in the taxpayer's financial statements for the year prepared in
  accordance with generally accepted accounting principles; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in computing the taxpayer's income for the year, an
  amount is deductible under paragraph 20(1)(a) of the Act in respect of
  the property that is the subject of the arrangement.

### [Prescribed Non-reporting Financial Institution]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596598 .Subheading}

**[[9005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9005 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
the definition [[non-reporting financial
institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection 270(1) of the Act, the
following entities are prescribed:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a labour-sponsored venture capital corporation as
  prescribed in section 6701;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a registered retirement savings plan;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a registered retirement income fund;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a pooled registered pension plan;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} a deferred profit sharing plan;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} a registered disability savings plan;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} a registered education savings plan;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} a registered pension plan;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} a trust governed by a registered pension plan;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} a trust described in paragraph 149(1)(o.4) of the
  Act, if all of the interests in the trust as a beneficiary are held by
  one or more registered pension plans;

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} a corporation described in clause 149(1)(o.1)(i)(A)
  or subparagraph 149(1)(o.1)(ii) or (o.2)(i) of the Act;

- [(l)]{.lawlabel} a corporation described in any of subparagraphs
  149(1)(o.2)(ii) to (iii) of the Act, if all of the shares of the
  corporation are held by

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} one or more registered pension plans or trusts
    governed by registered pension plans,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} one or more trusts described in paragraph (j), or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} one or more corporations described in this
    paragraph or paragraph (k);

- [(m)]{.lawlabel} a trust, if all of the interests in the trust as a
  beneficiary are held by one or more plans, trusts or corporations
  described in paragraph (i), (k) or (l);

- [(n)]{.lawlabel} a [[central cooperative credit
  society]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined in section 2 of the
  [Cooperative Credit Associations Act](/eng/acts/C-41.01) and whose
  accounts are maintained for member financial institutions;

- [(o)]{.lawlabel} a TFSA; and

- [(p)]{.lawlabel} a FHSA.

## [PART XCI]{.HLabel1}[Financial Institutions --- Income from Specified Debt Obligations]{.HTitleText1} {#h-596635 .Part}

### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596636 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[9100]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9100 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Part.

[[fixed payment obligation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[fixed payment obligation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, of a taxpayer,
    means a specified debt obligation under which

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount and timing of each payment (other than
      a fee or similar payment or an amount payable because of a default
      by the debtor) to be made by the debtor were fixed when the
      taxpayer acquired the obligation and have not been changed; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} all payments are to be made in the same
      currency. ([titre à paiements fixes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[primary currency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[primary currency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, of a specified debt
    obligation, means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the currency with which the obligation is
      primarily connected; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if there is no such currency, Canadian
      currency. ([monnaie principale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[tax basis]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[tax basis]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, of a specified debt obligation at
    any time to a taxpayer, has the meaning assigned by subsection
    142.4(1) of the Act. ([montant de base]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[total return]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[total return]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, of a taxpayer from a fixed
    payment obligation, means the amount, measured in the primary
    currency of the obligation, by which

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the total of all amounts each of which is the
      amount of a payment (other than a fee or similar payment) required
      to be made by the debtor under the obligation after its
      acquisition by the taxpayer

    exceeds

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the cost to the taxpayer of the
      obligation. ([rendement total]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/2009-222, s. 7
:::

### [Prescribed Inclusions and Deductions]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596652 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Inclusion

- **[[9101]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9101
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of paragraph
  142.3(1)(a) of the Act, where a taxpayer holds a specified debt
  obligation at any time in a taxation year, the amount prescribed in
  respect of the obligation for the year is the total of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the taxpayer's accrued return from the obligation
    for the year,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the taxpayer's accrual adjustment determined
    under section 9102 in respect of the obligation for the year is
    greater than nil, the amount of the adjustment, and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if a foreign exchange adjustment is determined
    under section 9104 in respect of the obligation for the year and is
    greater than nil, the amount of the adjustment.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deduction

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of paragraph 142.3(1)(b) of the Act,
  where a taxpayer holds a specified debt obligation at any time in a
  taxation year, the amount prescribed in respect of the obligation is
  the total of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the taxpayer's accrual adjustment determined
    under section 9102 in respect of the obligation for the year is less
    than nil, the absolute value of the amount of the adjustment, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if a foreign exchange adjustment is determined
    under section 9104 in respect of the obligation for the year and is
    less than nil, the absolute value of the amount of the adjustment.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
