- SOR/2009-222, s. 7
:::

### [General Accrual Rules]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596665 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Fixed payment obligation not in default

- **[[9102]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9102
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of paragraph
  9101(1)(a), a taxpayer's accrued return for a taxation year from a
  fixed payment obligation, under which each payment required to be made
  before the end of the year was made by the debtor when it was required
  to be made, shall be determined in accordance with the following
  rules:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} determine, in the primary currency of the
    obligation, the portion of the taxpayer's total return from the
    obligation that is allocated to each day in the year using

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the level-yield method described in subsection
      (2), or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any other reasonable method that is
      substantially similar to the level-yield method;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the primary currency of the obligation is not
    Canadian currency, translate to Canadian currency the amount
    allocated to each day in the year, using a reasonable method of
    translation; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} determine the total of all amounts each of which is
    the Canadian currency amount allocated to a day, in the year, at the
    beginning of which the taxpayer holds the obligation.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Level-yield method

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (1), the level-yield
  method for allocating a taxpayer's total return from a fixed payment
  obligation is the method that allocates, to each particular day in the
  period that begins on the day following the day on which the taxpayer
  acquired the obligation and that ends on the day on which the
  obligation matures, the amount determined by the formula

  ::: {#596676 .Subsection}
  (A + B - C) × D

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the cost of the obligation to the taxpayer (expressed in the
      primary currency of the obligation);

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the portion of the
      taxpayer's total return from the obligation that is allocated to a
      day before the particular day;

  [C]{.dfn}
  :   is the total of all payments required to be made under the
      obligation after it was acquired by the taxpayer and before the
      particular day; and

  [D]{.dfn}
  :   is the rate of interest per day that, if used in computing the
      present value (as of the end of the day on which the taxpayer
      acquired the obligation and based on daily compounding) of all
      payments to be made under the obligation after it was acquired by
      the taxpayer, produces a present value equal to the cost to the
      taxpayer of the obligation (expressed in the primary currency of
      the obligation).
  :::

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Other specified debt obligations

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of paragraph 9101(1)(a), a taxpayer's
  accrued return for a taxation year from a specified debt obligation,
  other than an obligation to which subsection (1) applies, shall be
  determined

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} using a reasonable method that,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} taking into account the extent to which the
      obligation differs from fixed payment obligations, is consistent
      with the principles implicit in the methods that can be used under
      subsection (1) for fixed payment obligations, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} is in accordance with generally accepted
      accounting practice for the measurement of profit from debt
      obligations; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} on the basis of reasonable assumptions with respect
    to the timing and amount of any payments to be made by the debtor
    under the obligation that are not fixed in their timing or amount
    (expressed in the primary currency of the obligation).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Accrual adjustment nil

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraphs 9101(1)(b) and (2)(a),
  if subsection 142.3(1) of the Act applies to a taxpayer for a
  particular taxation year in respect of a specified debt obligation and
  either the subsection did not apply in respect of the obligation for
  the taxpayer's immediately preceding taxation year or the taxpayer did
  not own the obligation at the end of that immediately preceding
  taxation year, the taxpayer's accrual adjustment in respect of the
  obligation for the particular taxation year is nil.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Accrual adjustment

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraphs 9101(1)(b) and (2)(a),
  if subsection (4) does not apply to determine a taxpayer's accrual
  adjustment in respect of a specified debt obligation for a particular
  taxation year, the taxpayer's accrual adjustment is the positive or
  negative amount determined by the formula

  ::: {#596692 .Subsection}
  A - B

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount that would
      be the taxpayer's accrued return from the obligation for a
      taxation year, before the particular taxation year, for which
      subsection 142.3(1) of the Act applied to the taxpayer in respect
      of the obligation if the accrued return were redetermined on the
      basis of
      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the information available at the end of the
        particular taxation year, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the assumptions, if any, with respect to the
        timing and amount of payments to be made under the obligation
        after the particular taxation year that were used for the
        purpose of determining the taxpayer's accrued return from the
        obligation for the particular taxation year; and

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the total of
      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount included under paragraph 9101(1)(a)
        as the taxpayer's accrued return from the obligation for the
        taxation year immediately preceding the particular taxation
        year, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the taxpayer's accrual adjustment in respect
        of the obligation for that immediately preceding taxation year
        was determined under this subsection, the value of A for the
        purpose of determining that accrual adjustment.
  :::

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Special cases and transition

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} The rules in this section for determining accrued
  returns and accrual adjustments are subject to section 9103.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/2009-222, s. 7
:::

### [Accrual Rules --- Special Cases and Transition]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596704 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Convertible obligation

- **[[9103]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9103
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of section 9102, if
  the terms of a specified debt obligation of a taxpayer give the
  taxpayer the right to exchange the obligation for shares of the debtor
  or of a corporation related to the debtor

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} subject to paragraph (b), the right shall be
    disregarded (whether it has been exercised or not); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if 5% or more of the cost of the obligation to the
    taxpayer is attributable to the right, the cost is deemed to equal
    the amount by which the cost exceeds the portion of the cost
    attributable to the right.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2009-222, s. 7\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amendment of obligation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the terms of a specified debt obligation of a
  taxpayer are amended at any time in a taxation year of the taxpayer to
  change the timing or amount of any payment to be made, at or after
  that time, under the obligation, the taxpayer's accrued returns for
  the taxation year and for each subsequent taxation year are to be
  redetermined under section 9102 using a reasonable method that fully
  gives effect, in those accrued returns, to the alteration to the
  payments under the obligation.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Obligations acquired before financial
  institution rules apply

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If a taxpayer held a specified debt obligation at the
  beginning of the taxpayer's first taxation year (in this subsection
  referred to as the "initial year") for which subsection 142.3(1) of
  the Act applied to the taxpayer in respect of the obligation, the
  following rules apply:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the taxpayer's accrued return from the obligation
    for the initial year or a subsequent taxation year shall not include
    an amount to the extent that the amount was included in computing
    the taxpayer's income for a taxation year preceding the initial
    year; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if interest on the obligation in respect of a
    period before the initial year becomes receivable or is received by
    the taxpayer in a particular taxation year that is the initial year
    or a subsequent taxation year, and all or part of the interest would
    not, but for this paragraph, be included in computing the taxpayer's
    income for any taxation year, there shall be included in determining
    the taxpayer's accrued return from the obligation for the particular
    taxation year the amount, if any, by which

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the portion of the interest that would not
      otherwise be included in computing the taxpayer's income for any
      taxation year

    exceeds

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the portion of the cost of the obligation to the
      taxpayer that is reasonably attributable to that portion of the
      interest.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prepaid interest --- transition rule

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} If, before November 1994 and in a taxation year that
  ended after February 22, 1994, a taxpayer received an amount under a
  specified debt obligation in satisfaction, in whole or in part, of the
  debtor's obligation to pay interest in respect of a period after the
  taxation year,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount may, at the election of the taxpayer, be
    included in determining the taxpayer's accrued return for the
    taxation year from the obligation; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the amount is so included, the taxpayer's
    accrued returns for subsequent taxation years from the obligation
    shall not include any amount in respect of interest that, because of
    the payment of the amount, the debtor is no longer required to pay.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/2009-222, s. 7
:::

### [Foreign Exchange Adjustment]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596726 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Obligations held at end of taxation year

- **[[9104]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9104
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraphs
  9101(1)(c) and (2)(b), if, at the end of a taxation year, a taxpayer
  holds a specified debt obligation the primary currency of which is not
  Canadian currency, the taxpayer's foreign exchange adjustment in
  respect of the obligation for the taxation year is the positive or
  negative amount determined by the formula

  ::: {#596730 .Subsection}
  (A × B) - C

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the amount that would be the tax basis of the obligation to the
      taxpayer at the end of the year if
      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the tax basis were determined using the primary
        currency of the obligation as the currency in which all amounts
        are expressed,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the definition [[tax
        basis]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 142.4(1) of the Act
        were read without reference to paragraphs (f), (h), (o) and (q),
        and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the taxpayer's foreign exchange adjustment in
        respect of the obligation for each year were nil;

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the rate of exchange at the end of the year of the primary
      currency of the obligation into Canadian currency; and

  [C]{.dfn}
  :   is the amount that would be the tax basis of the obligation to the
      taxpayer at the end of the year if
      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the definition [[tax
        basis]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 142.4(1) of the Act
        were read without reference to paragraphs (h) and (q), and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the taxpayer's foreign exchange adjustment in
        respect of the obligation for the year were nil.
  :::

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disposition of obligation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a taxpayer disposes of a specified debt obligation
  the primary currency of which is not Canadian currency, the taxpayer's
  foreign exchange adjustment in respect of the obligation for the
  taxation year in which the disposition occurs is the amount that would
  be the foreign exchange adjustment if the taxation year had ended
  immediately before the disposition.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disposition of obligation before 1996

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} At the election of a taxpayer, subsection (2) does
  not apply to specified debt obligations disposed of by the taxpayer
  before 1996.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/2009-222, s. 7
:::

## [PART XCII]{.HLabel1}[Financial Institutions --- Disposition of Specified Debt Obligations]{.HTitleText1} {#h-596746 .Part}

### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596747 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

- **[[9200]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9200
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in
  this Part.

  [[gain]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[gain]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, of a taxpayer from the disposition
      of a specified debt obligation, means the gain from the
      disposition determined under paragraph 142.4(6)(a) of the
      Act. ([gain]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[loss]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[loss]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, of a taxpayer from the disposition
      of a specified debt obligation, means the loss from the
      disposition determined under paragraph 142.4(6)(b) of the
      Act. ([perte]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[residual portion]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[residual portion]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, of a taxpayer's gain or
      loss from the disposition of a specified debt obligation, means
      the amount determined under subsection 142.4(8) of the Act in
      respect of the disposition. ([partie résiduelle]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amortization date

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, the amortization date
  for a specified debt obligation disposed of by a taxpayer is the day
  determined as follows:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} subject to paragraphs (b) to (d), the amortization
    date is the later of the day of disposition and the day on which the
    debtor is required to make the final payment under the obligation,
    determined without regard to any option respecting the timing of
    payments under the obligation (other than an option that was
    exercised before the disposition);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subject to paragraphs (c) and (d), the amortization
    date is the day of disposition if the day on which the debtor is
    required to make the final payment under the obligation is not
    determinable for the purpose of paragraph (a);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} subject to paragraph (d), the amortization date is
    the first day, if any, after the disposition on which the interest
    rate could change, if the obligation is one in respect of which the
    following conditions are satisfied:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the obligation provides for stipulated interest
      payments,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the rate of interest for one or more periods
      after the issuance of the obligation was not fixed on the day of
      issue, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} when the obligation was issued, it was
      reasonable to expect that the interest rate for each period would
      equal or approximate a reasonable market rate of interest for that
      period; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} if, for purposes of its financial statements, the
    taxpayer had a gain or loss from the disposition that is being
    amortized to profit, the amortization date is the last day of the
    amortization period.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/2009-222, s. 7
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transition amount

**[[9201]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9201 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 142.4(1) of the Act, [[transition
amount]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, of a taxpayer in respect of the
disposition of a specified debt obligation, means,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} if neither paragraph (b) nor (c) applies, nil;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} if

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the taxpayer acquired the obligation before its
    taxation year that includes February 23, 1994,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} neither paragraph 7000(2)(a) nor (b) has applied
    to the obligation, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the principal amount of the obligation exceeds
    the cost of the obligation to the taxpayer (which excess is referred
    to in this paragraph as the "discount"),

  the amount determined by the formula

  ::: {#596773 .Paragraph}
  A - B

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount included
      in respect of the discount in computing the taxpayer's profit for
      a taxation year that ended before February 23, 1994, and

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount included
      in respect of the discount in computing the taxpayer's income for
      a taxation year that ended before February 23, 1994; and
  :::

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} where

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the conditions in subparagraphs (b)(i) and (ii) are
    satisfied, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the cost of the obligation to the taxpayer exceeds
    the principal amount of the obligation (which excess is referred to
    in this paragraph as the "premium"),

  the negative of the amount determined by the formula

  ::: {#596781 .Paragraph}
  A - B

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount deducted
      in respect of the premium in computing the taxpayer's profit for a
      taxation year that ended before February 23, 1994, and

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount deducted
      in respect of the premium in computing the taxpayer's income for a
      taxation year that ended before February 23, 1994.
  :::

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/2009-222, s. 7
:::

### [Prescribed Debt Obligations]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596787 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application of related election

- **[[9202]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9202
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following rules apply with
  respect to an election made under subsection (3) or (4) by a taxpayer:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the election applies only if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it is in writing,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} it specifies the first taxation year (in this
      subsection referred to as the "initial year") of the taxpayer to
      which it is to apply, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} either it is received by the Minister within
      six months after the end of the initial year, or the Minister has
      expressly accepted the later filing of the election;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subject to paragraph (c), the election applies to
    dispositions of specified debt obligations in the initial year and
    subsequent taxation years; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the Minister has approved, on written
    application by the taxpayer, the revocation of the election, the
    election does not apply to dispositions of specified debt
    obligations in the taxation year specified in the application and in
    subsequent taxation years.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prescribed specified debt obligation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subparagraph 142.4(5)(a)(ii) of
  the Act, a specified debt obligation disposed of by a taxpayer in a
  taxation year is prescribed in respect of the taxpayer if the
  amortization date for the obligation is not more than two years after
  the end of the taxation year.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prescribed specified debt obligation
  --- exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not apply in respect of a
  taxpayer for a taxation year if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} generally accepted accounting principles require
    that the taxpayer's gains and losses arising on the disposition of a
    class of debt obligations be amortized to profit for the purpose of
    the taxpayer's financial statements;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the taxpayer has elected not to have subsection (2)
    apply; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the election applies to dispositions in the year.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prescribed specified debt obligation

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subparagraph 142.4(5)(a)(ii) of
  the Act, a specified debt obligation disposed of by a taxpayer in a
  taxation year is prescribed in respect of the taxpayer if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the taxpayer has elected to have this subsection
    apply;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the election applies to dispositions in the year;
    and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the absolute value of the positive or negative
    amount determined by the formula (A - B) does not exceed the lesser
    of \$5,000 and the amount, if any, specified in the election, where

    ::: {#596809 .Paragraph}

    [A]{.dfn}
    :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the residual
        portion of the taxpayer's gain from the disposition of the
        obligation or any other specified debt obligation disposed of in
        the same transaction, and

    [B]{.dfn}
    :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the residual
        portion of the taxpayer's loss from the disposition of the
        obligation or any other specified debt obligation disposed of in
        the same transaction.
    :::

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prescribed specified debt obligation

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subparagraph 142.4(5)(a)(ii) of
  the Act, a specified debt obligation disposed of by a taxpayer in a
  taxation year is prescribed in respect of the taxpayer if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the disposition resulted in an extinguishment of
    the obligation, other than an extinguishment that occurred because
    of a purchase of the obligation by the debtor in the open market;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the taxpayer had the right to require the
    obligation to be settled at any time; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the debtor had the right to settle the obligation
    at any time.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/2009-222, s. 7
:::

### [Residual Portion of Gain or Loss]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596819 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Allocation of residual portion

- **[[9203]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9203
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 9204, if
  subsection 142.4(4) of the Act applies to the disposition of a
  specified debt obligation by a taxpayer, the amount allocated to each
  taxation year in respect of the residual portion of the gain or loss
  from the disposition shall be determined, for the purpose of that
  subsection,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} by a method that complies with, or is substantially
    similar to a method that complies with, subsection (2); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if gains and losses from the disposition of debt
    obligations are amortized to profit for the purpose of the
    taxpayer's financial statements, by the method used for the purpose
    of the taxpayer's financial statements.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Proration method

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (1), a method for
  allocating to taxation years the residual portion of a taxpayer's gain
  or loss from the disposition of a specified debt obligation complies
  with this subsection if the amount allocated to each taxation year is
  determined by the formula

  ::: {#596827 .Subsection}
  A × B/C

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the residual portion of the taxpayer's gain or loss;

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the number of days in the taxation year that are in the period
      referred to in the description of C; and

  [C]{.dfn}
  :   is the number of days in the period that,
      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where subsection (3) applies in respect of the
        obligation, is determined under that subsection, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case,

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} begins on the day on which the taxpayer
          disposed of the obligation, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} ends on the earlier of

          - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the amortization date for the obligation,
            and

          - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the day that is 20 years after the day on
            which the taxpayer disposed of the obligation.
  :::

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Single proration period

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} This subsection applies in respect of specified debt
  obligations disposed of by a taxpayer in a transaction in a taxation
  year, and the period determined under this subsection in respect of
  the obligations is the period that begins on the day of disposition
  and ends on the weighted average amortization date for those
  obligations so disposed of to which subsection 142.4(4) of the Act
  applies, if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the taxpayer has elected in its return of income
    for the taxation year to have this subsection apply in respect of
    the obligations so disposed of;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} all the obligations so disposed of were disposed of
    at the same time; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the number of the obligations so disposed of to
    which subsection 142.4(4) of the Act applies is at least 50.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Weighted average amortization date

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (3), the weighted
  average amortization date for a group of specified debt obligations
  disposed of on the same day by a taxpayer is,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if paragraph (b) does not apply, the day that is
    the number of days after the day of disposition equal to the total
    of the number of days determined in respect of each obligation by
    the formula

    ::: {#596846 .Paragraph}
    A × B/C

    where

    [A]{.dfn}
    :   is the number of days from the day of disposition to the
        amortization date for the obligation,

    [B]{.dfn}
    :   is the residual portion of the gain or loss from the disposition
        of the obligation, and

    [C]{.dfn}
    :   is the total of all amounts each of which is the residual
        portion of the gain or loss from the disposition of an
        obligation in the group; and
    :::

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the day that the taxpayer determines using a
    reasonable method for estimating the day determined under paragraph
    (a).

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/2009-222, s. 7
:::

### [Special Rules for Residual Portion of Gain or Loss]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596854 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

- **[[9204]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9204
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This section applies for the
  purposes of subparagraphs 142.4(4)(c)(ii) and (d)(ii) of the Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Winding-up

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If subsection 88(1) of the Act has applied to the
  winding-up of a taxpayer (in this subsection referred to as the
  "subsidiary"), the following rules apply in respect of the residual
  portion of a gain or loss of the subsidiary from the disposition of a
  specified debt obligation to which subsection 142.4(4) of the Act
  applies:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount of that residual portion allocated to
    the taxation year of the subsidiary in which its assets were
    distributed to its parent on the winding-up shall be determined on
    the assumption that the taxation year ended when the assets were
    distributed to its parent;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} no amount shall be allocated in respect of that
    residual portion to any taxation year of the subsidiary after its
    taxation year in which its assets were distributed to its parent;
    and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the amount of that residual portion allocated to
    the taxation year of the parent in which the subsidiary's assets
    were distributed to it shall be determined on the assumption that
    the taxation year began when the assets were distributed to it.

- [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2009-302, s. 12\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transfer of an insurance business

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} No amount in respect of the residual portion of a
  gain or loss of an insurer from the disposition of a specified debt
  obligation to which subsection 142.4(4) of the Act applies shall be
  allocated to any taxation year of the insurer that ends after the
  insurer ceased to carry on all or substantially all of an insurance
  business, if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} subsection 138(11.5) or (11.94) of the Act has
    applied to the transfer of that business; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the person to whom that business was transferred is
    considered, because of paragraph 138(11.5)(k) of the Act, to be the
    same person as the insurer in respect of that residual portion.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transfer to new partnership

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If subsection 98(6) of the Act deems a partnership
  (in this subsection referred to as the "new partnership") to be a
  continuation of another partnership (in this subsection referred to as
  the "predecessor partnership"), the following rules apply in respect
  of the residual portion of a gain or loss of the predecessor
  partnership from the disposition of a specified debt obligation to
  which subsection 142.4(4) of the Act applies:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount of that residual portion allocated to
    the taxation year of the predecessor partnership in which its
    property was transferred to the new partnership shall be determined
    on the assumption that the taxation year ended when the property was
    transferred;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} no amount shall be allocated in respect of that
    residual portion to any taxation year of the predecessor partnership
    after its taxation year in which its property was transferred to the
    new partnership; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the amount of that residual portion allocated to
    the taxation year of the new partnership in which the predecessor
    partnership's property was transferred to it shall be determined on
    the assumption that the taxation year began when the property was
    transferred to it.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Ceasing to carry on business

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} There shall be allocated to a particular taxation
  year of a taxpayer the part, if any, of the residual portion of the
  taxpayer's gain or loss that is from a disposition of a specified debt
  obligation to which subsection 142.4(4) of the Act applies and that
  was not allocated to a preceding taxation year, if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} at any time in the particular taxation year the
    taxpayer ceases to carry on all or substantially all of a business,
    otherwise than as a result of a merger to which subsection 87(2) of
    the Act applies, a winding-up to which subsection 88(1) of the Act
    applies or a transfer of the business to which subsection 98(6) or
    138(11.5) or (11.94) of the Act applies;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the disposition occurred before that time; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the specified debt obligation was property used in
    the business.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-resident taxpayer

  [(5.1)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (5), a non-resident
  taxpayer is considered to cease to carry on all or substantially all
  of a business if the taxpayer ceases to carry on, or ceases to carry
  on in Canada, all or substantially all of the part of the business
  that was carried on in Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Ceasing to be a financial institution

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} There shall be allocated to a particular taxation
  year of a taxpayer the part, if any, of the residual portion of the
  taxpayer's gain or loss that is from a disposition of a specified debt
  obligation to which subsection 142.4(4) of the Act applies and that
  was not allocated to a preceding taxation year, if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the particular taxation year ends immediately
    before the time at which the taxpayer ceases to be a financial
    institution, otherwise than because it has ceased to carry on a
    business; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the disposition occurred before that time.

- SOR/2009-302, s. 12

## [PART XCIII]{.HLabel1}[Film or Video Production Services Tax Credit]{.HTitleText1} {#h-596886 .Part}

### [Accredited Production]{.HTitleText2} {#h-596887 .Subheading}

- **[[9300]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9300
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), for the
  purpose of section 125.5 of the Act, accredited production means

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a film or video production in respect of which the
    aggregate expenditures, included in the cost of the production, in
    the period that ends 24 months after the time that the principal
    filming or taping of the production began, exceeds \$1,000,000; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a film or video production that is part of a series
    of television productions that has two or more episodes, or is a
    pilot programme for such a series of episodes, in respect of which
    the aggregate expenditures included in the cost of each episode in
    the period that ends 24 months after the time that the principal
    filming or taping of the production began exceeds

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an episode whose running time is
      less than 30 minutes, \$100,000, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, \$200,000.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} The references to "24 months" in paragraphs
  9300(1)(a) and (b) are to be read as references to "36 months" in
  respect of film or video productions for which the Canadian labour
  expenditure of the corporation in respect of the production for the
  taxation years ending in 2020 or 2021 was greater than nil.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} An accredited production does not include a
  production that is any of the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} news, current events or public affairs programming,
    or a programme that includes weather or market reports;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a talk show;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a production in respect of a game, questionnaire or
    contest;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a sports event or activity;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a gala presentation or awards show;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a production that solicits funds;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} reality television;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} pornography;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} advertising; and

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a production produced primarily for industrial,
    corporate or institutional purposes.

## [PART XCV]{.HLabel1}[Employee Life and Health Trusts]{.HTitleText1} {#h-596914 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prescribed rights

**[[9500]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9500 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subparagraph 144.1(2)(g)(iii) of the Act, prescribed payments are
payments to General Motors of Canada Limited or Chrysler Canada Inc. by
the employee life and health trust established for the benefit of
retired automobile industry workers by the Canadian Auto Workers' Union
that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} are reasonable in the circumstances;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} are made as consideration for administrative services
  provided to or on behalf of the trust or its beneficiaries, or as
  reimbursement for employee benefit payments made on behalf of, or in
  contemplation of the establishment of, the trust; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the recipient acknowledges in writing shall be
  included in computing the recipient's income in the year that they are
  receivable, to the extent that the recipient deducts in the year, or
  deducted in a prior year, in computing its income amounts in respect
  of the services or benefit payments described in paragraph (b).

- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated

- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]

## [PART XCVI]{.HLabel1}[School Supplies Tax Credit]{.HTitleText1} {#h-596922 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prescribed durable goods

**[[9600]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9600 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
the definition [[teaching supplies]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection
122.9(1) of the Act, the following are prescribed durable goods:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} books;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} games and puzzles;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} containers (such as plastic boxes or banker boxes);

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} educational support software;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} calculators (including graphing calculators);

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} external data storage devices;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} web cams, microphones and headphones;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} multimedia projectors;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} wireless pointer devices;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} electronic educational toys;

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} digital timers;

- [(l)]{.lawlabel} speakers;

- [(m)]{.lawlabel} video streaming devices;

- [(n)]{.lawlabel} printers; and

- [(o)]{.lawlabel} laptop, desktop and tablet computers, provided that
  none of these items are made available to the eligible educator by
  their employer for use outside of the classroom.

## [PART XCVII]{.HLabel1}[COVID-19 --- Air Quality Improvement Tax Credit]{.HTitleText1} {#h-1352299 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Tax credit --- air quality improvement

- **[[9700]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9700
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in
  this section.

  [[HEPA filter]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[HEPA filter]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a high-efficiency
      particulate air filter that has been tested to ensure efficiency
      equal to or exceeding 99.97% for removal of airborne particles
      having a mean aerodynamic diameter of 0.3 µm (micrometres) from
      the air. ([filtre HEPA]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[HVAC system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[HVAC system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a mechanical heating,
      ventilating and air conditioning system that is installed in a
      building, and includes all of its equipment and
      components. ([système CVCA]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[MERV]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[MERV]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the minimum efficiency
      reporting value parameters specified in ANSI/ASHRAE Standard
      52.2-2017, Method of Testing General Ventilation Air-Cleaning
      Devices for Removal Efficiency by Particle Size, Section 12,
      Minimum Efficiency Reporting Value (MERV) for Air Cleaners, Table
      12-1, Minimum Efficiency Reporting Value (MERV)
      Parameters. ([MERV]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), for the purposes of the
  definition [[qualifying expenditure]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in
  subsection 127.43(1) of the Act, the following outlays and expenses
  are prescribed to the extent that they are reasonable and intended
  primarily to increase outdoor air intake or to improve air cleaning:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} outlays and expenses that are directly attributable
    to the purchase, installation, conversion or upgrade of a new or
    retrofitted HVAC system placed in service at a qualifying location
    that meets either of the following conditions:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the system is designed to filter air at a rate in
      excess of MERV 8 or an equivalent level of filtration, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the system is designed to filter air at a rate
      equal to MERV 8 or an equivalent level of filtration and the
      following conditions are met:

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the system is designed to achieve an outdoor
        air supply rate in excess of what is required for the space by
        applicable building codes, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an upgrade or conversion of an
        existing system, prior to the upgrade or conversion, the system
        was designed to filter air at a rate equal to MERV 8; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} outlays and expenses that are directly attributable
    to the purchase of a device that is placed in service at a
    qualifying location and designed to filter air using a HEPA filter.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The outlays and expenses in subsection (2) do not
  include an outlay or expense of an eligible entity

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} made or incurred under the terms of an agreement
    entered into before the start of the qualifying period;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is the cost of recurring or routine repair or
    maintenance;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} that can reasonably be expected to be paid or
    returned, directly or indirectly, in any manner whatever, to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the eligible entity,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a person or partnership not dealing at arm's
      length with the eligible entity, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} another person or partnership at the direction
      of the eligible entity;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} that is paid to a party with which the eligible
    entity does not deal at arm's length;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} that is salary or wages paid to an employee of the
    eligible entity; or

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} for financing costs.

## [SCHEDULE II]{.scheduleLabel}[(Sections 215, 700, 701, 1100 to 1105, 1205, 1206, 1700, 1704, 3900, 4600, 4601, 5202 and 5204)]{.OriginatingRef}[Capital Cost Allowances]{.scheduleTitleText}  {#h-597000 .scheduleLabel}
:::

### [CLASS 1]{.HLabel1}[(4 per cent)]{.HTitleText1} {#class-14-per-cent .SchedHeadL1}

Property not included in any other class that is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a bridge;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a canal;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a culvert;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a dam;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} a jetty acquired before May 26, 1976;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} a mole acquired before May 26, 1976;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} a road, sidewalk, airplane runway, parking area,
  storage area or similar surface construction, acquired before May 26,
  1976;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} railway track and grading, including components such
  as rails, ballast, ties and other track material,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} that is not part of a railway system, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} that was acquired after May 25, 1976;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} railway traffic control or signalling equipment,
  acquired after May 25, 1976, including switching, block signalling,
  interlocking, crossing protection, detection, speed control or
  retarding equipment, but not including property that is principally
  electronic equipment or systems software therefor;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} a subway or tunnel, acquired after May 25, 1976;

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} electrical generating equipment (except as specified
  elsewhere in this Schedule);

- [(l)]{.lawlabel} a pipeline, other than

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a pipeline that is gas or oil well equipment, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a pipeline that is for oil or natural gas if the
    Minister, in consultation with the Minister of Natural Resources, is
    or has been satisfied that the main source of supply for the
    pipeline is or was likely to be exhausted within 15 years after the
    date on which the operation of the pipeline commenced;

- [(m)]{.lawlabel} the generating or distributing equipment and plant
  (including structures) of a producer or distributor of electrical
  energy;

- [(n)]{.lawlabel} manufacturing and distributing equipment and plant
  (including structures) acquired primarily for the production or
  distribution of gas, except

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a property acquired for the purpose of producing or
    distributing gas that is normally distributed in portable
    containers,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a property acquired for the purpose of processing
    natural gas, before the delivery of such gas to a distribution
    system, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a property acquired for the purpose of producing
    oxygen or nitrogen;

- [(o)]{.lawlabel} the distributing equipment and plant (including
  structures) of a distributor of water;

- [(p)]{.lawlabel} the production and distributing equipment and plant
  (including structures) of a distributor of heat; or

- [(q)]{.lawlabel} a building or other structure, or a part of it,
  including any component parts such as electric wiring, plumbing,
  sprinkler systems, air-conditioning equipment, heating equipment,
  lighting fixtures, elevators and escalators (except property described
  in any of paragraphs (k) and (m) to (p) of this Class or in any of
  paragraphs (a) to (e) of Class 8).

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/90-22, s. 10
- SOR/97-377, s. 6
- SOR/2005-371, s. 7
- SOR/2006-117, s. 8
- SOR/2010-93, s. 27(F)
:::

### [CLASS 2]{.HLabel1}[(6 per cent)]{.HTitleText1} {#class-26-per-cent .SchedHeadL1}

Property that is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} electrical generating equipment (except as specified
  elsewhere in this Schedule),

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a pipeline, other than gas or oil well equipment,
  unless, in the case of a pipeline for oil or natural gas, the Minister
  in consultation with the Minister of Energy, Mines and Resources, is
  or has been satisfied that the main source of supply for the pipeline
  is or was likely to be exhausted within 15 years from the date on
  which operation of the pipeline commenced,

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the generating or distributing equipment and plant
  (including structures) of a producer or distributor of electrical
  energy, except a property included in Class 10, 13, 14, 26 or 28,

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} manufacturing and distributing equipment and plant
  (including structures) acquired primarily for the production or
  distribution of gas, except

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a property included in Class 10, 13 or 14,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a property acquired for the purpose of producing
    or distributing gas that is normally distributed in portable
    containers,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a property acquired for the purpose of processing
    natural gas, before delivery of such gas to a distribution system,
    or

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a property acquired for the purpose of producing
    oxygen or nitrogen,

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the distributing equipment and plant (including
  structures) of a distributor of water, except a property included in
  Class 10, 13 or 14,

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} the production and distributing equipment and plant
  (including structures) of a distributor of heat, except a property
  included in Class 10, 13 or 14,

acquired by the taxpayer

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} before 1988, or

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} before 1990

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} pursuant to an obligation in writing entered into
    by the taxpayer before June 18, 1987,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} that was under construction by or on behalf of the
    taxpayer on June 18, 1987, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} that is machinery or equipment that is a fixed
    and integral part of a building, structure, plant facility or other
    property that was under construction by or on behalf of the taxpayer
    on June 18, 1987.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/79-427, s. 2
- SOR/85-270, s. 1
- SOR/86-1092, ss. 19(F), 20
- SOR/90-22, s. 11
:::

### [CLASS 3]{.HLabel1}[(5 per cent)]{.HTitleText1} {#class-35-per-cent .SchedHeadL1}

Property not included in any other class that is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a building or other structure, or part thereof,
  including component parts such as electric wiring, plumbing, sprinkler
  systems, air-conditioning equipment, heating equipment, lighting
  fixtures, elevators and escalators, acquired by the taxpayer

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} before 1988, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} before 1990

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} pursuant to an obligation in writing entered into
      by the taxpayer before June 18, 1987,

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} that was under construction by or on behalf of
      the taxpayer on June 18, 1987, or

    - [(C)]{.lawlabel} that is a component part of a building that was
      under construction by or on behalf of the taxpayer on June 18,
      1987;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a breakwater;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a dock;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a trestle;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} a windmill;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} a wharf;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} an addition or alteration, made during the period
  that is after March 31, 1967 and before 1988, to a building that would
  have been included in this class during that period but for the fact
  that it was included in Class 20;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} a jetty acquired after May 25, 1976;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} a mole acquired after May 25, 1976;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} telephone, telegraph or data communication equipment,
  acquired after May 25, 1976, that is a wire or cable;

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} an addition or alteration, other than an addition or
  alteration described in paragraph (k) of Class 6, made after 1987, to
  a building included, in whole or in part,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in this class,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in Class 6 by virtue of subparagraph (a)(viii)
    thereof, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} in Class 20,

  to the extent that the aggregate cost of all such additions or
  alterations to the building does not exceed the lesser of

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} \$500,000, and

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} 25 per cent of the aggregate of the amounts that
    would, but for this paragraph, be the capital cost of the building
    and any additions or alterations thereto included in this class or
    Class 6 or 20; or

- [(l)]{.lawlabel} ancillary to a wire or cable referred to in
  paragraph (j) or Class 42 and that is supporting equipment such as a
  pole, mast, tower, conduit, brace, crossarm, guy or insulator.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/78-949, s. 2
- SOR/90-22, s. 12
- SOR/94-140, s. 17
:::

### [CLASS 4]{.HLabel1}[(6 per cent)]{.HTitleText1} {#class-46-per-cent .SchedHeadL1}

Property that would otherwise be included in another class in this
Schedule that is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a railway system or a part thereof, except automotive
  equipment not designed to run on rails or tracks, that was acquired
  after the end of the taxpayer's 1958 taxation year and before May 26,
  1976; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a tramway or trolley bus system or a part thereof,
  except property included in Class 10, 13 or 14.

### [CLASS 5]{.HLabel1}[(10 per cent)]{.HTitleText1} {#class-510-per-cent .SchedHeadL1}

Property that is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a chemical pulp mill or ground wood pulp mill,
  including buildings, machinery and equipment, but not including
  hydro-electric power plants and their equipment, or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} an integrated mill producing chemical pulp or ground
  wood pulp and manufacturing therefrom paper, paper board or pulp
  board, including buildings, machinery and equipment, but not including
  hydro-electric power plants and their equipment,

but not including any property that was acquired after the end of the
taxpayer's 1962 taxation year.

### [CLASS 6]{.HLabel1}[(10 per cent)]{.HTitleText1} {#class-610-per-cent .SchedHeadL1}

Property not included in any other class that is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a building of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} frame,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} log,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} stucco on frame,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} galvanized iron, or

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} corrugated metal

  construction, including component parts such as electric wiring,
  plumbing, sprinkler systems, air-conditioning equipment, heating
  equipment, lighting fixtures, elevators and escalators, if the
  building

  - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} is used by the taxpayer for the purpose of gaining
    or producing income from farming or fishing,

  - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} has no footings or any other base support below
    ground level,

  - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} was acquired by the taxpayer before 1979 and is
    not a building described in subparagraph (vi) or (vii),

  - [(ix)]{.lawlabel} was acquired by the taxpayer after 1978 under
    circumstances such that

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} he was obligated to acquire the building under
      the terms of an agreement in writing entered into before 1979, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the installation of footings or any other base
      support of the building was commenced before 1979, or

  - [(x)]{.lawlabel} was acquired by the taxpayer after 1978 under
    circumstances such that

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} he commenced construction of the building before
      1979, or

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the construction of the building was commenced
      under the terms of an agreement in writing entered into by him
      before 1979, and

  the installation of footings or any other base support of the building
  was commenced before 1979;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a wooden breakwater;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a fence;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a greenhouse;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} an oil or water storage tank;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} a railway tank car acquired before May 26, 1976;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} a wooden wharf;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} an airplane hangar acquired after the end of the
  taxpayer's 1958 taxation year;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} an addition or alteration, made

  - [(A)]{.lawlabel} during the period that is after March 31, 1967 and
    before 1979, or

  - [(B)]{.lawlabel} after 1978 if the taxpayer was obligated to have it
    made under the terms of an agreement in writing entered into before
    1979,

  to a building that would have been included in this class during that
  period but for the fact that it was included in Class 20;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} a railway locomotive that is acquired after May 25,
  1976 and before February 26, 2008 and that is not an automotive
  railway car;

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} an addition or alteration, made after 1978 to a
  building included in this class by virtue of subparagraph (a)(viii),
  to the extent that the aggregate cost of all such additions and
  alterations to the building does not exceed \$100,000.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/78-949, s. 3
- SOR/94-140, s. 18
- SOR/2009-126, s. 5
:::

### [CLASS 7]{.HLabel1}[(15 per cent)]{.HTitleText1} {#class-715-per-cent .SchedHeadL1}

Property that is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a canoe or rowboat;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a scow;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a vessel, but not including a vessel

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} of a separate class prescribed by subsection
    1101(2a), or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} included in Class 41;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} furniture, fittings or equipment attached to a
  property included in this class, but not including radiocommunication
  equipment;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} a spare engine for a property included in this class;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} a marine railway;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} a vessel under construction, other than a vessel
  included in Class 41;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} subject to an election made under subsection
  1103(2i), property acquired after February 27, 2000 that is

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a rail suspension device designed to carry trailers
    that are designed to be hauled on both highways and railway tracks,
    or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a railway car;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} property that is acquired after February 27, 2000
  (other than property included in paragraph (y) of Class 10), that is a
  railway locomotive and that is not an automotive railway car;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} pumping or compression equipment, including equipment
  ancillary to pumping and compression equipment, acquired after
  February 22, 2005 if the equipment pumps or compresses petroleum,
  natural gas or a related hydrocarbon for the purpose of moving it

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} through a transmission pipeline,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} from a transmission pipeline to a storage
    facility, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} to a transmission pipeline from a storage
    facility; or

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} pumping or compression equipment that is acquired
  after February 25, 2008, including equipment ancillary to pumping and
  compression equipment, that is on a pipeline and that pumps or
  compresses carbon dioxide for the purpose of moving it through the
  pipeline.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- SOR/90-22, s. 13
- SOR/2005-371, s. 8
- SOR/2006-117, s. 9
- SOR/2009-126, s. 6
:::

### [CLASS 8]{.HLabel1}[(20 per cent)]{.HTitleText1} {#class-820-per-cent .SchedHeadL1}

Property not included in Class 1, 2, 7, 9, 11, 17, 30, 57 or 58 that is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a structure that is manufacturing or processing
  machinery or equipment;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} tangible property attached to a building and acquired
  solely for the purpose of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} servicing, supporting or providing access to or
    egress from, machinery or equipment,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} manufacturing or processing, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} any combination of the functions described in
    subparagraphs (i) and (ii);

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a building that is a kiln, tank or vat, acquired for
  the purpose of manufacturing or processing;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a building or other structure, acquired after
  February 19, 1973, that is designed for the purpose of preserving
  ensilage on a farm;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} a building or other structure, acquired after
  February 19, 1973, that is

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} designed to store fresh fruits or fresh vegetables
    at a controlled level of temperature and humidity, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} to be used principally for the purpose of storing
    fresh fruits or fresh vegetables by or for the person or persons by
    whom they were grown;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} electrical generating equipment acquired after May
  25, 1976, if

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the taxpayer is not a person whose business is the
    production for the use of or distribution to others of electrical
    energy,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the equipment is auxiliary to the taxpayer's main
    power supply, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the equipment is not used regularly as a source
    of supply;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} electrical generating equipment, acquired after May
  25, 1976, that has a maximum load capacity of not more than 15
  kilowatts;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} portable electrical generating equipment acquired
  after May 25, 1976;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} a tangible capital property that is not included in
  another class in this Schedule except

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} land or any part thereof or any interest therein,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an animal,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a tree, shrub, herb or similar growing thing,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} an oil or gas well,

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} a mine,

  - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} a specified temporary access road of the taxpayer,

  - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} radium,

  - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} a right of way,

  - [(ix)]{.lawlabel} a timber limit,

  - [(x)]{.lawlabel} a tramway track, or

  - [(xi)]{.lawlabel} property of a separate class prescribed by
    subsection 1101(2a);

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} property not included in any other class that is
  radiocommunication equipment acquired after May 25, 1976;

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} a rapid transit car that is used for the purpose of
  public transportation within a metropolitan area and is not part of a
  railway system;

- [(l)]{.lawlabel} an outdoor advertising poster panel or bulletin
  board; or

- [(m)]{.lawlabel} a greenhouse constructed of a rigid frame and a
  replaceable, flexible plastic cover.

### [CLASS 9]{.HLabel1}[(25 per cent)]{.HTitleText1} {#class-925-per-cent .SchedHeadL1}

Property acquired before May 26, 1976, other than property included in
Class 30, that is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} electrical generating equipment, if

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the taxpayer is not a person whose business is the
    production for the use of or distribution to others of electrical
    energy,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the equipment is auxiliary to the taxpayer's main
    power supply, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the equipment is not used regularly as a source
    of supply,

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} radar equipment,

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} radio transmission equipment,

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} radio receiving equipment,

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} electrical generating equipment that has a maximum
  load capacity of not more than 15 kilowatts, or

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} portable electrical generating equipment,

and property acquired after May 25, 1976 that is

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} an aircraft;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} furniture, fittings or equipment attached to an
  aircraft; or

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} a spare part for an aircraft, or for furniture,
  fittings or equipment attached to an aircraft.

### [CLASS 10]{.HLabel1}[(30 per cent)]{.HTitleText1} {#class-1030-per-cent .SchedHeadL1}

Property not included in any other class that is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} automotive equipment, including a trolley bus, but
  not including

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an automotive railway car acquired after May 25,
    1976,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a railway locomotive, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a tramcar,

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a portable tool acquired after May 25, 1976 for the
  purpose of earning rental income for short terms, such as hourly,
  daily, weekly or monthly, except a property described in Class 12,

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} harness or stable equipment,

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a sleigh or wagon,

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} a trailer, including a trailer designed to be hauled
  on both highways and railway tracks,

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} general-purpose electronic data processing equipment
  and systems software for that equipment, including ancillary data
  processing equipment, acquired after May 25, 1976 and before March 23,
  2004 (or after March 22, 2004 and before 2005 if an election in
  respect of the property is made under subsection 1101(5q)), but not
  including property that is principally or is used principally as

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} electronic process control or monitor equipment,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} electronic communications control equipment,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} systems software for a property referred to in
    subparagraph (i) or (ii), or

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} data handling equipment unless it is ancillary to
    general-purpose electronic data processing equipment,

- [(f.1)]{.lawlabel} a designated underground storage cost, or

- [(f.2)]{.lawlabel} an unmanned telecommunication spacecraft designed
  to orbit above the earth,

and property (other than property included in Class 41, 41.1 or 41.2 or
property included in Class 43 that is described in paragraph (b) of that
Class) that would otherwise be included in another Class in this
Schedule, that is

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} a building or other structure (other than property
  described in paragraph (l) or (m) that would otherwise be included in
  Class 1, 3 or 6 and that was acquired for the purpose of gaining or
  producing income from a mine, except

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a property included in Class 28,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a property acquired principally for the purpose of
    gaining or producing income from the processing of ore from a
    mineral resource that is not owned by the taxpayer,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} an office building not situated on the mine
    property, or

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a refinery that was acquired by the taxpayer

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} before November 8, 1969, or

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} after November 7, 1969 and that had been used
      before November 8, 1969 by any person with whom the taxpayer was
      not dealing at arm's length;

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/80-99, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} contractor's movable equipment, including portable
  camp buildings, acquired for use in a construction business or for
  lease to another taxpayer for use in that other taxpayer's
  construction business, except a property included in

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} this Class by virtue of paragraph (t),

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a separate class prescribed by subsection
    1101(2b), or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} Class 22 or 38;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} a floor of a roller skating rink;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} gas or oil well equipment;

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} property (other than property included in class 28 or
  property described in paragraph (l) or (m)) that was acquired for the
  purpose of gaining or producing income from a mine and that is

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a structure that would otherwise be included in
    Class 8, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} machinery or equipment,

  except a property acquired before May 9, 1972 for the purpose of
  gaining or producing income from the processing of ore after
  extraction from a mineral resource that is not owned by the taxpayer;

- [(l)]{.lawlabel} property acquired after the 1971 taxation year for
  the purpose of gaining or producing income from a mine and providing
  services to the mine or to a community where a substantial proportion
  of the persons who ordinarily work at the mine reside, if such
  property is

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an airport, dam, dock, fire hall, hospital, house,
    natural gas pipeline, power line, recreational facility, school,
    sewage disposal plant, sewer, street lighting system, town hall,
    water pipeline, water pumping station, water system, wharf or
    similar property,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a road, sidewalk, airplane runway, parking area,
    storage area or similar surface construction, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} machinery or equipment ancillary to any of the
    property described in subparagraph (i) or (ii),

  but is not

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a property included in Class 28, or

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} a railway not situated on the mine property;

- [(m)]{.lawlabel} property acquired after March 31, 1977, principally
  for the purpose of gaining or producing income from a mine, if such
  property is

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} railway track and grading including components such
    as rails, ballast, ties and other track material,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} property ancillary to the track referred to in
    subparagraph (i) that is

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} railway traffic control or signalling equipment,
      including switching, block signalling, interlocking, crossing
      protection, detection, speed control or retarding equipment, or

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} a bridge, culvert, subway, trestle or tunnel,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} machinery or equipment ancillary to any of the
    property referred to in subparagraph (i) or (ii), or

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} conveying, loading, unloading or storing machinery
    or equipment, including a structure, acquired for the purpose of
    shipping output from the mine by means of the track referred to in
    subparagraph (i),

  but is not

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} property included in Class 28, or

  - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} for greater certainty, rolling stock;

- [(n)]{.lawlabel} property that was acquired for the purpose of cutting
  and removing merchantable timber from a timber limit and that will be
  of no further use to the taxpayer after all merchantable timber that
  the taxpayer is entitled to cut and remove from the limit has been cut
  and removed, unless the taxpayer has elected to include another
  property of this kind in another class in this Schedule;

- [(o)]{.lawlabel} mechanical equipment acquired for logging operations,
  except a property included in Class 7;

- [(p)]{.lawlabel} an access road or trail for the protection of
  standing timber against fire, insects or disease;

- [(q)]{.lawlabel} property acquired for a motion picture drive-in
  theatre;

- [(r)]{.lawlabel} property included in this class by virtue of
  subsection 1102(8) or (9), except a property included in Class 28;

- [(s)]{.lawlabel} a motion picture film or video tape acquired after
  May 25, 1976, except a property included in paragraph (w) or (x) or in
  Class 12;

- [(t)]{.lawlabel} a property acquired after May 22, 1979 that is
  designed principally for the purpose of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} determining the existence, location, extent or
    quality of accumulations of petroleum or natural gas,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} drilling oil or gas wells, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} determining the existence, location, extent or
    quality of mineral resources,

  except a property included in a separate class prescribed by
  subsection 1101(2b);

- [(u)]{.lawlabel} property acquired after 1980 to be used primarily in
  the processing in Canada of heavy crude oil recovered from a natural
  reservoir in Canada to a stage that is not beyond the crude oil stage
  or its equivalent that is

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} property that would otherwise be included in Class
    8 except railway rolling stock or a property described in
    paragraph (j) of Class 8,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an oil or water storage tank,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a powered industrial lift truck that would
    otherwise be included in paragraph (a), or

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} property that would otherwise be included in
    paragraph (f);

- [(v)]{.lawlabel} property acquired after August 31, 1984 (other than
  property that is included in Class 30) that is equipment used for the
  purpose of effecting an interface between a cable distribution system
  and electronic products used by consumers of that system and that is
  designed primarily

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} to augment the channel capacity of a television
    receiver or radio,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} to decode pay television or other signals provided
    on a discretionary basis, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} to achieve any combination of functions described
    in subparagraphs (i) and (ii);

- [(w)]{.lawlabel} a certified production acquired after 1987 and before
  March 1996;

- [(x)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian film or video production; or

- [(y)]{.lawlabel} a railway locomotive that is not an automotive
  railway car and that was not used or acquired for use for any purpose
  by any taxpayer before February 26, 2008.

  manufacturer thereof, acquired before May 26, 1976; or

  acquired by the taxpayer

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} before 1988, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} before 1990

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} pursuant to an obligation in writing entered into

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} that was under construction by or on behalf of

### [CLASS 12]{.HLabel1}[(100 per cent)]{.HTitleText1} {#class-12100-per-cent .SchedHeadL1}

Property not included in any other class that is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a book that is part of a lending library;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} chinaware, cutlery or other tableware;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a kitchen utensil costing less than

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} \$100, if acquired before May 26, 1976,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} \$200, if acquired after May 25, 1976, and before
    May 2, 2006, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} \$500, if acquired after May 1, 2006;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a die, jig, pattern, mould or last;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} a medical or dental instrument costing less than

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} \$100, if acquired before May 26, 1976,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} \$200, if acquired after May 25, 1976, and before
    May 2, 2006, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} \$500, if acquired after May 1, 2006;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} a mine shaft, main haulage way or similar underground
  work designed for continuing use, or any extension thereof, sunk or
  constructed after the mine came into production, to the extent that
  the property was acquired before 1988;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} linen;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} a tool (other than an electronic communication device
  or electronic data processing equipment that is acquired after May 1,
  2006 and that can be used for a purpose other than any of measuring,
  locating and calculating) costing less than

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} \$100, if acquired before May 26, 1976,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} \$200, if acquired after May 25, 1976, and before
    May 2, 2006, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} \$500, if acquired after May 1, 2006;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} a uniform;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} the cutting or shaping part in a machine;

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} apparel or costume, including accessories used
  therewith, used for the purpose of earning rental income;

- [(l)]{.lawlabel} a video tape acquired before May 26, 1976;

- [(m)]{.lawlabel} a motion picture film or video tape that is a
  television commercial message;

- [(n)]{.lawlabel} a certified feature film or certified production;

- [(o)]{.lawlabel} computer software acquired after May 25, 1976, but
  not including systems software and property that is described in
  paragraph (s);

- [(p)]{.lawlabel} a metric scale or a scale designed for ready
  conversion to metric weighing, acquired after March 31, 1977 and
  before 1984 for use in a retail business and having a maximum weighing
  capacity of 100 kilograms;

- [(q)]{.lawlabel} a designated overburden removal cost; or

- [(r)]{.lawlabel} a video-cassette, a video-laser disk or a digital
  video disk, that is acquired for the purpose of renting and that is
  not expected to be rented to any one person for more than 7 days in
  any 30- day period;

and property that would otherwise be included in another class in this
Schedule that is

- [(s)]{.lawlabel} acquired by the taxpayer after August 8, 1989 and
  before 1993, for use in a business of selling goods or providing
  services to consumers that is carried on in Canada, or for lease to
  another taxpayer for use by that other taxpayer in such a business,
  and that is

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} electronic bar code scanning equipment designed to
    read bar codes applied to goods held for sale in the ordinary course
    of the business,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a cash register or similar sales recording device
    designed with the capability of calculating and recording sales tax
    imposed by more than one jurisdiction in respect of the same sale,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} equipment or computer software that is designed
    to convert a cash register or similar sales recording device to one
    having the capability of calculating and recording sales tax imposed
    by more than one jurisdiction in respect of the same sale, or

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} electronic equipment or computer software that is
    ancillary to property described in subparagraph (i), (ii) or (iii)
    and all or substantially all the use of which is in conjunction with
    that property.

### [CLASS 13]{.HLabel1} {#class-13-1 .SchedHeadL1}

Property that is a leasehold interest and property acquired by a
taxpayer that would, if that property had been acquired by a person with
whom the taxpayer was not dealing at arm's length at the time the
property was acquired by the taxpayer, be a leasehold interest of that

  in respect of a right to explore for, drill for, take or remove
  minerals, petroleum, natural gas, other related hydrocarbons or
  timber;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} that part of the leasehold interest that is included
  in another class in this Schedule by reason of subsection 1102(5) or
  (5.1); or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a property included in Class 23.

Property that is a patent, franchise, concession or licence for a

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a leasehold interest;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a property included in Class 23;

### [CLASS 14.1]{.HLabel1}[(5 per cent)]{.HTitleText1} {#class-14.15-per-cent .SchedHeadL1}

Property of a taxpayer that, in respect of a business of the taxpayer,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} is goodwill;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} was eligible capital property of the taxpayer
  immediately before January 1, 2017 and is owned by the taxpayer at the
  beginning of that day; or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} is acquired after 2016, other than

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} property that is tangible or, for civil law,
    corporeal property,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} property that is not acquired for the purpose of
    gaining or producing income from business,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} property in respect of which any amount is
    deductible (otherwise than as a result of being included in this
    class) in computing the taxpayer's income from the business,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} property in respect of which any amount is not
    deductible in computing the taxpayer's income from the business
    because of any provision of the Act (other than paragraph 18(1)(b))
    or these Regulations,

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} an interest in a trust,

  - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} an interest in a partnership,

  - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} a share, bond, debenture, mortgage, hypothecary
    claim, note, bill or other similar property, or

  - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} property that is an interest in, or for civil
    law a right in, or a right to acquire, a property described in any
    of subparagraphs (i) to (vii).

- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]

:::

### [CLASS 15]{.HLabel1} {#class-15-1 .SchedHeadL1}

Property that would otherwise be included in another class in this

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} was acquired for the purpose of cutting and removing
  merchantable timber from a timber limit, and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} will be of no further use to the taxpayer after all

  from the limit has been cut and removed,

except

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} property that the taxpayer has, in the taxation year

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a timber resource property.

### [CLASS 16]{.HLabel1}[(40 per cent)]{.HTitleText1} {#class-1640-per-cent .SchedHeadL1}

Property acquired before May 26, 1976 that is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} an aircraft,

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} furniture, fittings or equipment attached to an
  aircraft, or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a spare part for a property included in this class,

property acquired after May 25, 1976 that is

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a taxicab,

property acquired after November 12, 1981 that is

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} a motor vehicle that

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} would be an automobile as that term is defined in
    subsection 248(1) of the Act, if that definition were read without
    reference to paragraph (d) thereof,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} was acquired for the purpose of renting or
    leasing, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} is not expected to be rented or leased to any
    person for more than 30 days in any 12 month period,

property acquired after February 15, 1984 that is

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} a coin-operated video game or pinball machine,

and property acquired after December 6, 1991 that is

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} a truck or tractor designed for hauling freight, and
  that is primarily so used by the taxpayer or a person with whom the
  taxpayer does not deal at arm's length in a business that includes
  hauling freight, and that has a "gross vehicle weight rating" (as that
  term is defined in subsection 2(1) of the [Motor Vehicle Safety
  Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._1038)) in excess of 11,788
  kg.
